jobs.title: Director, Medical Governance Partner
jobs.description:
About the role

Serves as the Medical Governance Office's primary global-to-local governance partner, providing practical governance support, advice and expert input to Business Units, regional and country Medical teams.

Provides MGO accountability for the governance framework supporting GxP and other regulated Medical activities globally, while preserving the distinct accountabilities of activity owners, independent Quality functions, Ethics & Compliance and independent Audit.

Helps Medical teams apply MGO frameworks, standards, minimum controls and tools consistently; maintains the integrated Global Medical risk view and supports proactive risk management, audit/inspection readiness, CAPA/remediation follow-up and escalation.

Acts as a single point of connection between countries, MGO capability owners and key partner functions, using country experience, risk signals and assurance outcomes to improve processes, tools and capabilities and accelerate country support and decision-making.



How you will contribute

Lead the MGO governance framework for GxP and other regulated Medical activities globally, ensuring clear standards, minimum controls, activity classification, decision rights, documentation expectations, escalation routes and interfaces with independent Quality oversight.

Serve as the principal MGO governance partner to Business Unit, regional, cluster and country Medical leaders and activity owners; provide practical guidance and coaching and help teams navigate complex requirements, ownership questions and cross-functional dependencies.

Connect countries with the appropriate MGO capability owners - including Evidence Generation, Patient Solutions, Data Dissemination, Grants & Sponsorships and other Medical governance domains - and coordinate coherent support without duplicating domain ownership.

Establish and maintain the integrated Global Medical risk register and risk view; proactively identify material and emerging risks, recurring themes and cross-country issues, support mitigation with accountable owners and escalate significant or unresolved concerns through appropriate governance channels.

Lead MGO coordination of proactive GIA audit readiness and Medical audit workstreams, including risk-based country preparation, documentation and evidence readiness, SME coordination, issue escalation and enterprise follow-up of findings, while preserving auditor independence.

Coordinate Medical readiness support for Quality audits and health-authority inspections with R&D Quality, Commercial Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs and local activity owners; ensure governance expectations, records and controls are clear and retrievable.

Support root-cause analysis, CAPA and remediation planning for Medical governance findings; monitor significant actions, overdue items and effectiveness at enterprise level while formal ownership and closure remain with the accountable business or Quality owner.

Monitor governance performance and adherence through appropriate risk indicators, KPIs, dashboards and issue tracking; provide timely feedback to strengthen processes, systems, tools and country support.

Act as a key cross-functional interface with Global Internal Audit, R&D Quality, Commercial Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Privacy, Procurement, Digital/DD&T and other relevant functions, facilitating resolution of ownership gaps and handoffs.

Build a global Medical governance network and continuous-learning loop between countries: capture country feedback, audit/CAPA themes and recurring questions; share effective practices; and translate insights into clearer guidance, 'how-to' materials, training inputs, tools and recommendations for MGO framework improvement.



Dimensions and Aspects

Global remit across Business Units, regions, clusters and countries in a regulated, matrixed environment with differing local requirements, Medical Affairs maturity and Quality footprints.

Works across Medical activities with non-GxP, GCP/GVP and GMP/GDP interfaces. Activity owners retain strategy and execution; MGO sets enterprise Medical governance expectations and risk visibility; Quality retains independent Quality authority; Audit retains independent assurance responsibilities.

Creates value for countries by providing an accessible route into MGO, reducing navigation complexity, connecting teams to the right expertise early and helping resolve governance issues before they become recurring findings or execution barriers.



Technical / Functional Expertise

Strong knowledge of Medical Affairs governance, quality systems and governance of GxP and other regulated Medical activities, including risk-based oversight, audit/inspection readiness, root-cause analysis, CAPA and remediation.

Ability to translate enterprise policies, standards and quality requirements into clear, practical guidance while maintaining appropriate boundaries between business ownership, MGO governance, Ethics & Compliance, independent Quality and Audit.



Leadership

Acts as a trusted advisor, coach and constructive challenger to Medical leaders and teams; promotes early engagement, transparency, learning and sustainable improvement rather than reactive compliance.

Influences without direct authority across geographies and seniority levels and brings the right stakeholders together to resolve ambiguity, recurring issues and cross-functional dependencies.



Decision-Making and Autonomy

Within approved MGO direction, determines the operating approach for global-to-local governance partnership, enterprise Medical risk visibility, proactive country support, audit-readiness coordination and cross-country issue follow-up.

Determines when MGO guidance is sufficient and when formal input or decision is required from Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs or another accountable function; recommends escalation or enterprise action based on risk and recurrence.



Interaction

Works directly with the Head, Medical Governance Office and MGO capability leads and maintains regular engagement with Business Unit/regional Medical leaders, Cluster Medical Heads, Country Medical Directors and Medical activity owners.

Coordinates closely with GIA/Enterprise Auditing, R&D Quality, Commercial Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, PV, RA, Privacy, Procurement, Digital/DD&T and other partner functions.



Innovation

Identifies opportunities to simplify governance and use data, analytics, automation and approved AI-enabled capabilities to improve risk sensing, governance visibility, audit readiness, knowledge reuse and decision support.



Complexity

Balances global consistency with valid local requirements across multiple Medical governance domains and functions, operating through partnership and matrix leadership rather than direct control of country teams.



Skills and qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, public health, healthcare management, quality, compliance or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

10+ years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs, Medical governance, quality/compliance, Medical operations or related functions in the biopharmaceutical or healthcare industry.

Demonstrated experience with GxP and other regulated Medical activities and with Quality, Ethics & Compliance, Legal, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs and Audit stakeholders.

Experience supporting global/regional/country Medical teams through governance guidance, risk assessment, audit or inspection readiness, CAPA/remediation, issue management or continuous improvement.

Proven success in complex global matrix organizations, including senior stakeholder influence.



Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of Medical governance, regulated-activity governance, risk-based oversight, audit/inspection readiness, CAPA and sustainable remediation.

Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; able to connect individual country issues to enterprise patterns and maintain meaningful risk views, metrics and dashboards.

Ability to create concise, practical governance guidance, decision aids, checklists, playbooks and learning materials and to manage cross-functional actions, escalation and follow-through.



Behavioural Competencies

Trusted-partner and customer-focused mindset with strong listening, coaching, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.

Excellent executive communication and judgment; able to frame complex governance issues, risks, implications and recommendations clearly and challenge constructively.

Collaborative, pragmatic and culturally sensitive working style with strong ownership, follow-through and commitment to transparency, learning and continuous improvement.



Languages

Fluent English required; additional languages advantageous.

DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
=======================

**Company Description**

MF Group is a subsidiary of Riverty and part of the Bertelsmann Group. Around 120 employees  
work across two locations in Switzerland to make invoice\-based purchasing with flexible  
installment payments even simpler and safer for Swiss retailers. As a leading Swiss provider, we  
are a key partner for the retail sector, combining credit checks, fraud prevention, invoicing, and  
pre\-financing into a comprehensive end‑to‑end solution.  
In addition to our straightforward invoice payment solutions—both online and in‑store—we offer  
private customers flexible cash loans. We also issue a variety of payment cards. Our strength  
lies in managing complex projects where multiple sales channels and payment methods interact  
seamlessly. We work with nearly all major brick‑and‑mortar and online retailers in Switzerland,  
actively shaping the future of payments.



**Description**

DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)  
(unlimited, full\-time) Join our team at our location in Chiasso – flexible working conditions  
available**


As part of the Cloud \& Infrastructure team, you will play a key role in designing, automating, and  
operating CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure platforms supporting MF Group's critical business  
systems. You will contribute directly to modernizing our software delivery processes, improving  
deployment reliability, and enabling fast, secure, and repeatable delivery of applications across  
on\-premises and cloud environments.

The position is ideal for someone who enjoys automating repetitive work, bridging development and operations, and taking ownership of platform topics while driving the adoption of DevOps practices across teams.

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI), collaborating closely with development teams to optimize build, test, and release workflows.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure as
* Code tools such as Ansible and Packer, contributing to cloud\-ready environments.

* Own security hardening, patch management, and vulnerability remediation across infrastructure and the delivery pipeline.
* Define and maintain infrastructure standards, best practices, and technical documentation.




**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Schlieren

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Teamleitung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Schlieren

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Schlieren liegt westlich von Zürich und ist durch die S-Bahn sowie mehrere Buslinien ausgezeichnet erreichbar. Die zentrale Lage in der Metropolitanregion macht den Ort für Pendler attraktiv. Sie profitieren von stabilen Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie und Dienstleistung, modernen Infrastrukturen und guter Verkehrsanbindung. Die Nähe zu Zürich bei gleichzeitig niedrigeren Kosten macht Schlieren zu einem beliebten Arbeitsstandort.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Teamleitung in Schlieren

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Teamleitung

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Teamleitung in Schlieren verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). - Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Teamleitung in Schlieren

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Solution Architect
==================











  **Description**  




Within the Solution Architecture and Engineering IT organization, we are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to **drive the firm\-wide adoption of strategic technologies and the delivery of technology projects, from architectural vision to scalable implementation**.







**This role offers the opportunity to make a tangible, firm\-wide impact,** with real ownership to take responsibility for solutions and **directly influence how technology is used across the organization.**



It spans the full lifecycle from concept and architectural design through to hands\-on delivery and operationalization, with a strong focus on building reusable, enterprise\-grade capabilities.







The Solution Architect will play **a key role in enabling business\-critical initiatives** and in driving the smart, sustainable adoption of technology to **deliver measurable business value at scale**, **increased efficiency**, and long\-term evolution of our architectural and technology landscape.

Product Designer \- Digital Platforms (Real Estate, CRM \& AI) (f/m/d) \| 80–100% \| Hybrid Working Model \| Zürich, Switzerland

**Company Description**



**Welcome to SMG Swiss Marketplace Group!**



SMG is a pioneering network of online marketplaces and a leading European digital company that simplifies people’s lives with forward\-looking products.  
We operate leading marketplaces across real estate, automotive, general classifieds, and finance \& insurance. We’re driven by our values: **Better Together, Aim High, and Act Responsibly.**  




  **Description**



As a Product Designer at SMG Real Estate, you will play a key role in shaping and scaling products for real estate professionals and property seekers across Homegate, ImmoScout24, Flatfox, and our CRM tools for managing listings and enquiries. Your work will contribute directly to our core goals around customer acquisition, retention, and satisfaction.  

In close collaboration with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Analysts, , and other stakeholders, you will help uncover customer insights through discovery and research, and translate them into seamless, market\-ready product experiences. You will design solutions that connect property seekers with listers to generate high\-quality, qualified leads.  

This role allows you to pioneer AI\-native design methodologies and multi\-brand design systems while contributing to our overarching goal of helping property seekers find homes faster and providing listers with high\-quality qualified leads.  

Join our dynamic team, located across six countries (Switzerland, Serbia, Vietnam, , Germany, and ), where creativity and innovation thrive. Together, we tackle challenges, celebrate successes, and keep learning and growing.  

**Specifically, you will work on:**



* Designing seamless, intuitive user journeys for improving listing quality, visibility, and performance across B2C and B2B experiences on Web and Mobile Apps, directly aligned with key product and business OKRs.
* Integrating active AI tools and workflows into daily design practices; from rapid AI\-driven wireframing, generative UI/UX concepts, and interactive prototyping to automated synthesis of user research feedback.
* Building, evolving, and maintaining scalable, multi\-brand design systems for SMG Real Estate products, leveraging AI automation for component governance, design token synchronisation, accessibility checks, and design\-to\-code pipelines.
* Partnering closely with Product Managers, Data Analysts, and Engineers to conduct A/B tests, fake door tests, and user research sessions to continuously refine features, reduce user friction, and boost key acquisition metrics.
* Establishing AI Design Ops guidelines together with the team members on leveraging generative AI tools to elevate product quality and team efficiency.  



**Qualifications**



* 5\+ years of experience as a Product Designer or Senior Product Designer shaping complex B2C digital marketplace or subscription products across Web, iOS, and Android platforms.
* Proven track record of active AI usage within the design lifecycle (e.g., leveraging AI for UI generation, rapid prototyping, UX research synthesis, and workflow automation).
* Demonstrated expertise in building, documenting, and managing scalable multi\-brand design systems, with experience using AI tools to streamline design tokens, component maintenance, and governance.
* Strong background in user\-centered design, quantitative/qualitative user research, A/B testing, and data\-informed decision\-making to optimize conversion funnels and drive key subscription growth metrics.
* Outstanding cross\-functional communication and collaboration skills in English, working effectively across international, multi\-disciplinary engineering and product teams.
* Fluency or working proficiency in (Swiss) is a strong advantage.  



**Additional Information**



**What do we offer?**



* 6 weeks of holidays per year (plus option to buy 10 extra)
* 40\-hour work week with flexitime (capped at 45 hours)
* A hybrid work setup with flexibility to work remotely
* Generous parental leave: 18 weeks for maternity and 6 weeks for paternity/adoption
* SBB Half\-Fare Card and first\-class travel between SMG offices in Switzerland
* Gender\-neutral pay and transparent career paths
* Choose your gear: Mac or Windows laptop, and iPhone, Samsung, or Pixel mobile
* An inclusive and innovative environment where your voice matters


**Recruitment Process**



We believe hiring is a two\-way street, where both parties get to know each other. Here's what  
you can expect:



* Initial Screening Call (Video 30 min)
* Meeting the Hiring Manager / Portfolio Review (Video 60 min)
* Case Study / Design Challenge (Video 60 min)

**Apply now**



To take advantage of this great opportunity, please send us your detailed CV and feel free to include any supporting documents that will help us understand why you are the perfect fit.

**About Us**



**SMG Swiss Marketplace Group** is a pioneering network of online marketplaces and a cutting\-edge digital company that simplifies people’s lives with innovative products.  
SMG Swiss Marketplace Group provides customers with the best tools to meet their life decision needs. The portfolio includes Real Estate (ImmoScout24, Homegate, Flatfox, CASASOFT, IAZI), Automotive (AutoScout24, MotoScout24\), General Marketplaces ( , , ) and Finance \& Insurance (FinanceScout24, ).

Scientist \- Biology (m/f/d), 100%
==================================

**\#SingleCell \#Biomedical \#NGS \#MolecularBiology \#YourNewJob**

Our customer, a **pharmaceutical company** based in **Basel**, needs reinforcement. For a **temporary employment** from 01\.11\.2026 to 30\.04\.2028 (18 month contract), we are looking for an experienced professional to support technical transfer operations.

    



### Benefits

* An internationally operating, innovative Swiss pharmaceutical company, a leader in its field
* Flexible working hours and extensive training opportunities
* A motivated multicultural team and environment


### Your main responsibilities

* Develop, evaluate, and implement innovative NGS methods and protocols, with emphasis on single\-cell RNA sequencing and spatial multimodal applications or multi\-omics applications to enhance platform capabilities and provide comprehensive in\-sights into disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets
* Independently perform experiments, analyze data, and generate high\-quality reports.
* Apply scientific rigor to ensure the generation of FAIR\-compliant data.
* Collaborate with wet lab and bioinformatics teams to interpret complex sequencing datasets and provide actionable insights to project teams
* Present protocols and results to internal stakeholders


### Your Profile

* Master’s degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline with 1\-2 years industry experience specifically in genomics, in\-situ hybridization, imaging and spatial techniques
* Direct, demonstrable experience with advanced molecular technologies, particularly Next\-Generation Sequencing (NGS) workflows
* Exceptional proficiency in molecular biology techniques, including nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, and NGS library preparation
* Experience working with challenging clinical sample types (e.g., FFPE tissue, primary tumor cells, low\-input samples).
* Experience and enthusiasm for developing and refining experimental methods.
* Ability to independently conduct experiments, evaluate data, and communicate findings effectively.
* You have an exceptional ability to collaborate within and across matrix teams, enabling both effective independent and team\-based work in a diverse and heterogeneous environment
* Fluent in English and local language.
* Basel, on\-site role

jobs.description:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

To sustain the company's growth, Ledger is looking for a Senior Scala Backend Engineer to join the Cloud Wallet team. This team builds and operates the backend services that power blockchain account management, transaction processing and on-chain data aggregation across all Ledger wallet surfaces, from Ledger Live to Ledger Enterprise, the custody platform used by financial institutions. Every client transaction goes through these services, and so does every new blockchain Ledger supports. We believe in the power of functional programming to build robust and scalable platforms. We take time to share, challenge, and grow together through bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, meetups, conferences, and open source contributions.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, build and operate the Scala services that connect Ledger wallets and the Ledger Enterprise platform to blockchain backends: account creation, operation history, transaction crafting, broadcast and lifecycle tracking.

  • Lead new blockchain integrations end to end, from the integration design (ADR) to production, across account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

  • Own production quality on your scope: SLIs and SLOs, observability, distributed tracing. Take part in the firefighting rotation and drive incidents to resolution, including those raised by institutional clients.

  • Define clear contracts with the Coin Integration and Ledger Enterprise teams, for example where UTXO selection lives or how transaction states are exposed to consumers.

  • Write and review ADRs, challenge designs, and raise the bar on code quality, testing (including end-to-end on testnets) and technical debt management.

  • Work in an AI-native way: use coding agents daily, write the specifications, constraints and verification that let them deliver safely, and contribute to the team's AI tooling.

  • Mentor other engineers and share your knowledge across the Backend Blockchain community.

     

You will collaborate cross-functionally with:

  • The Coin Integration team for coin modules and new blockchain integrations.

  • The Ledger Enterprise team, main consumer of the team's services for institutional custody.

  • The Ledger Wallet, Ledger Button and Wallet XP teams as consumers of the team's backend APIs.

  • The Blockchain platform team for data model alignment, indexing and event streaming.

  • The Infrastructure and SRE teams for deployment, reliability and scalability.

  • The Security team (Donjon) for vulnerability analysis and remediation.

  • The Product team for roadmap prioritization and customer-driven requirements.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend engineering, with real production ownership of distributed systems.

  • Strong production experience

  • Interest for Scala and functional programming practice

  • Hands-on blockchain integration experience: transaction lifecycle, fees, finality, reorgs, on at least two models among account-based, UTXO and privacy-preserving chains.

  • Experience with event-driven systems and data infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, NATS or equivalent) and with observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).

  • Able to diagnose an incident across several services and own the outcome, from root cause to fix in production.

  • Comfortable reading and contributing to TypeScript code, as the team works on a polyglot stack.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

  • Clear written communication in English, especially for design documents and incident reports.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Responsable Réglementation et Conformité (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Juridique.  Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Le Responsable Réglementation et Conformité veille à ce que l'entreprise respecte l'ensemble des réglementations applicables à ses activités, produits et processus, tant au niveau national qu'international. Il garantit la conformité des collections (prêt-à-porter et accessoires, lifestyle et décoration/maison) avec les normes en vigueur, tout en intégrant les enjeux éthiques, environnementaux et sociaux sur l'ensemble des marques du groupe. Il pilote par ailleurs le dispositif de conformité corporate du groupe, en particulier la lutte anticorruption.

Missions

1. Veille réglementaire et normative

  • Assurer une veille constante sur les réglementations applicables : droit de la consommation, droit du travail, droit commercial, douanes, réglementation textile, REACH, sécurité produit, étiquetage, allégations environnementales (directive Empowering Consumers), protection des données
  • Identifier les évolutions réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter l'activité de l'entreprise (France, UE, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, pays de fabrication et de distribution)
  • Informer les équipes internes des évolutions et les accompagner dans leur mise en œuvre

2. Conformité produit

  • S'assurer que les produits respectent les exigences légales en matière de composition, traçabilité, étiquetage, sécurité, tests laboratoires, sur l'ensemble des catégories (textile, maroquinerie, bijoux, lifestyle, décoration/maison)
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes qualité, achats, design, développement produit et supply chain afin de garantir la bonne conduite des audits de conformité et des tests produits (substances réglementées, inflammabilité, solidité, sécurité des articles enfant…)

3. Conformité corporate et lutte anticorruption

  • Piloter le dispositif de conformité à la loi Sapin II : cartographie des risques de corruption, code de conduite, dispositif d'alerte interne, procédures d'évaluation des tiers, formation des collaborateurs exposés 
  • Gérer le dispositif de recueil des signalements (lanceurs d'alerte) : réception, qualification, instruction et suivi, dans le respect de la confidentialité et des délais légaux
  • Déployer et suivre les procédures de due diligence tiers (fournisseurs, intermédiaires, agents à l'international)
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations liées au devoir de vigilance et au reporting de durabilité (CSRD), en lien avec les équipes RSE et Finance

4. Accompagnement des équipes et mise en conformité

  • Rédiger ou actualiser les procédures internes et les différents cahiers des charges (produits, matières, fournitures)
  • Former les collaborateurs aux enjeux réglementaires et de conformité (équipes design, production, marketing, supply chain, achats, finance, commerce)
  • Aider à l'accompagnement par les équipes des fournisseurs dans la mise en conformité des produits et dans le respect des standards sociaux et environnementaux de l'entreprise
  • Être le point de contact des équipes opérationnelles pour toute question de conformité, et savoir arbitrer entre exigence réglementaire et réalité business

5. Gestion des risques et reporting

  • Mettre en place des plans de prévention ; animer et mettre à jour la cartographie des risques de conformité du groupe 
  • Suivre les indicateurs de conformité et établir un reporting régulier
  • Gérer les situations liées à une non-conformité : rappels produits, litiges clients, contrôles DGCCRF, AFA, CNIL ou autorités étrangères
  • Piloter les relations avec les conseils externes sur les sujets de conformité

Requirements

  • Formation supérieure en droit (Master 2 en droit des affaires, compliance, droit de la consommation ou équivalent) ; une certification compliance est un atout
  • 6 à 10 ans d'expérience en conformité, en entreprise ou en cabinet, avec une expérience opérationnelle avérée du déploiement d'un dispositif Sapin II
  • Une expérience dans le retail, le e-commerce ou les biens de consommation est fortement souhaitée, idéalement avec une exposition à la conformité produit textile et aux filières REP
  • Maîtrise des réglementations clés : Sapin II, RGPD, droit de la consommation, devoir de vigilance, réglementation textile et sécurité produit
  • Capacité à traduire la réglementation en process opérationnels simples, applicables par des équipes non juristes
  • Rigueur, autonomie, sens de la confidentialité et solidité face à des situations sensibles
  • Anglais courant indispensable, environnement de travail international

Het gaat om strategische, Vanboeijen-brede facilitaire projecten met een afdeling overstijgend karakter. Dit kan variëren van een huisvestingsproject tot een project voor het optimaliseren van het FMIS-systeem.

Je komt met verbetervoorstellen en bent betrokken bij het optimaliseren van facilitaire werkprocessen. Je schrijft beleidsnotities en treedt op als projectleider bij complexe projecten. Daarnaast neem je deel aan diverse werkgroepen en projectteams, denk je mee over verschillende vraagstukken en oplossingen en geef je huisvestingsadvies.

Als Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de totstandkoming en uitvoering van de projectenkalender voor verbouw- en nieuwbouwprojecten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de bouwkundige projectleiders. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met de facilitaire adviseurs, die goed weten wat er op de zorglocaties nodig is om de bewoners een prettige en veilige omgeving te bieden om te wonen en/of te werken.

Na afronding van een project zorg je voor een goede overdracht aan de beheerorganisatie. Je bent proactief en ondernemend en weet onverwachte ontwikkelingen te vertalen naar concrete projecten. Daarbij zoek je actief de verbinding binnen en buiten de facilitaire afdeling.

Je standaard werkplek is Assen. In overleg is thuiswerken ook goed mogelijk.

Wil jij jouw ervaring met facilitaire dienstverlening en projectmanagement inzetten voor projecten die echt impact hebben? Als Projectleider Facilitair en Huisvesting werk je aan uiteenlopende, complexe projecten binnen Vanboeijen. Van huisvestingsprojecten tot het optimaliseren van het FMIS systeem jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteitseisen worden gerealiseerd. Daarbij verbind je verschillende disciplines en zorg je ervoor dat de facilitaire dienstverlening steeds beter aansluit bij wat nodig is voor de bewoners en medewerkers.

Vanboeijen ondersteunt ruim 700 kinderen, jongeren, volwassenen en ouderen met een verstandelijke beperking in Drenthe en omgeving. Met ongeveer 1600 medewerkers wordt dagelijks gewerkt vanuit de missie Goed leven, Mooi werk, Met elkaar.

jobs.description:
Als taxichauffeur leerlingenvervoer vervoer je leerlingen veilig en op tijd van huis naar school en weer terug. Je zorgt voor een rustige en prettige rit, helpt bij het in- en uitstappen en bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor leerlingen en hun ouders.

Bij Van Driel draait het om mensen. Wij vervoeren leerlingen die niet zelfstandig naar school of dagbesteding kunnen reizen. Voor deze kinderen is een vertrouwd gezicht achter het stuur belangrijk. Daarom zoeken wij een sociale, zorgzame en verantwoordelijke chauffeur die graag iets betekent voor anderen.

Als taxichauffeur leerlingenvervoer in de regio Den Bosch vervoer je leerlingen veilig van huis naar school en weer terug. Je helpt bij het in- en uitstappen, zorgt dat iedereen veilig zit en maakt van iedere rit een prettige ervaring. Met jouw aandacht en betrokkenheid voelen leerlingen zich veilig en op hun gemak.

De werkzaamheden vinden plaats op schooldagen in de ochtend en middag, waardoor de functie goed te combineren is met andere activiteiten.

jobs.title: Manager Financiele Administratie

Rechtstreeks dienstverband.

Daarnaast begeleid je de financiële integratie van een recent overgenomen onderneming. Je zorgt ervoor dat systemen en processen zorgvuldig op elkaar worden afgestemd en dat de overgang soepel verloopt. Wat ga je doen?
Aansturen, begeleiden en verder ontwikkelen van het accountingteam in Nederland en België.
Verzorgen van de maand- en jaarafsluitingen en tijdige rapportages aan de centrale organisatie.
Toezien op de grootboek-, debiteuren-, crediteuren-, salaris- en vasteactiva-administratie.
Bewaken van de balans en winst-en-verliesrekening.
Monitoren van het werkkapitaal, waaronder debiteuren, crediteuren en voorraden.

Vereisten?
Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding in Accountancy, Finance of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen accounting, waarvan ten minste drie jaar in een leidinggevende functie. Gedegen kennis van financiële verslaggeving, boekhoudkundige principes en relevante wet- en regelgeving.Kennis van IFRS is een pré.
Ervaring met ERP- en boekhoudsystemen, bij voorkeur Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite of SAP. Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden. Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Ervaring met systemen zoals Exocad is een pré

jobs.title: Medewerker Selectie & Opleiding
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van gesprekken met mensen en weet jij snel een goed beeld van iemand te vormen? Vind je het leuk om kandidaten te begeleiden en samen te kijken naar de mogelijkheden voor een nieuwe stap in hun carrière? Dan is de functie van Medewerker Selectie & Opleiding bij Taxiwerq misschien iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Medewerker Selectie & Opleiding ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor mensen die als taxichauffeur aan de slag willen. Vanuit heel Nederland komen dagelijks sollicitaties binnen via onze website, relaties, het UWV, gemeenten en andere kanalen.
Jij voert het eerste telefonische gesprek met deze kandidaten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen een cv. Je wilt weten wie iemand is, wat hem of haar motiveert en of het werk als taxichauffeur past bij de persoonlijke situatie en verwachtingen.
Je bespreekt onder andere de beschikbaarheid, het gewenste aantal uren en de mogelijkheden binnen het personenvervoer. Ook informeer je kandidaten over wat nodig is om als taxichauffeur te kunnen starten, zoals medische geschiktheid, een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) en de benodigde opleiding.
Omdat kandidaten gebruik kunnen maken van verschillende  Financieringsmogelijkheden, kijk je samen met hen welke route van toepassing is. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld via het UWV, een gemeente, een andere regeling of op eigen initiatief.
Tijdens het gesprek maak je een goede inschatting van de kandidaat. Past iemand bij het werk? Zijn de verwachtingen realistisch? Is de kandidaat gemotiveerd en zie jij voldoende mogelijkheden om het traject voort te zetten?
Wanneer het totaalplaatje klopt, zorg jij ervoor dat de kandidaat doorgaat naar de volgende stap. Je plant een vervolggesprek in bij een van je collegas en zorgt ervoor dat alle relevante informatie goed wordt vastgelegd.
Jij bent daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen de kandidaat en een mogelijke nieuwe baan als taxichauffeur.

Je gaat werken bij Taxiwerq in Hoogeveen. Wij zijn actief op het gebied van personeelsbemiddeling binnen het personenvervoer en helpen mensen bij het vinden van passend werk als taxichauffeur.
Wij geloven dat goed werk belangrijk is voor een gezonde balans in het dagelijks leven. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat mensen zich gezien, gehoord en gerespecteerd voelen.
Die persoonlijke benadering zie je ook terug binnen ons eigen team. We werken hard, helpen elkaar en vinden een goede dosis humor belangrijk. En tussen het werk door is er natuurlijk altijd ruimte voor een spannend potje tafeltennis.

Je werkzaamheden zijn:

- Je weet precies wat er op de bouw gebeurd en borg je de operationele uitvoering. Ook weet je de uitdagingen van de bouwlocatie en bouwwijze op de juiste wijze te beheersen en vertalen noodzakelijke planning, materiaal en materieel.
- Je zorgt dat de aangedragen planning gerealiseerd wordt. Je signaleert kansen en bedreigingen en zorgt proactief voor adequate acties en aanpassingen.
- Je communiceert met de project coordinatie, de diverse montage partijen en de vertegenwoordiger van de klant. Hierdoor speel je in op de actualiteiten van het project en stem je met alle nodige partijen af.

jobs.title: Jouw ervaring in elektrotechniek voor de klas in Apeldoorn
jobs.description:
Je werkt minimaal 3 jaar in de elektrotechnische installatiebranche en wilt jouw praktijkervaring graag doorgeven. Je kent de NEN 1010 en NEN 3140 en weet hoe je deze toepast bij het inspecteren van elektrische laagspanningsinstallaties. Heb je al lesgegeven aan werkende volwassenen? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen. Ook zonder leservaring of docentenbevoegdheid horen we graag van je!

Krijg jij energie van elektrotechniek én van het moment waarop iemand jouw uitleg begrijpt? Bij Elektrovakopleidingen in Weert geef je jouw vakkennis door aan volwassenen die zich verder willen ontwikkelen in de elektrotechniek. Als Docent Elektrotechniek verzorg je theorie- en praktijklessen over het installeren, beheren en inspecteren van laagspanningsinstallaties. Je laat cursisten zien hoe ze de NEN 1010 en NEN 3140 in de praktijk toepassen en begeleidt hen bij het meten en beproeven. Met voorbeelden uit jouw eigen ervaring maak je de lesstof herkenbaar en begrijpelijk. De uitdaging? Iedere cursist brengt andere kennis, ervaring en vragen mee. Jij sluit daarop aan, helpt hen verder en ziet hoe hun vaardigheden en vertrouwen groeien. Daarnaast denk je mee over het verbeteren van ons lesmateriaal en onze cursussen. Je krijgt duidelijke lesstof om mee te werken en ruimte om jouw praktijkkennis in de lessen te verwerken. Elektrovakopleidingen is een opleidingsinstituut voor professionals in de elektrotechniek. In onze eigen theorie- en praktijklokalen combineren we actuele vakkennis met realistische oefeningen en persoonlijke begeleiding. Voor onze nieuwe locatie in Weert zoeken we een collega die samen met ons de opleidingen verder vormgeeft. Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten voor de ontwikkeling van andere vakmensen? Solliciteer of neem vrijblijvend contact met ons op. We maken graag kennis met je!

Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

The accommodations are gorgeous holiday homes. You are available every Monday and/or Friday. Je werkt op maandag en vrijdag van 10:00 uur tot 16:00 uur in Cadzand. soms ook op dinsdag en Donderdag alles is in overleg mogelijk. Wanneer er wordt gevraagd wat langer door te werken, is dat uiteraard geen probleem voor jou.

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Electronics Engineer, you will work on advanced electronic products within a high-tech environment, with a strong focus on existing products and their further development, testing and ramp-up into production. You will be involved in the complete electronics engineering process: from analysing and improving existing designs to testing hardware, troubleshooting technical issues and supporting the transition towards stable, high-volume production. A large part of your work will involve understanding how electronic systems behave in practice. You will analyse test results, investigate technical issues and use simulation and modelling tools to support your conclusions. MATLAB will be an important tool in this process, alongside tools such as LTspice. Your responsibilities will include: Analysing and improving existing electronic designs and products. Selecting and integrating electronic components. Supporting PCBA and PCB design activities. Performing simulations and technical analyses using MATLAB and LTspice. Developing and executing test plans and test specifications. Testing and validating electronic hardware. Troubleshooting hardware during qualification, integration and production ramp-up. Analysing technical issues and identifying their root causes. Supporting prototype and production activities and helping to ensure products can be manufactured reliably and consistently. Reviewing PCB designs and related electronic components. Contributing to risk management and design quality activities. Working closely with colleagues from electronics, manufacturing, testing and other engineering disciplines. You will work on products where reliability, quality and technical performance are essential. The role combines analytical engineering with hands-on work, giving you the opportunity to see how electronic products perform not only on paper, but also in real-world production. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A full-time position of 38 hours per week. A competitive gross monthly

salary between €3,100 and €4,500, depending on your experience and level. Flexible working hours. Time-for-time compensation for additional hours worked. Performance-based salary growth. A personal development and learning plan tailored to your ambitions. Extensive opportunities for further growth within a high-tech engineering environment. Access to a company gym. Free lunch, dinner and healthy snacks at the workplace. Full relocation assistance Wat levert deze baan jou op? Build expertise through real engineering challenges This is a role where you can develop your technical knowledge by working directly with complex electronic products. You will not be limited to one small part of the engineering process: you will learn how electronics are analysed, tested, improved and prepared for reliable production. Develop from a broad electronics engineer into a specialist Depending on your interests and strengths, you can develop towards areas such as power electronics, precision analog electronics, RF or other specialised electronics disciplines. At the same time, you can choose to remain broadly involved across different technical areas. Learn by doing Especially if you are at the start of your career, you will have the opportunity to turn the knowledge you gained during your studies into practical engineering experience. You will work with real hardware, measurement equipment, simulations and production-related challenges. See the impact of your work Because you will work with existing products and their ramp-up, your work directly contributes to making products more stable, reliable and suitable for larger-scale production. You will see the results of your engineering decisions in actual hardware and production. Grow quickly in a high-tech environment You will work alongside experienced engineers and specialists from different disciplines. This gives you the opportunity to learn quickly, take ownership of increasingly complex challenges and build a strong foundation

You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.
  • ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.
  • support with your relocation
  • a comprehensive induction with your colleagues by your side.
  • 30-day vacation by default.
  • an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.


How to reach us

jobs.description:
Onze klant is een Belgische retailorganisatie in volle groei, actief op locaties die dagelijks veel passanten en pendelaars aantrekken.

Ze ontwikkelen moderne, frisse winkelconcepten waar klanten graag even stoppen voor kwaliteitsvolle snacks, koffie of een snelle maaltijd onderweg.

Vandaag beschikt de organisatie over een uitgebreid netwerk van shops verspreid over het land, telkens met een uitnodigende, hedendaagse uitstraling. De winkels zijn 7 dagen op 7 geopend en combineren een vlotte service met een aanbod dat inspeelt op verschillende momenten van de dag: van ontbijt tot snelle lunch of een kleine pauze tussendoor.

Binnen deze omgeving staat comfort, klantvriendelijkheid en efficiëntie centraal. Elke shop is ontworpen om klanten in een korte tijd een aangename ervaring te bieden, met aandacht voor kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en een duidelijke, moderne winkelbeleving.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je werkt in een enthousiast, familiaal team
  • Je krijgt een goede verloning en extra voordelen
  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden


Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistant Manager bij Foodstation ben je de rechterhand van de manager en speel je een cruciale rol binnen ons gloednieuwe foodconcept.

Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • het coördineren van de foodservice
  • helpen bij het bereiden en serveren van gerechten wanneer nodig
  • het aansturen, motiveren en ondersteunen van het team
  • het voorraadbeheer en de bestellingen opvolgen
  • toezien op netheid, hygiëne en veiligheid in de keuken en de foodcorner
  • klanten vriendelijk ontvangen en een uitstekende service garanderen
  • samen met de manager zorgen voor een vlotte werking en fijne werksfeer

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Manager van het Foodstation herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in de horeca of catering, je bent bij voorkeur vertrouwd met healthy fast food
  • je bent vertrouwd met het reilen en zeilen binnen retail food
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent flexibel inzetbaar en kan ook in het weekend werken
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren

De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een enthousiaste en gedreven teamplayer die energie haalt uit afwisseling en het coachen van een team.

Je hebt een passie voor voeding en de bereiding ervan en vindt het leuk om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar geen dag hetzelfde is.

Je kan terugkijken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring in een horeca-keten of een supermarkt, waarin het aansturen van collega's zeker aan bod kwam.

Organiseren, delegeren en actie ondernemen zijn jouw tweede natuur.

Je bent flexibel ingesteld en vindt het geen probleem om in het weekend te werken. Ook vroege en late uren (tussen 5u en 23u) schrikken jou niet af.

Je kan ook op vroege en late uren vlot ter plaatse zijn.

Je zoekt een vaste job waar je kan groeien binnen een gezonde en innovatieve organisatie.

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja Vatsakeskuksen osastolle M13
jobs.description:
Hei sairaanhoitaja,
Kiinnostaisiko sinua mielenkiintoinen ja monipuolinen työ kivassa työyhteisössä?
Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Meilahden tornisairaalan Vatsakeskuksen osastolle M13.

Olemme monierikoisalainen yksikkö, jossa yhdistyvät sekä elektiivinen, että päivystyksellinen toiminta. Osastollamme on 22-paikkainen kirurginen vuodeosasto sekä 5-paikkainen varhaisen kotiutumisen yksikkö (VARKO), jossa potilaat ovat seurannassa muun muassa endoskooppisten pientoimenpiteiden jälkeen. Erikoisaloihimme kuuluvat urologia, verisuonikirurgia, gastroenterologia, endokriininen kirurgia sekä endokrinologia.

Olethan hankkinut jo aikaisempaa kokemusta kirurgiasta. Yhdessä opetushoitajamme kanssa suunnittelemme perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan. Tärkeintä on hyvä ja motivoitunut asenne sekä halu oppia uutta. Useiden erikoisalojen ansiosta pääset kartuttamaan osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti ja kehittymään todelliseksi moniosaajaksi.Osastolla työskentelemme työparimallin mukaisesti, joten hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot ovat tärkeä osa tehtävässä menestymistä. Päivittäisen työn tukena osastolla toimivat myös kotiutushoitaja, vuorovastaava, apulaisosastonhoitaja sekä opetushoitaja.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta kirurgisen potilaan hoidosta tai päivystystoiminnasta sekä valmiutta tarttua erilaisiin tilanteisiin joustavasti. Viihdyt vauhdikkaassa työympäristössä ja pystyt säilyttämään rauhallisen ja ammatillisen otteen myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

Työ on kolmivuorotyötä ja käytössämme on yhteisöllinen työvuorosuunnittelu. Työvuorosuunnittelussa pyrimme huomioimaan työntekijöiden yksilölliset elämäntilanteet ja toiveet mahdollisuuksien mukaan.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3218,18€/kk, sekä mahdolliset kokemuslisät. Palkka määräytyy SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan.

HUSin työntekijänä sinulla on laajat kouluttautumismahdollisuudet ja ammatillisen kehittymisen edellytykset. HUS tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuolisia työsuhde-etuja mm:
Epassin liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työmatkaedun
Maksuttomat HUSin vastaanottokäynnit
Työsuhde- ja loma-asuntojen vuokrauspalvelut
mm. edullisen kuntosalin käyttömahdollisuuden

Haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää – panosta hyvään hakemukseen ja CV:hen ja kerro osaamisestasi. Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian tai viimeistään hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Tutustumme hakemukseesi jo hakuajan kuluessa ja kutsumme hakijoita haastatteluun.

Tervetuloa meille! HUSissa olet elämäntyössä.


Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja Vastasyntyneiden teho-osasto Saari Uusi lastensairaala
jobs.description:
Kiinnostaako sinua työ, jossa jokainen työpäivä on merkityksellinen ja täynnä oppimista? Tule mukaan Suomen suurimmalle vastasyntyneiden teho-osastolle osaksi tiimiämme! Haemme sairaanhoitajaa perhevapaan sijaisuuteen 20.11.26-21.7.27väliselle ajalle. Sijaisuus täytetään sopivan sijaisen löydyttyä.

Meillä pääset osaksi innostavaa ja positiivista työyhteisöä, jossa tuemme toisiamme ja jaamme osaamistamme. Työskentelet vastasyntyneiden ja ennenaikaisesti syntyneiden lasten parissa, joiden hoidossa yhdistyvät huipputeknologia sekä perhekeskeinen lähestymistapa. Jokainen päivä tuo mukanaan uuden mahdollisuuden oppia uutta, tukea perheitä ja kehittyä hoidon asiantuntijana.

Osastollamme on ympärivuorokautinen valmius hoitaa tehohoitoa tarvitsevat vastasyntyneet. Täällä saat arvokasta kokemusta keskosuudesta, hengitysvaikeuksista, infektioista ja monista muista vastasyntyneiden haasteista. Lasten ja nuorten palveluiden tulosalue tarjoaa sinulle Vastasyntyneiden teho-osastolla monipuolisen työympäristön, jossa riskiraskaudet ja varhaiset synnytykset ovat arkipäivää. Vastasyntyneiden teho-osasto sijaitsee Naistenklinikan rakennuksessa, lähellä Uutta lastensairaalaa.

Toivomme sinulta innokasta ja kehitysmyönteistä asennetta, hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä halua kasvaa alan huippuosaajaksi. Kolmivuorotyö mahdollistaa joustavan työvuorosuunnittelun – voit vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi yhteisöllisesti. Aikaisempi kokemus vastasyntyneiden tehohoidosta on etu, mutta tärkeintä on motivaatio ja halu oppia uutta.

Als Sales Manager verbindest du Neukundengewinnung mit strategischer Account-Entwicklung und baust unsere Marktposition im Schweizer Healthcare-IT-Markt weiter aus. Dich erwarten komplexe Sales Cycles, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Healthcare-IT-Expert*innen.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Du gewinnst neue Spitäler und steuerst den Sales Cycle bis zum Abschluss
  • Du entwickelst Accounts weiter und hebst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale
  • Du gewinnst Entscheider*innen in Management, IT und Fachbereichen

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb komplexer Software oder SaaS, idealerweise für Softwarelösungen für Kliniken
  • Du hast nachweislich Neukunden gewonnen und komplexe Sales Cycles abgeschlossen

jobs.title: Cloud and Data Platform Lead
jobs.description: Cloud and Data Platform Lead. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt joukkoomme Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajaa vastaamaan Helenin yhteisten pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta ja niiden kehittämisestä. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajana huolehdit siitä, että alustapalvelut muodostavat liiketoimintaa ja digitaalisten ratkaisujen kehittämistä tukevan, hallitun ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän kokonaisuuden. Tehtävä ei ole ensisijaisesti syvällinen tekninen asiantuntijarooli, vaan sinun tulee ymmärtää pilvi- ja dataratkaisujen toimintaympäristöä ja mahdollisuuksia. Pilvi- ja data-alustojen kehittämistä tehdään Helenissä virtuaalitiimin voimin. Roolissasi Vastaat Helenin pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta, niiden elinkaaresta ja suunnitelmallisesta kehittämisestä.Määrität yhdessä liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa alustapalveluiden tavoitetilaa.Vastaat alustapalveluiden laadusta, jatkuvuudesta, kustannustehokkuudesta, tietoturvasta ja tarkoituksenmukaisesta elinkaarenhallinnasta.Rakennat selkeitä palvelumalleja ja huolehdit siitä, että alustojen tarjoamat kyvykkyydet ovat niitä hyödyntäville tiimeille helposti ymmärrettäviä ja käytettäviä.Ohjaat palveluiden tuottamiseen ja kehittämiseen osallistuvia kumppaneita ja varmistat, että tekeminen etenee yhteisten tavoitteiden mukaisesti.Varmistat aktiivisen yhteistyön liiketoiminnan, IT:n, data- ja analytiikkatoimintojen, arkkitehtuurin, kyberturvan sekä muiden keskeisten sidosryhmien välillä.Toivomme sinulta Vähintään noin viiden vuoden kokemusta laajojen IT-palveluiden, alustojen tai digitaalisten kyvykkyyksien omistamisesta ja kehittämisestä.Hyvää kokonaisymmärrystä pilvi- ja data-alustoista liiketoiminnan ja digitaalisten palveluiden mahdollistajana sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeiden ja teknologian yhdistämisestä.Kykyä tarkastella palveluita myös kustannusten, riskien, jatkuvuuden ja käyttäjäkokemuksen näkökulmista.Kokemusta toimittaja- ja kumppanijohtamisesta sekä kykyä ohjata useiden toimijoiden muodostamaa kokonaisuutta.Hyviä yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja vaikuttamistaitoja sekä kykyä rakentaa yhteistä ymmärrystä erilaisten sidosryhmien välillä. Emme etsi tehtävään yksittäisen pilviteknologian syväosaajaa, vaan suunnannäyttäjää, joka pystyy johtamaan alustapalveluita kokonaisuutena ja tekemään niiden kehittämisestä liiketoimintalähtöistä. Tarjoamme sinulle Pilvi- ja data-alustat ovat keskeisiä mahdollistajia Helenin digitaalisten palveluiden, datan hyödyntämisen, analytiikan ja uusien AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisessä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia yhteisiä kyvykkyyksiä Helen tarjoaa kehittäjille ja liiketoiminnoille sekä miten niitä kehitetään tulevaisuudessa. Saat vastuullesi kokonaisuuden, jossa onnistuminen ei tarkoita vain teknisesti toimivaa alustaa. Tavoitteena on rakentaa palveluita, jotka ovat käyttäjilleen selkeitä, helposti hyödynnettäviä, kustannustehokkaita ja turvallisia ja jotka kehittyvät Helenin liiketoiminnan mukana. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jarmo Ojamo / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 11.10.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Solution Consultant Intern
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

Solution Consultant Intern — Mirakl Connect

📍 Paris | 🗓 January – June 2027 (6 months) 
 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Solution Consulting team led by Jonathan D'Elissagaray, Director of Solution Consulting. The team consists of two Solution Consultants focused on Mirakl Connect, working alongside four Platform Consultants covering B2B customers across Southern Europe and the Middle East. Together, you'll be helping sellers successfully onboard and grow through the Mirakl Connect ecosystem.
 
About Mirakl Connect
Mirakl Connect is Mirakl's ecosystem platform, connecting marketplace operators and sellers to simplify partnerships, onboarding, and growth. Trusted by leading brands such as Macy's and Lacoste, Mirakl Connect helps sellers discover new marketplace opportunities while enabling marketplace teams to efficiently onboard and manage their seller ecosystem at scale.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Support and progressively take ownership of end-to-end seller onboarding on Mirakl Connect, starting with simpler cases and building towards greater autonomy.
  • Guide sellers through key onboarding steps and deliver clear enablement sessions tailored to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.
  • Develop expertise in Catalog Transformer — Mirakl's AI-based catalogue management product — and support sellers in troubleshooting and optimising their catalogues.
  • Contribute to scaling onboarding by creating and improving documentation, guides, and internal content, and by identifying opportunities for process and reporting automation.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Data Science/AI teams, capturing feedback from onboarding activities to continuously improve the seller experience.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently enrolled in a Master's programme (M1 or M2) at a business school, engineering school, or equivalent institution, available for a six-month internship from January 2027
  • At least one previous internship or corporate experience, ideally in an enterprise environment
  • Demonstrated interest in technology, SaaS platforms, or digital products
  • Familiarity with APIs, data, or automation tools is a plus but not required
Skills:
  • Autonomous and solution-oriented, with solid project management skills and the ability to see tasks through from start to finish
  • Strong communication and teaching skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in AI and a willingness to use it practically, including for troubleshooting AI-based products
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable working in English across an international, cross-functional team
 

4. Tools Used

  • Mirakl Connect
  • Salesforce
  • Gong
  • Google Workspace (Sheets, Slides, Drive)
  • Confluence
  • Dust
  • Catalog Transformer
 

5. Languages

  • English: Professional proficiency required
  • French: Professional proficiency is a plus
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month (depending on profile and study level)
Perks & Benefits:
  • A workplace that promotes well-being and balance: breakfasts, yoga and sports classes, after-work drinks, and game nights
  • A tailor-made onboarding experience designed to help you hit the ground running
  • A unique opportunity to join a fast-growing French unicorn and collaborate with international teams
  • Access to CSE discounts (ticketing, cultural activities, and more)
  • Gymlib pass to support your well-being
  • Modern offices in the heart of Paris
  • Swile meal vouchers
  • 50% coverage of transportation costs (Navigo pass, bike, and more)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. 30-minute Talent Acquisition interview with Heather Decoudun
  3. Interview with Jonathan D'Elissagaray, Director of Solution Consulting
  4. Values interview with a trained Mirakl interviewer

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

  • Good methodology to deal with inbound leads

  • Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients

  • Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature

  • The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike

  • Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities

  • Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus

Optional

  • You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs

  • Knowledge of the open-software landscape

  • Languages other than English and French are considered a plus

  • Start-up experience

  • Experience with Hubspot

Soft Skills

  • You are a confident and polished communicator able to build strong and lasting relationships

  • You are autonomous, do not hesitate to share new ideas with the team, and are genuinely interested in learning your customer's needs

  • You are located in a +/- 6h from CEST Timezone

Why join CrowdSec?

  • You want to take part in an adventure with a bleeding edge tech startup

  • Work with a team of blackbelt pros in their fields and interact with an exciting community

  • You are driven and energetic, with a passion for prospecting and driving pipeline

  • We are a full-remote company, we meet twice a year to strengthen the team spirit during a 1-week seminar.
