jobs.title: Kok
jobs.description:
De smaakmaker achter warme, kwaliteitsvolle maaltijdzorg

Als kok draag je elke dag bij aan smakelijke, veilige en kwaliteitsvolle maaltijden voor onze bewoners en gebruikers. Je zorgt mee voor een correcte bereiding, portionering en presentatie van maaltijden en bewaakt daarbij de afspraken rond hygiëne, veiligheid, diëten en HACCP.

Vanuit jouw vakkennis werk je nauw samen met collega’s binnen het keukenteam. Je ondersteunt medewerkers, volgt procedures correct op en draagt mee zorg voor een warme maaltijdbeleving waarin kwaliteit, veiligheid en respect centraal staan.

  • Je bereidt kwaliteitsvolle, veilige en smakelijke maaltijden en zorgt voor een correcte portionering, presentatie, regeneratie en bedeling.
  • Je volgt afspraken rond HACCP, hygiëne, veiligheid, onderhoud en voedselbewaring nauwgezet op en zorgt voor correcte registraties.
  • Je controleert leveringen, plaatst bestellingen in overleg en bewaakt een ordelijke en kwaliteitsvolle voorraadwerking.
  • Je staat in voor een goede planning zodat de continuïteit van de dienst gegarandeerd blijft.
  • Je ondersteunt keukenmedewerkers in de dagelijkse werking en sensibiliseert hen rond kwaliteit, hygiëne en veilig werken en staat in voor hun opvolging en coaching.
  • Je draagt mee zorg voor een nette, veilige en efficiënte keukenomgeving zodat bewoners en gebruikers kunnen rekenen op warme maaltijdzorg.

Wat maakt werken bij ons bijzonder?
• Je maakt elke dag mee het verschil met maaltijden die bewoners en gebruikers comfort, 
   smaak en zorg bieden.
• Je werkt in een betrokken keukenteam waar kwaliteit, samenwerking en hygiëne centraal
   staan.
• Je krijgt een afwisselende functie waarin koken, organiseren, opvolgen en ondersteunen
   samenkomen.
• Je draagt bij aan een warme maaltijdbeleving binnen een zorgorganisatie met aandacht
   voor mensen.

📍 Momenteel zoeken we een kok in: 

Centrale keuken Sint-Niklaas– voltijds (38u/week)
  
  

Wie zoeken we?

Een kok die graag kwaliteitsvol kookt, zorgvuldig werkt en oog heeft voor bewoners, gebruikers en collega’s. Je voelt je thuis in een grootkeukenomgeving, volgt afspraken rond voedselveiligheid nauwgezet op en haalt voldoening uit samenwerken aan smakelijke en veilige maaltijden.

Jouw competenties maken het verschil

We zoeken een kok die:

  • samenwerken belangrijk vindt en informatie deelt om samen met collega’s tot een goed resultaat te komen.
  • initiatief neemt, zelfstandig aan de slag gaat en actief oplossingen zoekt wanneer de werking of kwaliteit onder druk komt te staan.
  • klantgericht werkt met aandacht voor vragen en noden van bewoners, familie en collega’s.
  • betrouwbaar is, afspraken nakomt en procedures correct, eerlijk en consequent toepast.
  • veilig werkt volgens hygiëne- en veiligheidsvoorschriften en materialen, producten en machines correct gebruikt.
  • zorgvuldig werkt met aandacht voor nauwkeurigheid, orde, kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid.
  • resultaatgericht handelt en afspraken opvolgt met aandacht voor kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid.
  • kennis deelt en collega’s ondersteunt bij het correct uitvoeren van taken.
  • flexibel blijft zoeken naar werkbare oplossingen wanneer omstandigheden wijzigen.
  • stressbestendig blijft rustig en efficiënt functioneren bij drukte, wijzigingen of onverwachte situaties.

Jouw sleutel tot deze job?

  • Je hebt een diploma secundair onderwijs in de richting kok, of een diploma secundair onderwijs en relevante ervaring in een grootkeuken
  • Je hebt kennis van de juiste (kook)technieken voor het bereiden van producten.
  • Je hebt voldoende kennis van HACCP-regelgeving en past hygiëne- en veiligheidsafspraken consequent toe.
  • Je hebt kennis van allergenen en diëten om maaltijden correct te kunnen bereiden en serveren.
  • Je beschikt over productkennis, met aandacht voor bereiding en bewaarvoorschriften.
  • Je kan medewerkers aansturen, coachen en ondersteunen in de dagelijkse keukenwerking.
  • Je hebt basiskennis van informaticatoepassingen en een goede kennis van het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

jobs.title: Logistiek medewerker
jobs.description:
Maak elke dag mee het verschil achter de schermen én op de afdeling

Als logistiek medewerker in een woonzorgcentrum van Zorgpunt Waasland ondersteun je de dagelijkse werking van de afdeling. Je helpt onder meer bij maaltijden en dranken, houdt kamers en leefruimtes mee ordelijk, vult materialen en voorraden aan en neemt huishoudelijke, logistieke en eenvoudige administratieve taken op.

Je ondersteunt bewoners zonder slikproblemen bij eten en drinken, begeleidt hen waar nodig bij praktische verplaatsingen en helpt zorgmedewerkers bij taken zoals bedden opmaken, intern transport en het gebruiksklaar houden van materiaal. Daarbij werk je steeds zorgvuldig volgens de afspraken rond hygiëne, veiligheid en comfort.

Je merkt praktische noden, tekorten of bijzonderheden snel op en geeft die tijdig door aan de verantwoordelijke of het zorgteam. Zo krijgen zorgkundigen en verpleegkundigen meer ruimte om zich te richten op zorg en nabijheid.

Met jouw zorgvuldigheid, behulpzaamheid en warme aanpak draag je elke dag bij aan het comfort, welzijn en de leefkwaliteit van bewoners.

Wat maakt werken bij ons bijzonder?

  • Je bent een belangrijke schakel in het dagelijkse woon- en leefcomfort van bewoners.
  • Je ondersteunt zorgteams zodat zij zich maximaal kunnen richten op zorg en nabijheid.
  • Je werkt in een warme omgeving waar samenwerking, respect en zorgzaamheid centraal staan.
  • Je ziet snel resultaat van je werk: nette ruimtes, aangevulde materialen en tevreden bewoners.
  • Je krijgt een afwisselende job met veel contact met bewoners en collega’s.

Je werkt  in een ploegensysteem met weekenddiensten.

Momenteel beschikken we over de volgende plaats: 

contract onbepaalde duur in WZC De Notelaar - Beveren : werkbreuk 19u/week

Wie zoeken we?

Een betrokken en praktische collega die graag ondersteunt waar nodig en oog heeft voor bewoners, collega’s en de dagelijkse werking van de afdeling.

  • Je werkt graag praktisch en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
  • Je hebt aandacht voor orde, netheid, hygiëne en veiligheid.
  • Je gaat respectvol, vriendelijk en discreet om met bewoners en collega’s.
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken, maar vindt samenwerken minstens even belangrijk.
  • Je blijft rustig wanneer het druk is en kan vlot schakelen tussen verschillende taken.

Jouw competenties maken het verschil

We zoeken een logistiek medewerker die:

  • constructief samenwerkt met zorgkundigen, verpleegkundigen en andere collega’s.
  • klantgericht omgaat met bewoners, met respect voor hun comfort, gewoontes en persoonlijke bezittingen.
  • initiatief neemt en praktische noden, tekorten of verbeterpunten tijdig opmerkt.
  • organisatiebewust werkt en taken afstemt op de dagindeling en prioriteiten van het team.
  • met inlevingsvermogen rekening houdt met de beleving, gewoontes en mogelijkheden van bewoners.
  • flexibel inspeelt op wisselende prioriteiten en onverwachte vragen.

jobs.title: Responsable Comptable Process & outils - CDI (H/F/X)
jobs.description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Nous recherchons un Responsable Comptable Process & Outils passionné, prêt à transformer nos opérations comptables au sein de notre équipe. Ce rôle stratégique combine une expertise comptable pointue avec des compétences en gestion de projet et en leadership, afin de piloter l'optimisation et la fiabilisation de nos processus et outils, notamment sur les périmètres de la comptabilité fournisseurs (BP et IP) et des stocks.


🎯 MISSIONS

En tant que pilier de l'amélioration continue, vous serez au cœur de l'évolution de nos pratiques comptables. Vos responsabilités principales incluront :

Activité 1 : Pilotage de Projets Process & Outils

  • Concevoir et déployer une feuille de route ambitieuse pour les projets d'optimisation, en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Tech. ; que ce soit dans le développement de nos outils, comme dans  l’intégration de l’IA dans nos process

  • Analyser les besoins, définir les processus cibles et mener l'automatisation des flux pour une efficacité maximale.

  • Diriger en autonomie les projets d'évolution et de développement de nos outils comptables, en alignement avec les objectifs de la Direction Financière.

    • Activité 2 :Optimisation et Fiabilisation des Processus Comptables 

  • Identifier et analyser les pistes d'amélioration, en proposant des solutions innovantes (IA ou développement d’outils)

  • Garantir la bonne application des process et booster la performance des équipes grâce à des flux optimisés.

  • Mettre en place des outils ou solutions garantissant l'application rigoureuse des procédures et schémas comptables en vigueur dans le département.

  • Être le référent clé pour les audits internes et externes, garantissant une conformité irréprochable.

    • Activité 3:  Management et développement de l’équipe 

  • Manager, animer et faire grandir une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement du changement, à la formation et au support fonctionnel.

  • Développer les compétences de vos collaborateurs à travers la formation et une montée en puissance structurée.

  • Mettre en place et suivre des reportings et des KPI comptables pertinents pour une visibilité complète de l'activité.

    • Activité 4 : Support, Conformité et Qualité

  • Mettre à jour et diffuser les modes opératoires et supports, assurant une base de connaissances à jour.

  • Assurer la formation et le support quotidien des équipes (présentiel et à distance) pour une autonomie renforcée.

  • Formaliser et implémenter des contrôles opérationnels (RIB, PO, etc.) et les schémas comptables.

  • Définir et superviser les actions correctives nécessaires suite aux contrôles ou audits.


    • 👉 PRÉ REQUIS

    Formation & Expérience :

  • Diplôme supérieur en Comptabilité (BAC+2 minimum), socle indispensable de votre expertise.
  • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en comptabilité, dont une première expérience managériale où vous avez déjà démontré votre capacité à encadrer et inspirer.

  • Communicant hors pair, doté d'une forte aisance relationnelle et de qualités pédagogiques avérées pour transmettre et fédérer.
  • Curieux, organisé, rigoureux et respectueux des délais, vous excellez dans la gestion proactive de vos missions.

  • Share business objectives and inputs with UX and data teams to improve algorithm personalization and member experience

  • Help guarantee operational excellence in the member experience and contribute to developing corrective actions or new ideas to improve related performance

  • Analyze project performance and propose action plans to optimize KPIs

    •  

  • Data expertise: You use data to develop and improve our B2C strategy

  • Collaboration with other teams:  You collaborate and communicate with key stakeholders on your topics across teams & B2C countries

  • Collaborate closely with the CRM team to align CRM and B2C objectives and execution in the “B2C campaigns”

jobs.title: Förskollärare
jobs.description:
Sävsjö kommun är en liten kommun där det finns stora möjligheter att växa. I den lilla kommunen är det nära mellan människor – mellan dig och dina kollegor och mellan medarbetare och chefer. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att ge våra invånare bästa möjliga service och i våra team får du chans att ta plats, utvecklas och bidra.      



9 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som förskollärare kommer du finnas i barnens vardag och vara en del i vad som formar Sveriges nästa generation genom att du coachar, utmanar och lyssnar in barnets behov. Du kan se och ta vara på unga individers olikheter och talanger. Utifrån förskolans läroplan och andra styrdokument förväntas du arbeta systematiskt för att förskolan ska vara en trygg, rolig och en lärorik plats för varje barn. Du har ett särskilt pedagogiskt ansvar för att planera arbetet, genomföra, dokumentera, utvärdera och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med arbetslaget. Du har förmåga att bygga vidare på barnens upptäckter och erfarenheter. Du utvecklar och förnyar arbetssättet utifrån barnens behov och intressen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har utbildning och legitimation som förskollärare.

Som person är du trygg och tar aktivt initiativ i sociala sammanhang. Du har lätt för att skapa nya relationer och bibehålla kontakterna. Du har en god relation till kollegor och andra personer du kommer i kontakt med på arbetsplatsen. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Enligt skollagen krävs legitimation för tillsvidareanställning. För att få arbeta med barn och unga måste du enligt lag visa upp ett utdrag från belastningsregistret.

Löpande urval kan komma att ske så skicka in din ansökan snarast.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-01-01  Eller enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Schema.

Tillsvidareanställda medarbetare i Sävsjö kommun är  krigsplacerade på sin ordinarie arbetsplats.

I händelse av höjd beredskap, krigsfara eller krig ska medarbetaren  komma till sin ordinarie arbetsplats.

Arbetsgivaren har rätt att omplacera medarbetare till en annan arbetsplats inom Sävsjö kommuns organisation om behov skulle uppstå.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Counter Sales Agent – Europcar

jobs.description:
Vi søker en fleksibel og serviceinnstilt Counter Sales Agent til Europcar.

Stillingen passer for deg som liker å jobbe med mennesker, yte god kundeservice og trives med en variert arbeidshverdag. Arbeidet innebærer både kundekontakt, utleie av biler og oppfølging av skader og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til bilutleie.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utleie og innlevering av biler

  • Kundebehandling og veiledning av kunder

  • Håndtering av reservasjoner og utleiekontrakter

  • Kontroll av biler ved ut- og innlevering

  • Gjennomføring av skadekontroller (skadesjekk)

  • Registrering og oppfølging av skader

  • Dialog med kunder i forbindelse med skader og eventuelle skadekrav

  • Besvare telefoner og e-poster

  • Oppfølging av kunder før, under og etter leieperioden

  • Klargjøring og oppfølging av biler i forbindelse med utleie

  • Andre forefallende oppgaver knyttet til den daglige driften av bilutleien

Arbeidstid

Dette er en tilkallingsstilling / arbeid på telefon.

  • Fast arbeidstid er annenhver søndag

  • Utover dette vil du bli kontaktet ved behov, blant annet ved sykdom eller andre situasjoner hvor det er behov for ekstra bemanning

  • Det er derfor viktig at du er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille på kort varsel

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner og liker å jobbe med kunder

  • Er serviceinnstilt, løsningsorientert og ansvarsbevisst

  • Er fleksibel og kan stille på kort varsel ved behov

  • Arbeider strukturert og nøyaktig

  • Har gode IT-kunnskaper og behersker Microsoft Word, Excel og andre vanlige dataverktøy

  • Har gode kunnskaper i engelsk -- dette er et krav

  • Har førerkort klasse B -- dette er et krav

  • Erfaring fra bilutleie, kundeservice, salg eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav

Vi tilbyr

  • En variert og praktisk jobb i bilutleiebransjen

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Mulighet for ekstra arbeid ved behov

  • Et hyggelig og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

PHD IN ADVANCING SAFE AND SUSTAINABLE BY DESIGN (SSBD) ASSESSMENT OF NOVEL BIO-BASED POLYMERS: INTEGRATION OF NEW APPROACH METHODOLOGIES AND COMPUTATIONAL MODELLING FOR SAFETY ASSESSMENT (m/f)

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 Months (14 +22+12 )
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Dělník dokončovny, Obsluha strojů na výrobu a zpracování výrobků z plastu
jobs.description:
Hledáme šikovného kolegu na pozici Dělník dokončovny.

CO VÁS ČEKÁ?

.. Balení laminátových výrobků: vaší hlavní náplní práce bude pečlivé balení laminátových výrobků podle schváleného balicího předpisu. Správné zabalení je klíčové pro ochranu výrobků a zajištění jejich bezpečné manipulace i expedice.

.. Finalizace laminátových výrobků: budete provádět dokončovací operace spojené s finalizací výrobků. Důraz bude kladen na preciznost, pečlivé provedení a dodržení stanovených postupů, aby každý kus splňoval požadované kvalitativní standardy.

. Plnění výrobního plánu: vaše práce bude klíčová pro včasné splnění výrobních cílů. Díky vaší pečlivosti a odpovědnému přístupu bude výroba probíhat plynule a efektivně.

.. Dodržování technické dokumentace: při práci budete používat přesně předepsané přípravky podle technické dokumentace, což zajistí optimální technologické postupy.

. Samokontrola: budete pravidelně kontrolovat svou práci, aby kvalita odpovídala požadovaným standardům. Váš cit pro detail přispěje k bezchybnému výrobnímu procesu.

CO OD VÁS OČEKÁME?

.. Manuální zručnost a fyzická zdatnost: máte šikovné ruce, sílu a chuť pracovat? U nás se vaše dovednosti a preciznost opravdu uplatní! (Bohužel, práce je s těžkými břemeny a tak není vhodná pro ženy.)

.. Zkušenosti s broušením – výhoda, ne podmínka: pokud máte zkušenosti s broušením, leštěním nebo kytováním, skvělé! Ale pokud ne, nezoufejte – rádi vás zaučíme přímo na místě. Stačí mít praxi s manuální prací ve výrobě.

.. Ochota učit se a rozvíjet dovednosti: máte otevřenou mysl, chuť osvojit si nové techniky a postupy? Každý den se můžete naučit něco nového.

. Práce na plný úvazek

Závodní stravování, roční prémie, poskytování nealkoholických nápojů ke spotřebě na pracovišti, volnočasové poukázky v hodnotě 1.000,-Kč, poukázky na nákup pracího prášku, příspěvek na dopravu, po třech letech 25 dní dovolené

Stačí zavolat na tel. +420 703 194 520 nebo poslat životopis na  michaela.matejskova@compositecomponents.eu a domluvíme se na pohovor

Náplň práce
•    řízení a rozvoj systému managementu kvality dle ISO 9001,
•    vedení pracovníků oddělení kvality – kontroloři kvality a referent kvality,
•    nastavování a kontrola pravidel vstupní, mezioperační a výstupní kontroly,
•    sledování a vyhodnocování kvality výrobků, procesů a dodávaných materiálů,
•    řešení neshod, zmetkovitosti, oprav a nákladů na nekvalitu,
•    řízení zákaznických a dodavatelských reklamací,
•    komunikace se zákazníky a dodavateli v oblasti kvality,
•    analýza příčin problémů a zavádění nápravných a preventivních opatření,
•    příprava a provádění interních auditů,
•    příprava společnosti na zákaznické a certifikační audity,
•    řízení měřidel, jejich evidence, kalibrace a ověřování,
•    spolupráce při zavádění nových výrobků, technologií a výrobních procesů,
•    tvorba a aktualizace směrnic, pracovních postupů, kontrolních plánů a formulářů,
•    školení zaměstnanců v oblasti kvality,
•    pravidelné vyhodnocování ukazatelů kvality a reporting vedení společnosti,
•    návrhy a realizace projektů zaměřených na zvyšování kvality a snižování nákladů na nekvalitu,
•    úzká spolupráce s výrobou, technologií, konstrukcí, nákupem, logistikou a obchodem.
Vaší pravomocí bude
•    zastavit výrobu nebo expedici při zjištění závažné neshody,
•    blokovat neshodný materiál, polotovar nebo hotový výrobek,
•    požadovat zavedení nápravných opatření,
•    rozhodovat o provedení mimořádných či rozšířených kontrol,
•    svolávat jednání k řešení reklamací a závažných neshod,
•    navrhovat změny výrobních, kontrolních a organizačních postupů,
•    zastupovat společnost při jednáních se zákazníky, dodavateli a certifikačními orgány v oblasti kvality.

•    minimálně SŠ vzdělání technického směru, VŠ vzdělání výhodou,
•    alespoň 3 roky praxe v oblasti řízení kvality ve výrobní společnosti,
•    zkušenost s vedením zaměstnanců výhodou,
•    zkušenost s interními audity a řešením zákaznických reklamací,

- práce s plastovými materiály

- po zapracování možnost výjimečných servisních výjezdů v blízkém okolí
Hlavní náplní práce je výroba bazénů v naší dílně. Nejedná se o pozici s pravidelným cestováním.
👤 Koho hledáme?
- manuálně zručného člověka
- někoho, kdo má chuť pracovat a učit se nové věci
- technické myšlení je výhodou
- spolehlivost a zodpovědnost
- schopnost pracovat samostatně i v týmu
- pečlivost a smysl pro dobře odvedenou práci
- kladný vztah k práci s nářadím a materiály
- ochotu pracovat ve výrobě
Zkušenosti s výrobou bazénů nejsou podmínkou. Výhodou jsou zkušenosti s prací s plasty, svařováním nebo jinou technickou či řemeslnou výrobou.

35 000–50 000 Kč
- práci na HPP
- stabilní zaměstnání v české rodinné firmě
- jednosměnný provoz
- práci převážně v jedné provozovně v Ratíškovicích

- dlouhodobé pracovní uplatnění
- nástup dle dohody
Hledáme šikovného člověka, kterého můžeme naučit řemeslo

Na této pozici můžete získat zkušenosti s výrobou polypropylenových bazénů a postupně se stát samostatným odborníkem ve svém oboru.

Náborový příspěvek 50 000 Kč

jobs.title: Technik / technička kolejových vozidel, Strojírenští technici přístrojů, strojů a zařízení
jobs.description:
První kontakt: e-mailem nebo telefonicky

Jste nadšenci do železnice a vlaků? Chcete být součástí železniční dopravy?
Do našeho týmu hledáme nového kolegu nebo kolegyni, kteří nám pomohou maximálně využít možnosti provozu, techniky a údržby a zajistit tak špičkový servis pro náš vozový park. Přidejte se k nám. Zajímá vás více?

Co Vás na této pozici čeká?
•Technická správa vozového parku železničních kolejových vozidel.
•Přejímky vozů po opravách a Technických kontrolách.
•Přejímky vozů do a z pronájmu.
•Řešení technických záležitostí k evidenci vozového parku v pronájmu.
•Zadávání technických podkladů a rozsahu pro provádění oprav a Technických kontrol.
•Technická specifikace a zajišťování náhradních dílů potřebných pro opravy vozů.
•Zadávat podklady pro fakturace pronájmů, oprav nebo obchodu s náhradními díly.
•Drobné opravy vozového parku v rámci ECM.
•Spolupráce s opravnami, dodavateli a zákazníky.

Požadavky z naší strany
•Střední vzdělání technického směru (výhodou maturita).
•Zkušenosti s výrobou nebo údržbou kolejových vozidel, nejste v oboru nováčkem.
•Orientace ve výkresové dokumentaci.
•Platný řidičský průkaz sk. B a aktivní řízení vozidla.
•Dobrá práce s počítačem.
•Znalost cizího jazyka (angličtina, případně němčina).
•Ochota cestovat v rámci ČR, případně Evropy.
•Samostatnost, pečlivost, trpělivost, zodpovědnost a schopnost organizovat si čas a určovat priority.

Zaujali jsme Vás?
Pošlete nám svůj strukturovaný životopis na email: zemanova@lokotrans.cz nebo volejte na 547250176.

jobs.title: Clinical Lead
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced clinical development professional looking for the opportunity to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated compound?

We are looking for a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central part in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics and other cross-functional partners to ensure that the clinical program is scientifically robust, operationally feasible and aligned with the compound’s development objectives. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities
The Clinical Development Lead is the expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:
•Lead the Clinical Team at project level and provide clear scientific direction, alignment and guidance across the clinical program; may include line management responsibility.
•Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Drive the clinical component of the development program in close partnership with global line functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear priorities and timely delivery.
•Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.
•Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.
•Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.
•Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.
•Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.
•Represent the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and contribute to the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements
•Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc or equivalent.
•At least seven years of relevant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
•Proven experience contributing to the planning, execution, reporting and publication of Phase II to IV clinical trials in a global, cross-functional and matrix environment.
•Demonstrated experience leading clinical projects or substantial clinical development workstreams through to completion.
•Strong experience in the preparation of clinical and regulatory documentation, including Investigator’s Brochures, protocols, briefing books, clinical study reports, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Experience supporting regulatory submissions, such as INDs, NDAs and MAAs, and contributing to interactions with Health Authorities, including pre-IND, pre-NDA, end-of-Phase II and SAWP/CHMP meetings.
•Excellent understanding of global drug development, from first-in-human studies through post-approval activities.
•Strong knowledge of clinical trial design methodology and statistics applied to clinical research.
•Ability to interpret and integrate preclinical, translational and clinical data into clinical trial design and development planning.

**Salary:** competitive

**Hours:** Full\-time (100%), 42 hours per week (standard office hours, with some flexibility of commute), unlimited employment

**Start Date:** Now

If you’re motivated by meaningful work, strong customer relationships, and continuous learning, this role is for you. Help deliver technology that makes a real difference in public safety while building trusted relationships with key customers across Switzerland.

**Company Overview:**

Buddi is a fast\-paced, high\-growth UK based technology company that is a global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment to the Criminal Justice Sector around the world.

Buddi has a long\-standing contract for its supply within Switzerland, and this is managed from our office in Lausanne.

Buddi has hubs, such as we have in **Lausanne, Switzerland** in many other parts of the world where that is necessary and improves the quality of our delivery and customer support.

Buddi’s parent company, Big Technologies PLC, is listed on the UK stock market and provides the financial resources and stability for the company to expand the supply of the equipment to new areas. Europe is a particular area for such expansion.

**Role Overview:**

As the **Operations Specialist**, you will join a small team in Lausanne and support our contract delivery within Switzerland. You may also support our wider operations in the region. Some flexibility with partially working remotely.

Fluency, written and verbal, in English language and either German, French or Italian is a necessary requirement to support our Cantonal customers in Switzerland. Any other languages, at any level, would be beneficial though not essential.

From the Lausanne office you will manage the stock of equipment, including in country logistic supply via the postal service and provide the first line of direct customer support, whether through telephone or email engagement.

Alongside the day\-to\-day operations conducted from the office there will be a necessity for some travel to customer offices within Switzerland, specifically those that are German or French speaking, for face\-to\-face meetings and delivery of some training relating to the equipment and software. Training will predominantly be supplied in Lausanne however it may also be preferable to attend Buddi’s UK office occasionally.

You will help in identifying and nurturing good practice, helping maintain strong customer relationships, and ensuring we meet and exceed our service delivery standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide operational support to help customers meet their Electronic Monitoring (EM) objectives, including timely and accurate equipment deliveries and technical advice.
* Support the delivery of training and knowledge sharing sessions, both upon request and by identifying areas for improvement.
* Support the completion of contractual obligations, such as the management of SLAs, KPIs, and the delivery of regular performance reports.
* Participate in regular account management meetings, capturing customer feedback and driving continuous service enhancements.
* Contribute to wider business development activities including supporting new customer implementations.


**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* Fluency in English and either German, French or Italian.
* A proactive, positive attitude with a passion for customer support and personal development.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick learner with the ability to understand and then explain Buddi’s products and services.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly in billing and data accuracy.
* Competency with office\-based IT tools and software ( Microsoft Office suite)
* Eligibility to work in Switzerland.


**Desirable Skills:**

* Previous experience in direct customer communication.


**Additional Information:**

* Buddi supplies its equipment to criminal justice agencies, therefore data security, confidentiality and security vetting are contractual necessities.
* Willingness to achieve any available high\-level security vetting is required.
* Compliance with all data security and confidentiality requirements, whether from Buddi or our customers, is a necessity.

*  Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining brand standards.
*  Effective communication, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.

Financial Analyst \& AI Engineer
================================

**Merion Swiss Partners SA**

Geneva, Switzerland

### **About us**

Founded in Geneva in 2019, Merion is an independent, FINMA\-regulated wealth management firm. We provide bespoke portfolio management built on independence, transparency, collaboration, and stability.

We are seeking a high\-potential, entry\-level / junior professional to design and implement next\-generation automated management tools within our existing framework, as well as to contribute to financial and investment analysis, research, and the development of the Company’s internal analytical tools.

### **Innovation \& Artificial Intelligence**

* Privacy\-First Local AI Engine: A 100% offline, local AI assistant that securely parses PDFs, conducts smart searches across internal files, and summarizes news sentiment without data leaks.
* Internet mitigation tool: develop a KYC AI tool that groups internet and AI searches in various languages and alphabets (Latin and Cyrillic).
* Contribute to the adoption of AI and automation capabilities across research workflows.
* Company’s visibility via AI: improve the Company’s visibility in the field of Wealth and Investment Management on Google and via AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.


### **Research Tools \& Analytics**

**Proprietary solution for Equities and Bonds**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database that automates pipeline tracking from multiple sources within the Company’s internal investment universe.
* Build a screening and data solution based on the database that returns data such as daily prices, stops and targets based on technical analysis and/or sentiment, news, descriptions (EN/FR), investment or disinvestment rationales, ratings, and default risks.
* Automate data collection to support financial research activities.
* Transform the solution into an end\-user interface technology.
* Work closely with end users to understand their needs and continuously improve the solution.


**Proprietary solution for Structured Products**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database for Structured Products and their underlyings.
* Screen underlyings and return a live one\-page format with key information, P\&L, probabilities of autocall or an unfavorable scenario, and issuer default risk.


### **Financial Analyst**

* Analyze and challenge the data resulting from the Analysis Database, especially in relation to purchase and sale signals or recommendations, and potentially mitigate associated risks. Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and accessibility across the research platform.
* Investment research: evaluate emerging technologies relevant to financial research and data analysis.
* Modular Portfolio Dashboard: an interactive desktop interface (Streamlit) to build portfolio profiles, enforce rules, brackets, currencies, markets, etc., and run backtests based on the Company’s universe.
* Support the assessment of investment opportunities through fundamental and quantitative analysis, including financial ratios, historical performance, risk factors and market data.
* Use Python, SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to automate financial analysis, reporting and recurring investment\-monitoring processes.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Company’s internal financial research methodologies, analytical models and investment\-monitoring framework.


### **Office Support**

* Translation of internal and sensitive documents from EN to RU.
* Support to the Company’s Business Introducers via KYCs, KYTs and FINMA standards (RU / FR / EN).
* Possibility to develop the Company’s clientele.
* Handle the Company’s website.


### **Your profile**

**Financial \& Investment Analysis**

* Ability to combine financial reasoning with quantitative and data\-driven approaches and to translate analytical results into clear conclusions for investment professionals.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to work with financial and market data from multiple sources.


**Data \& Programming**

* Financial Scraping \& Data Retrieval: proven experience in financial web scraping (Beautiful Soup, Selenium) and automated daily data parsing into local Excel/SQL environments.
* Tool Implementation \& Interfaces: hands\-on experience implementing functional desktop control panels and UI analytics tools using Python (Pandas, NumPy) and frameworks such as Streamlit.
* Quant Modeling: constrained portfolio optimization, multi\-currency conversions, and historical backtesting metrics, including Sharpe ratio and volatility. Prior experience supporting quantitative asset pricing or empirical risk factor research is highly valued.
* Local AI/NLP: implementation of secure, offline LLMs via LangChain or LlamaIndex to process data entirely on\-site. Specific exposure to building custom text preprocessing, PDF extraction tools, and news sentiment scoring engines is ideal.


**Education**

Master’s degree in Finance or Quantitative Finance (completed or in progress).

**Languages**

Fluent English and Russian.

Good knowledge of French — minimum B1\.

**Job Offer**

Attractive environment.

Home office and flexibility.

Full time.

Immediate entry date or to be discussed.

Are you all in? 't be shy, apply!



Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management
==========================================================================



As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, theClient Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a1\.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity\-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.



In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI's strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward\-looking operating model, driving a culture ofcontinuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI\-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client\-centric and data\-driven approach.



The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank's integrity\-related client lifecycle framework.







  **Key responsibilities:**



**1\. Leadership, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**



* Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
* Establish and maintain a strong, risk\-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI's remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision\-making.
* Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI's area of responsibility.
* Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
* Build and develop a high\-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
* Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.


**2\. Client Onboarding, Integrity\-related Lifecycle Management \& AML Transaction Monitoring**



* Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Oversee integrity\-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event\-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
* Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
* Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high\-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.


**3\. Process Effectiveness, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**



* Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
* Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
* Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity\-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
* a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes.


That’s enough about us – what about you?

We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan.

Position Summary:

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales.


Key position responsibilities:

  • Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation

  • Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.)

  • Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio

  • Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy

  • Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients

  • Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information

  • Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product

  • Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service

  • Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data

  • Perform other special projects or duties when required


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?


Rejoindre notre groupe, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et technologique passionnante : garantir la conformité de nos dispositifs médicaux pour réduire les risques liés aux rayonnements et faire avancer la santé.


Chez nous, rigueur rime avec bonne humeur ! Tu intégreras une équipe à taille humaine, dynamique, accessible et bienveillante, où le travail d'équipe, l'esprit d'entraide et la bonne ambiance sont au centre du quotidien.


Ce que nous t'offrons :

  • La richesse du multi entreprise : 6 marques "entreprises", 6 stades de maturité et des produits et services différents (conseil et expertise, formation, DM et DMDIV) ! Un terrain de jeu idéal si tu aimes la polyvalence, la diversité des sujets et les défis stimulants.

  • Le package : rémunération attractive, tickets resto, prime d’intéressement, comité d’entreprise, 50% de l’abonnement aux transports en commun et/ou location de vélo pour le trajet domicile-siège ...

  • Un programme d’intégration complet : Pour une prise de poste réussie et une vraie politique de développement des compétences.

  • Une ambiance unique reconnue par nos collaborateurs : Entraide, management horizontal, transparence, évènements d’équipe… et bien d’autres éléments nous valent la note de 4/5 sur Glassdoor !

Tes principales missions :
Rattaché(e) au Directeur Assurance Qualité, tu garantis la conformité réglementaire de nos produits et services sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie, tout en contribuant au maintien de notre Système de Management de la Qualité :

Affaires réglementaires & marquage CE :

  • Constituer, mettre à jour et contrôler la conformité des dossiers techniques pour l'obtention et le maintien du marquage CE, ainsi que les enregistrements à l'international (import/export).

  • Administrer la gestion des identifiants produits (UDI) et alimenter les bases de données réglementaires (ex. EUDAMED).

  • Valider la conformité réglementaire des étiquetages, notices d'utilisation et supports promotionnels.

  • Accompagner l'équipe commerciale auprès des distributeurs et gérer les demandes de changement relatives aux dispositifs.

Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) & vigilance :

  • Élaborer, piloter et rédiger les plans et bilans de suivi après commercialisation.

  • Traiter les signalements d'incidents, rédiger les rapports destinés aux autorités de santé et engager les actions correctives face aux réclamations.

Qualité, gestion des risques & amélioration continue :

  • Participer aux analyses de risques liés aux produits et piloter les indicateurs clés (notamment la satisfaction client).

  • Participer ou mener les audits (SMQ et fournisseurs) et suivre les plans d'actions associés.

  • Rédiger et structurer les procédures propres aux affaires réglementaires en étroite collaboration avec l'Assurance Qualité.

Veille réglementaire :

  • Assurer la veille réglementaire et normative (JOUE, ANSM, EMA, FDA...) et diffuser les actualités impactantes au sein de l'entreprise.

    Ta fierté si tu réussis avec nous ?
    Tu contribues directement à l'expansion d'un groupe français innovant en pleine croissance et surtout à la diminution des risques liés aux rayonnements !


Ton profil :

De formation supérieure Bac+5 (Master spécialisé Dispositifs Médicaux, idéalement avec un background en biologie) ou fort(e) de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Affaires Réglementaires / AQ.

Tu maîtrises parfaitement le cadre réglementaire des DM et DMDIV (MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746) ainsi que les normes sectorielles (ISO 13485, ISO 14971 pour la gestion des risques). Doté(e) d’une solide culture scientifique, tu échanges facilement avec les équipes R&D, production et qualité. Tu justifies d’une excellente rigueur rédactionnelle pour structurer et maintenir la documentation technique tout en garantissant une traçabilité sans faille face aux organismes notifiés. Ton anglais professionnel est fluide à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

Analyse, proactivité et organisation te permettent d'évaluer des données complexes, de gérer les priorités et d'anticiper les évolutions normatives grâce à une veille stratégique constante. Pédagogue et diplomate, tu sais vulgariser les exigences réglementaires en interne et échanger avec assurance auprès des autorités de santé.

Au-delà de ta rigueur, c'est ton dynamisme, ton enthousiasme et ton aisance relationnelle qui feront la différence pour faire avancer les projets en équipe. Prêt(e) à relever le défi ?

Si tu cherches un poste stimulant dans un groupe où règne une super ambiance, rejoins-nous vite ! Envoie-nous ta candidature.

jobs.title: Consultant & Account Manager (H/F)
jobs.description:
Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?
 
As a Consultant & Account Manager, your mission is to cultivate and strengthen relationships across our portfolio of clients, including a part of key accounts. You’ll drive value by identifying opportunities for growth through strategic up-sells and cross-sells, directly contributing to moka’s expansion and scalability. Your ultimate goal is to position moka.care as the trusted, go-to partner for all their mental health needs.

Your Responsibilities:
  • Build strong relationships: Develop lasting partnerships with your high-profile clients, including HR and People Directors.
  • Advise and implement solutions: Act as an expert in proposing and leading PSR audits, transformation plans, and mental health roadmaps to ensure our services remain relevant and impactful.
  • Manage your client portfolio proactively: Identify opportunities for improvement, advise clients strategically and develop action plans, using key data and insightful reports.
  • Drive growth through upsells: Regularly pitch new products and services to deliver value while contributing to business growth.
  • Ensure client retention: Lead contract renewals, negotiations, and signatures, striving for 100% client retention.
  • Help us scale: Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Consultants/Account Managers department by optimizing processes and workflows.

    • You’re the ideal person if:
  • Experience & Adaptability: You have min. 3 years of experience in Consulting or Account Management within B2B services, and you’re eager to apply those skills in a fast-paced, growing environment.
  • Bilingual Excellence: You’re fluent in both French and English, with exceptional communication skills that allow you to engage clients effortlessly in both languages.
  • Client-Focused & Organized: You thrive in a client-facing role, are highly organized, and take pride in delivering personalized service to your portfolio of clients.
  • Analytically Strong: Your strong analytical skills empower you to not only deliver insightful reports but also identify opportunities for improvement and growth.
  • Process-Oriented & Tech-Savvy: You have a knack for process optimization and are comfortable navigating technical aspects to solve client challenges efficiently.
  • Calm, Sales-Driven Leader: With a cool head under pressure, you build strong relationships, spot cross-sell and up-sell opportunities, and lead with confidence to add value for both clients and the business.

    • Joining us you will

    • Participate in an entrepreneurial fast-growing adventure and the possibility of having a huge potential for evolution inside moka
    • See the concrete impact of your efforts each day and participate in nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations
    • Grow as a person and learn within a team of great people
    • Be trusted: we hire great talents who lead us to the next level

    We'll take care of you

    • Access to Moka.Care: selfcare, individual & group sessions, and the possibility to test the new features in preview
    • Benefit Fund - May : up to 1500€ net / year (125€ net / month)
    • BSPCE for everyone
    • Work life balance: 60% at the office - 2 days per week or 1 week per month remotely
    • Swile Meal voucher card of 10€/day (restaurants, groceries and food apps)
    • Gymlib for sport & wellness allowance
    • Transportation allowance (50% reimbursed)
    • 7 week holiday policy (& one additional day off per year)

    Interview Process

    • Phone interview 
    • Background Interview
    • A Case study and job focused interview to project yourself in your future day-to-day job
    • And finally a Value fit interview to make sure you’ll feel comfortable at moka
    • Offer and reverse interview
    If needed we organize other informal talks like coffee with the team.
     
    Moka.Care is a disability-friendly company.

jobs.title: Tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:
Vaheldusrikas ja väljakutsuv töö Elva linnas

Tööülesanded: Oled hooliv, vastutustundlik ning hindad meeskonnatööd ja arengut? Siis on see ametikoht Sulle!
Sinu töö eesmärgiks on arendada ja säilitada psüühilise erivajadusega inimeste elukvaliteeti. Selleks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - iseseisvalt elamiseks vajalike oskuste õpetamine; - tööalane nõustamine; - vajadusel arsti külastamine; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine. Kliendiga tehtud töö tuleb dokumenteerida ning see võtab umbes pool tööajast. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms. Teenusel olevatele inimestele väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ja nendel osalemine. Tööle asudes tuleb arvestada, et osa väljaõppest toimub Tartus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Elvas on kokkuhoidev kollektiiv. Kord kuus toimuvad asutuse töökoosolekud Tartus. Uutele töötajatele toimuvad uue töötaja koolitused, kus kõik erialaga seotud teemad detailselt läbi käime. Lisaks on olemas mentori ja kvaliteedijuhi tugi.
Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena. Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja supervisioonid. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vaba päeva võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga. Juhul kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus.
Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida oma vaimset tervist korras. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel.

jobs.title: Seamstress / Seamster and Garment Cutter
jobs.description:
Experienced sewing professional wanted for Estonian clothing brand UMU’s studio

Work tasks: As UMU’s workload grows, we are looking for a skilled sewing professional with garment-cutting skills to join our small team. Your main task will be sewing everyday clothing from start to finish. Each team member makes complete garments independently. This keeps the work varied and gives you the opportunity to see the results of your work and take pride in them.
Your responsibilities will include: • sewing garments independently to a high standard; • covering for the garment cutter when needed (up to 10% of annual working time); • working with industrial sewing, overlock and coverstitch machines; • pressing and finishing garments; • checking the quality of your own work; • keeping your equipment and workspace clean and in good order.

We offer: We want everyone to look forward to coming to work each morning, so every member of the UMU studio team shares responsibility for maintaining a friendly and enjoyable working atmosphere.
We offer: • good pay based on the work completed – gross monthly pay starting from €1,200, with the opportunity to earn more depending on your output; • a cosy, modern workplace in central Tallinn; • quality equipment and comfortable working conditions; • friendly colleagues; • varied work bringing quality Estonian designs to life; • a full-time, permanent employment contract; • the opportunity to be part of the growth of UMU, a successful Estonian clothing brand. We encourage you to apply early, as suitable candidates will be invited to a paid trial day while applications are still open. This gives us a chance to get to know each other and assess your sewing skills, while you get acquainted with our work and studio.

Option to work from home: No

Ta koostab individuaalseid õppekavu ja arenduskavu ning jälgib nende täitmist. Samuti suhtleb regulaarselt lapsevanematega, jagades soovitusi koduseks toetamiseks. - Dokumenteerimine ja aruandlus: Eripedagoog-logopeed peab üksikasjalikku dokumentatsiooni õpilaste progressi kohta, koostab aruandeid tugiteenuste vajaduse ja tulemuslikkuse kohta ning osaleb individuaalse õppekava läbivaatamisel ja uuendamisel. - Keskkonna kohandamine: Ta annab soovitusi füüsilise õpikeskkonna kohandamiseks ja õppematerjalide diferentseerimiseks. Eripedagoog aitab luua kaasavat õhkkonda kogu koolis ning korraldab vajadusel täiendkoolitusi õpetajatele. - Üleminekute toetamine: Eripedagoog-logopeed aitab õpilastel üleminekutel ning teeb koostööd teiste asutustega. Lisaks HEV õpilaste õpetamine; elektroonilise päeviku Stuudiumi täitmine; valmisolek klassijuhatamiseks; osalemine kooli arendustöös. Eripedagoog-logopeed juhindub oma töös õpetaja eetikakoodeksist ning hoiab oma käitumise ja tegevusega kooli mainet.

- tähtajatut töölepingut (kvalifikatsiooni olemasolul); - pikka suvepuhkust; - enesearengu- ja eneseteostusvõimalusi; - võimalust loovalt panustada kooli arendamisse.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Keisarinkotoon!
jobs.description:
Hei sinä lähihoitaja – me etsimme ehkäpä juuri sinua!

**Keisarinkodossa Piikkiössä olisi paikka yhdelle hyvälle tyypille. Voisitko se olla sinä?**

Jos olet lähihoitaja, joka tykkää ihmisistä, vaihtelevista päivistä ja siitä, että töihin on kiva tulla, **jatka lukemista!** Meillä Keisarinkodossa tehdään tärkeää työtä, mutta otsa kurtussa ei tarvitse olla. Arjessa on tilaa **hymyille, huumorille, hyvälle kahville ja onnistumisille** – unohtamatta tietenkään laadukasta ja turvallista hoitotyötä.

Mitä meillä pääset tekemään? Olemaan läsnä, auttamaan, kohtaamaan, kuuntelemaan ja toteuttamaan hyvää arkea yhdessä asukkaidemme kanssa. Työpäivät eivät ole samanlaisia, ja juuri se tekee tästä työstä mielenkiintoista. Joskus tarvitaan ripeyttä, joskus rauhallista kuuntelijaa ja välillä ripaus huumoria. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata heti – **me opetellaan ja autetaan toinen toisiamme.**

Mitä me toivomme sinulta?

- Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja.

- Olet luotettava ja vastuuntuntoinen.

- Kohtaat ihmiset aidosti ja arvostavasti.

- Osaat tehdä töitä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa.

- Sinulla on positiivinen asenne ja mielellään myös **pilkettä silmäkulmassa.**


Ikääntyneiden parissa työskentelyn kokemus on plussaa, mutta **hyvä tyyppi ja oikea asenne painavat vaakakupissa paljon.**

Miksi juuri meille? Koska meillä **työkaveria ei jätetä yksin**. Meillä saa kysyä, oppia, nauraa ja välillä todeta yhdessä, että _"selvittiinpäs tästäkin!"_

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään ja jossa hyvä työ näkyy sekä asukkaiden arjessa että työkavereiden fiiliksessä.

Joko nappasit ajatuksesta kiinni? Jos mietit, että **"tuonne voisin kyllä tulla töihin"**, niin laita hakemus tulemaan! Me odotamme innolla, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun.

**Tervetuloa Keisarinkotoon – meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti:** sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

_P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua._

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

jobs.title: Souschef @ Villa Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Want to be a part of a fantastic adventure? 

Villa Copenhagen is a social scene in Copenhagen allowing the past, present and future to come together in an inspiring, playful and authentic ambiance.

We live by our values - Contrast - Playful - Local. These values form our daily lives at Villa Copenhagen as well as guide us towards our vision of being the best hotel FOR the world.

We are now looking for a trained Souschef for our a la carte kitchen. 

Skills & qualifications needed 

  • Trained chef with 8+ years of experience working in an hotel and/or high end a la carte kitchen 

  • Qualifications for working as a souschef 

  • Leading and Developing  Team 

  • Menu Execution (Developing, Cost control )

  • Fluent in english, speaking and writing

  • Responsible and positive personality

  • Teamplayer with respect for products and colleagues

You identify with the following

You thrive in a high pressure and dynamic environment  ensuring a consistently high level of productivity and operational standards paying particular attention to details. You are a true team player, approachable and have a can-do attitude. You are a Cosmopolitan spirit with a genuine love for Copenhagen and Mother Earth. 

Responsibilities

  • Keeping hygiene and cleaning standards

  • Ordering and control of products from our suppliers

  • Ability to train, motivate and lead staff

  • Running service from A-Z

  • Setting and keeping standards

What we can offer (amongst other things)

  • Pension program with health insurance 

  • 4 free hotel night stays per year within the Strawberry chain (contract higher than 20%) 

  • 25% discount on food & beverages at all our restaurants & bars

  • Staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 200+ hotels

  • Sweet deals on experiences, travels, retail and lots more!

  • The opportunity to grow and develop in an inspiring environment

  • Together with a team of dedicated and passionate people, you have the chance to put your very personal imprint and create a Villa Copenhagen that you - and we - are proud to be part of. A preferred place to work. We come from very different backgrounds and we love how that diversity positively influences our work

Are we the perfect match?

The position is a full-time position, reporting to the Headchef and Executive Chef. 

If you see yourself in the above description, then please don’t hesitate to apply already today and no later than the 25th of October 2026. The position is to start as soon as possible, no later than the start of December. 

For questions, please contact the Executive Chef at christoffer.oberg@villacph.com (no applications) 

Interviews will be held throughout the application period. 

We hire attitude ….and train skills
