jobs.title: Strategic Global Procurement Lead
jobs.description:
At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.



Position Overview

As the Strategic Global Procurement Lead, you will design, implement, and mature our global category management and strategic sourcing framework. You will be reporting directly to the Global Head of Supply Chain & Procurement and oversee a multi-million-euro spend across both direct and indirect spend categories. Your primary mission is two-fold: on the one hand you’ll be initiating and driving short term cost reduction initiatives, both on direct and indirect, and in parallel you’ll be tasked to design, build and implement the future global procurement organization to support our strategic direction. This combination requires a hands-on person that’s able to simplify complex topics, understands what data is needed to drive improvements (and knows how to collect this data when not available) and has experience pitching strategic initiatives to senior leadership. It’s a crucial role in the organization and a unique opportunity to truly make a difference and help to set up our organization for future success.

Key Responsibilities

    

Cost reduction initiatives: initiate, drive and implement cost reduction across direct and indirect spend, teaming up and working with relevant stakeholders within and outside our organization

    

Organization: lead and develop our global procurement team in place today and in parallel design, implement and mature a global procurement organization set to support our strategic direction including the required supporting processes and systems

    

Supplier Database & Lifecycle Management: build, structure, and maintain a centralized global supplier database containing up-to-date contracts, tiered pricing architectures, product/service portfolios, and comprehensive supplier profiles

    

Supplier Risk Assessment & Mitigation: own the end-to-end supplier risk management framework; develop data-driven risk assessment profiles (financial health, operational capacity, geopolitical risks, and compliance) for all key vendors

    

Category Strategy: own and execute long-term global category strategies to optimize cost, quality, and supply continuity

    

Low-Cost Country Sourcing (LCCS): identify, evaluate, and onboard high-potential suppliers to optimize Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

    

Supplier Relationship Management (SRM): govern relationships with critical global suppliers, leading executive business reviews, KPI monitoring, and performance audits

    

Contract Negotiation: lead high-value contract lifecycle management, securing robust commercial terms, IP protection, and medical regulatory compliance

    

Cross-Functional Collaboration: partner with R&D, Quality, and Regulatory teams to seamlessly onboard and qualify new suppliers during New Product Introduction (NPI) phases

What We Are Looking For

    

Education: University degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent.

    

Experience: minimum of 15 years track record in strategic procurement, category management, or global sourcing within a highly regulated sector, including leadership of a global procurement team

    

Data & Database Management: proven experience in building or maturing master data frameworks, supplier information systems, or advanced SRM databases from the ground up

    

Project Management: experience in leading global, cross-functional projects with a proven track-record to deliver on results. Lean Six Sigma experience is considered to be a strong advantage

    

Risk Management Expertise: strong background in creating structured Supplier Risk Assessment profiles, methodologies, and tracking tools (e.g., FMEA, financial health indices)

    

Global Sourcing Expertise: track record of successfully mapping, auditing, and developing new supplier networks in low-cost manufacturing regions (e.g., APAC, Eastern Europe, LATAM)

    

Industry Knowledge & Regulatory Acumen: direct experience in MedTech, Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, or Biotechnology (under frameworks like ISO 13485 or GMP) is highly valued

    

Systems: Highly proficient with global ERP networks (Jeeves/Navision considered a plus), Excel, and modern procurement analytics / BI dashboard methodologies

    

Languages: Full professional proficiency in English. Additional European languages (Spanish, Swedish, or Danish) is considered to be a strong advantage



Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible, the position might be filled before the last application date.

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.

We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Vaasaan
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Vaasan alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Porin alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. - Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. The HVDC Service organisation works with upgrades, service and warranty support for HVDC installations already in operation around the world. In this role you will contribute to the design, implementation and integration of SCADA, control and monitoring systems used in critical power infrastructure.

Background

Hekassa työskentelee lähes 700 asumisen ammattilaista. Suurimmat henkilöstöryhmämme ovat kiinteistöhuolto ja siivous. Heka on savuton työpaikka.

jobs.title: Junior Developer, Intern, or Thesis Worker — Rust and AI Applications
jobs.description:
Advaun Oy develops web applications, AI systems, healthcare and industrial solutions, including our own AI-powered ERP platform for manufacturers.

Were looking for an intern, junior developer or thesis worker to help build our machine vision-based warehouse management solution and our voice AI solution combining speech recognition and large language model (LLM) integration.

**Responsibilities**

- Develop backend services in Rust using axum.

- Build and integrate REST APIs and MQTT messaging.

- Work with PostgreSQL databases and sqlx.

- Develop user interfaces using egui and contribute across the application stack.

- Help integrate machine vision into our warehouse management solution.

- Support speech recognition and LLM integration for our voice AI solution.

- Write and run tests, investigate bugs and verify your own work.

- Contribute to software architecture and explain your technical decisions.


**Requirements**

- Practical Rust programming experience from personal, academic or professional projects.

- Understanding of full stack development and how user interfaces, backend services and databases work together.

- Familiarity with REST APIs, MQTT and relational databases.

- Ability to write code independently, test and debug your own work, and think through software architecture and trade-offs.

- Willingness to learn and contribute to practical AI applications.

- A GitHub profile or equivalent coding portfolio with accessible source code from relevant projects you have worked on.


AI tools can support your work, but you must be able to write code without relying on AI-generated output and understand, explain and validate any code you use.

**Tech Stack**

- **Core:** Rust, axum

- **Data:** PostgreSQL, sqlx

- **APIs and messaging:** REST APIs, MQTT

- **User interfaces:** egui

- **AI applications:** Computer vision, speech recognition, LLM integration

- **Additional language:** Python


**Nice to Have**

- Familiarity with axum, sqlx or egui.

- Knowledge of machine learning and computer vision, such as image recognition or object detection.

- Experience with speech recognition.

- Experience integrating LLMs with application data, APIs or functions.

- Python programming skills.

- Interest in warehouse management, manufacturing or industrial software.


You do not need experience in every area. We welcome students, recent graduates and early-career developers who can demonstrate relevant skills through their projects.

**Thesis Opportunities**

We welcome thesis candidates interested in computer vision for warehouse management, speech recognition, LLM integration or the software architecture supporting these systems.

The thesis topic, scope, development responsibilities and time allocation will be agreed separately, with your educational institution involved as appropriate.

**What We Offer**

- Hands-on involvement in a growing startup.

- Work on real warehouse management, voice AI and industrial software.

- Opportunities to develop your Rust, full stack and AI integration skills.

- A modern technical environment and supportive team culture.

- An office in Helsinki/Espoo.

- Weekly yoga, Monday breakfast, 24/7 gym access and team events.


**Apply**

Send your CV and a short introduction to **https://forms.gle/ZePvbhePi1sMLXh8A**

Include:

- Your availability and whether youre applying for an internship, junior position or thesis opportunity.

- Link to your GitHub profile or equivalent coding portfolio containing relevant source code.

- A brief description of a relevant project: what you built, your own contribution, key technical decisions and how you tested it.

- For thesis applicants: your field of study, proposed topic or area of interest, and expected schedule of graduation.

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til grønne events, kommunikation og koordinering
jobs.description:
Kan du lide at få ting til at ske, koordinere events og samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker? Har du samtidig blik for detaljerne og lyst til at arbejde med den grønne omstilling helt tæt på borgere, kultur- og erhvervsliv? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Klima- og Bæredygtighedsteamet søger en studentermedhjælper ca. 15 timer om ugen. Vi er fire fuldtidsansatte og to studentermedhjælpere, som arbejder bredt med den grønne omstilling på Frederiksberg. Vores opgaver spænder fra udvikling af strategier og politikker til kommunikation, events og aktiviteter sammen med borgere og lokale aktører.

Du bliver en del af et lille team med tæt samarbejde og får mulighed for både at tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver og arbejde sammen med kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Dine opgaver

En stor del af dit arbejde bliver knyttet til planlægning og afvikling af Grønne Dage, Frederiksbergs grønne festival, som i 2027 finder sted fra den 13. til 19. september. Her vil du sammen med en kollega være med til at koordinere festivalen og de mange arrangementer, der skabes i samarbejde med lokale aktører.

Du får blandt andet en vigtig rolle i kontakten til aktørerne og i at sikre, at deres arrangementer kommer godt hele vejen fra idé til færdigt arrangementsopslag. Det betyder, at du skal indsamle og kvalitetssikre information, afklare spørgsmål med aktørerne og sørge for, at arrangementerne bliver oprettet korrekt på vores platforme og løbende opdateret på hjemmesiden.

Der kan være mange arrangementer i proces på samme tid og en del detaljer, der skal falde på plads. Derfor er jobbet også for dig, der kan lide at skabe system i mange informationer, opdager når noget mangler og har tålmodighed til at følge op og få ting helt i mål.

Du kommer også til at:

  • koordinere aktiviteter og arrangementer med lokale aktører og frivillige grønne ildsjæle på Frederiksberg
  • løse kommunikationsopgaver, fx skrive tekster til sociale medier og web samt opdatere vores hjemmeside
  • hjælpe med forskellige praktiske og administrative opgaver i forbindelse med teamets projekter og arrangementer
  • bidrage til andre indsatser under Klimaplan 2025, særligt arbejdet med at engagere borgere, foreninger, uddannelsesinstitutioner, kulturaktører og erhvervsliv i den grønne omstilling.

Arbejdet foregår som udgangspunkt i almindelig arbejdstid, men i forbindelse med arrangementer vil der indimellem være arbejde om aftenen eller i weekenden. 

Hvem er du?

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele fra starten. Til gengæld leder vi efter dig, der er nysgerrig, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx miljø, klima, samfundsvidenskab eller kommunikation og har minimum 1,5 år tilbage af dit studie
  • er detaljeorienteret og trives med opgaver, hvor der er mange informationer, aftaler og deadlines at holde styr på
  • arbejder struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs, også når det kræver et par ekstra afklaringer
  • er imødekommende og har let ved at kommunikere med mange forskellige mennesker
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage initiativ og samtidig spørge om hjælp, når der er brug for det
  • interesserer dig for klima og den grønne omstilling
  • er god til at formulere dig på skrift og kan tilpasse kommunikationen til forskellige målgrupper
  • gerne har et godt visuelt blik og lyst til at arbejde med indhold til sociale medier og web.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos os får du:

  • mulighed for at arbejde konkret med den grønne omstilling i en ambitiøs klimakommune
  • et studiejob med ansvar og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på opgaverne
  • erfaring med eventkoordinering, kommunikation, borgerinddragelse og samarbejde med lokale aktører
  • en bred kontaktflade til både kolleger på tværs af kommunen og foreninger, kulturaktører, virksomheder og andre samarbejdspartnere på Frederiksberg
  • et lille team med høj faglighed, godt samarbejde og plads til nysgerrighed og nye idéer
  • fleksible arbejdstider, hvor du i høj grad kan tilrettelægge dine timer i forhold til dit studie

Ansøgningsfrist

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte Klimakonsulent Siri Astrup på 28984077. Du kan læse mere om Frederiksberg Kommune på vores hjemmeside www.frederiksberg.dk 

Vi ser frem til at modtage en kort ansøgning og CV senest den 17. november. 

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler d. 26 eller 27 november med henblik på opstart i midt januar. 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in collaborative teams and want your work to shape what players experience every day?

As a Backend Developer at Snowprint, you’ll build the backend systems, infrastructure, and tools that power our games. You’ll work closely with your fellow developers, designers, and other disciplines to create stable, scalable solutions, always with the player experience in mind.

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take ownership, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.

What you’ll be doing

You'll bring new game features to life while also supporting the systems, tooling, and infrastructure behind them. The role combines feature development with live operations, giving you the opportunity to work on both player-facing functionality and the technical foundations that keep the game running.

You'll take ownership of the technical areas you work on, from planning and implementation to testing and live operations. A normal week might include feature development, playtests, troubleshooting production issues, discussing technical approaches with the team, and improving systems to support future needs as the game evolves.

You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues to shape technical solutions that work well for both the game and the people building it.

Is this you?

    

You’re an experienced backend developer who is fluent in Kotlin and/or Java and has experience working with live backend services. You’re comfortable operating cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS.

    

You’re comfortable with live operations, including troubleshooting complex production issues and balancing bug fixing and fine-tuning with longer-term improvements and planning.

    

You take ownership of your work and are comfortable working independently while staying connected to the bigger picture. You enjoy solving problems, making decisions, and seeing things through from idea to implementation.

    

You communicate clearly and collaborate well with colleagues across different disciplines. You’re comfortable asking questions, discussing technical approaches, and working through problems together.

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner ‘Mobile game of the year’ and ‘Best strategy game’ 2022

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner 'Best game we are still playing’ 2024 & 2026

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Finalist, ‘Best developer’ 2025

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner, ‘Best updated game’ & ‘Best community’ 2026

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Would you like to build software that real companies use every day?**

CraftLeap is a software company founded in 2023. We develop easy-to-use software, particularly for **production and inventory management**, for companies in the manufacturing industry. Our product is already in active use by companies across Finland – and now we are looking for our first software developer to join us and help build the next stage of CraftLeap.

Our first customer joined us in 2023. We now have **almost 20 customers, with the majority joining us during this year**. Growth has been strong, and new customers are continuously coming in.

This is an exciting stage to join us if you want to have a real impact on a growing product.

What will you be doing?

You will be developing CraftLeap's web-based software together with the founder. Your work will include, for example:

- designing and implementing new features

- developing user interfaces and functionality

- improving and maintaining existing code

- investigating and fixing bugs

- developing the software based on customer needs

- building new integrations and backend services


As the product continues to grow, you will also have the opportunity to influence **what we build and how we build it**.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We are primarily looking for someone who already has experience in software development and is comfortable taking responsibility for their work.

**Developers at the early stages of their careers are also very welcome to apply.** If you are familiar with software development, learn quickly, and are eager to work on a real software product, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Experience with technologies such as these is a plus:

- **JavaScript or TypeScript**

- **React, Angular, Vue or other modern web development**

- web-based application development

- REST APIs and integrations

- cloud services and cloud-based databases

- Git and modern software development tools


We are not looking for a long list of technologies on your CV. What matters most to us is that **you can build working software and solve problems independently**.

What is it like to work at CraftLeap?

CraftLeap is a small company, so you won't be one developer among a hundred others.

You will work directly with the founder. Decisions can be made quickly, new ideas can be tested, and your work will have a visible impact on the product.

The position is **hybrid, with a strong focus on remote work**. We do, however, hope that you can work together with us in the Seinäjoki area when needed.

There is no unnecessary bureaucracy or complicated organizational structure. If you see something that could be done better, you can say it – and even better if you can help make it happen.

Why join us now?

CraftLeap is at a point where the product is no longer just an idea or a prototype.

**The software is in production, we have customers across Finland, and our customer base is growing rapidly.**

We are now building the foundation for the next stage of growth. As one of the first developers at CraftLeap, you will have a significant role in developing the product and shaping the technical solutions as the development team grows.

Salary and applying

Salary will be agreed based on your experience and skills.

**Please include your salary expectation in your application.**

If this sounds like something you could be a good fit for, **we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement listed above**.

Tell us briefly about yourself, your previous experience and the kind of software you have worked with.

**More information:** craftleap.com

**Applications:** info@craftleap.com

jobs.title: Kirketjener til Stengård Kirke
jobs.description:
Er du typen, der ser, hvad der skal gøres – og får det gjort?
Stengård Kirke søger en engageret kirketjener med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Vi er en levende og aktiv kirke med mange gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, arrangementer og aktiviteter. Som kirketjener får du en alsidig arbejdsdag med selvstændige opgaver og tæt samarbejde med kirkens øvrige medarbejdere, herunder en anden kirketjener, en kordegn og en daglig leder.

Vi søger dig, som
  • er imødekommende og serviceminded over for kirkens brugere og gæster
  • tager ansvar og arbejder selvstændigt – ser, hvad der skal gøres, tager initiativ og får tingene gjort, samtidig med at du arbejder inden for aftalte rammer og beslutninger
  • kan prioritere og strukturere opgaver og bevare overblikket
  • er en god samarbejdspartner, der lytter, kommunikerer åbent og bidrager konstruktivt
  • er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider, herunder aftener, weekender og helligdage.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra et serviceorienteret arbejde og har håndværksmæssig erfaring. Erfaring som kirketjener er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du er ansvarsbevidst, praktisk anlagt og har lyst til at få tingene til at fungere. Kørekort og adgang til bil er en fordel.

Dine opgaver
  • kirketjeneste ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
  • praktisk forberedelse og oprydning ved gudstjenester og arrangementer
  • rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirke og tilknyttede bygninger
  • servicering ved arrangementer og møder
  • praktiske og mindre håndværksmæssige opgaver samt pasning af udendørsarealer, herunder havearbejde
  • kontakt med brugere af kirkens lokaler og håndværkere
  • indkøb af dagligvarer og forbrugsvarer.

Vi tilbyder
  • et meningsfuldt og alsidigt arbejde
  • selvstændige opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine praktiske evner og dit initiativ
  • engagerede kolleger, en arbejdsplads med plads til forskellighed og et godt samarbejdsmiljø
  • fleksible arbejdstider inden for en tjenesteplan, der tilrettelægges efter kirkens aktiviteter.

Om stillingen
Stillingen er på fuld tid med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Ansættelsen er omfattet af gældende overenskomst og organisationsaftale for kirketjenere. Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at fortsætte som tjenestemænd.

Lønnen aftales mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening inden for intervallet 324.667 - 408.841 kr. årligt, afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring. Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen, og rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231 kr. årligt. Herudover er der et OK18 tillæg på 1.401 kr. årligt. Alle ovennævnte beløb er i niveau pr. 1. august 2026 ved fuldtidsbeskæftigelse (37 timer ugentligt). Herudover er der et pensionsbidrag på 15%.

Der er 3 måneders prøvetid, og der indhentes børneattest. Har du ikke gennemført den obligatoriske 5-ugers kirketjeneruddannelse, skal den gennemføres inden for 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen fås ved henvendelse til daglig leder, Lars Grindsted, tlf. 3011 6141 eller e-mail lagri@km.dk.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.
Læs mere om Stengård Sogn og Kirke på www.stengaardkirke.dk.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til Stengård Sogns Menighedsråd, mrk. Kirketjener, på 7133fortrolig@sogn.dk senest 30. oktober 2026. Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende efter fristen.

jobs.title: Svenskspråkig vårdare åt sympatisk kund i Östersundom
jobs.description:
**Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**

Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund i Östresundom

Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!

Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**

Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Vad gör en vård helppare?**

En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.

Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

- hjälp vid dusch

- uppföljning av hur senioren mår

- stöd för att klara sig hemma

- stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet


Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.

**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**

Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.

Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.

Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?

Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:

Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.

Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.

Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.

Som vård helppare får du:

- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap.

- **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka.

- **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning.

- **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön!


Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.

**Skicka in din ansökan som vårdare-helpper här.**

**Läs mer om Hemby genom att klicka här.**

Om du har frågor om att bli vårdare-helpper, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

jobs.title: King of the Road trenger flere med på laget!
jobs.description:
Noen velger yrke, andre velger livsstil.
 
Hos Scania Kløfta jobber vi ikke bare med lastebiler. Vi jobber med et varemerke som vekker stolthet. Scania er kjent langt utover verkstedgulvet, og det finnes folk som bærer griffen på både klær, vegger, og noen ganger til og med tatovert på kroppen. Men hos oss handler det først og fremst om noe annet: dyktige folk som er stolte av faget sitt.
Hver dag kommer lastebiler inn og ut av verkstedet vårt i Kløfta. Kundene våre forventer kvalitet, kompetanse og løsninger som holder dem på veien. Det ansvaret tar vi på alvor.
For å fortsette å levere på det nivået vi er kjent for, ønsker vi nå å styrke laget med flere mekanikere. Er dette kanskje deg?
 
Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi søker to nye mekanikere til oss. Du trenger ikke ha Scania-logoen tatovert, men du må ha interesse for faget.
Vi ønsker at du har relevant fagbrev og erfaring som mekaniker, enten fra tungbil, bil, anlegg, landbruk eller industri. Du liker å løse tekniske utfordringer, har interesse for moderne kjøretøy og ønsker å utvikle deg videre.
Du jobber strukturert, samarbeider godt med andre og tar stolthet i arbeidet du leverer.
 
Hva kan vi tilby deg?
Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og godt samhold. Du får jobbe i et moderne verksted med moderne utstyr, og du får muligheten til å utvikle deg gjennom kurs, opplæring og nye utfordringer.
Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger og en trygg arbeidsgiver med et av bransjens sterkeste varemerker. Her blir du satset på - og her kan du bli lenge.
 
Er du klar?
Vil du bli en del av laget i Kløfta? Send oss gjerne en søknad allerede i dag. Vi behandler søknader fortløpende.
Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Distriktssjef Jan Erik Dokken +4794985111.

jobs.title: Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, Location: Danmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.

You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.

Your tasks & responsibilities 
Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.
  • Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms
  • Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately


Your profile & qualifications
 
You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you:

  • Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field
  • Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling
  • Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge
  • Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions
  • Communicate clearly in written and spoken English
  • Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Laboratory technician at DTU Metabolomics Core - DTU Bioengineering
jobs.description:
The DTU Metabolomics Core at DTU Bioengineering, Kgs. Lyngby, is looking for a skilled and motivated Laboratory Technician to join our team of excellent scientists and technicians collaborating on microbial molecules, trying to unravel their importance in nature, and discover how they can benefit humanity in various ways, such as in agriculture, and novel pharmaceuticals.

About the DTU Metabolomics Core
The DTU Metabolomics Core in the Department of Bioengineering is one of a several Core facilities within the Department that supports a wide range of research and teaching. The area in which the Metabolomics Core specializes is in the chemical analysis of small secondary metabolites from microorganisms, such as bacteria, fungi, and microalgae. This analysis is undertaken in our extensive instrument suite (HPLC, LCMS, GCMS, MALDI etc.), a collection of instrumentation that you will work closely with as our new technician.

The primary job areas of responsibility
As Laboratory Technician in the Metabolomics Core, you will play a key role in the day-to-day operation of the facility in close collaboration with the Facility Manager. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Operating and maintaining our analytical instrumentation, including high-resolution LC-MS systems (sample preparation, calibration, QC runs, routine troubleshooting and preventive maintenance in cooperation with service engineers)
  • Running samples for internal researchers and external contract projects, from sample preparation to data acquisition
  • Ordering and managing laboratory supplies, consumables, and chemicals, and keeping the lab stocked and organized
  • Maintaining lab standards: cleanliness, safety, waste handling, documentation, and quality control routines
  • Supporting users of the facility with practical guidance on sample submission and preparation
  • Contributing to the ongoing development of workflows and procedures in the facility
  • Supporting students

In addition to this is it expected that you will take part in some Department duties, particularly involving laboratory and chemical safety. This will be done in close collaboration with a team of 4 other technicians working within the same section that hosts the Metabolomics Core.

Qualifications
We expect that you:
  • Hold a degree as a laboratory technician (laborant) and/or a BSc/MSc in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, chemical engineering, or a related field
  • Have hands-on experience with HPLC instrumentation. Experience with high-resolution MS (e.g., QTOF) is a strong advantage
  • Are experienced in routine laboratory work, including sample preparation, solvent handling, and general upkeep of analytical labs
  • Have knowledge of Good Laboratory Practice, safety regulations, and documentation standards
  • Are structured, detail-oriented, and able to plan your own work independently
  • Enjoy collaborating with researchers of different backgrounds and communicating in English (our working language)
  • Ideally, have experience with natural products chemistry, and sample preparation

What we offer in return
With this job we offer you an exciting and versatile position in a multicultural, respectful and dynamic research and learning environment with many international employees and students. You will gain hands on experience with a wide variety of different analytical instrumentation and have the freedom to create your own daily agenda by prioritizing your tasks.

You will have:
  • A central role in a well-equipped core facility with diverse and exciting projects spanning microbiology, natural products, and industrial collaborations
  • Close collaboration with leading research groups at DTU Bioengineering
  • A flexible, informal working environment at DTU's Lyngby campus
  • Professional development opportunities, including training on new instrumentation and methods

Salary and appointment terms
Salary and appointment terms are in accordance with the OAO-S Joint Agreement and the organization agreement for Office Clerks, Laboratory Technicians and IT staff (HK/stat). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for clerical employees OR laboratory technicians: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The appointment is permanent full time. The position starts 1st December 2026 or as soon as possible after.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 4 November 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Facility Manager, Aaron Andersen by e-mail (ajca@dtu.dk) or by telephone (+45 45 25 61 38). DTU Bioengineering website: https://www.bioengineering.dtu.dk/english.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

The Department of Biotechnology and Biomedicine (DTU Bioengineering) is an international leader in the areas of biotechnology and biomedicine. Our engineering approach to all aspects of biotechnology and biomedicine positions us as a valuable player with unique competences in a growing bio-based economy and with health systems transforming towards personalized medicine. We have a clear focus on the needs in life science- and biotech industries and point towards innovation, new businesses, and scientific services for the benefit of society. The department has extensive collaborations with national and international research units and industry. DTU Bioengineering has approx. 400 employees, of which 2/3 are scientific staff. The department is located at DTU Lyngby Campus.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

I din rolle hos oss som bilklargjører er du en nøkkelperson i driften. Det er du som sørger for at bilene våre er rene, klare og klare til levering, akkurat når kundene trenger dem. Du jobber tett med kolleger i skranke og ledelse, og bidrar til god flyt i en travel hverdag. Hos oss betyr klargjøring mer enn vask, det handler om presisjon, ansvar og kvalitet i alle ledd.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Klargjøre og vaske leiebiler i henhold til Sixt sine standarder.

  • Sikre god flyt mellom bestilling, tilgjengelig bilpark og levering.

  • Registrere og følge opp skader på biler.

  • Følge opp service og dekkomlegg.

  • Håndtere utstyr som barneseter og skistativ.

  • Yte god kundeservice når situasjonen krever det.

  • Sørge for orden og struktur på arbeidsplassen.

Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Du liker å jobbe effektivt, tar ansvar og er opptatt av å levere et godt sluttresultat.

  • Har førerkort klasse B (manuell og automat).

  • Har plettfri vandel (politiattest kreves).

  • Jobber raskt, nøyaktig og strukturert.

  • Har høy arbeidskapasitet og god fysisk form.

  • Liker å jobbe i team og motiveres av å hjelpe andre.

  • Behersker norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Har grunnleggende datakunnskaper.

Hva tilbyr vi?

Hos Sixt blir du en del av et selskap som vokser, og som vet at gode kundeopplevelser starter med dyktige medarbeidere

  • En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger.

  • Grundig opplæring og tydelige rammer.

  • Reelle utviklingsmuligheter for den som vil mer.

Klar for å bli en del av Sixt? Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende, søk i dag.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
jobs.description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

  • Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

  • Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

  • Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

  • Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

  • Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

  • Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

  • Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

  • Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

  • National or European research and innovation funding 

  • Development of collaborative funding proposals 

  • Consortium building and partner identification 

  • University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

  • Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

  • Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

  • Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

  • Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

  • Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

  • Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

  • Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

  • Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

  • Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

  • Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

  • Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

  • Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

  • Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages. 

  • Work in. 

  • Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

  • A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and exam certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All documents must be in English and PDF format.  All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.  

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: MORS Software : Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time and permanent

**Location**: Helsinki, Aleksanterinkatu 48

**Application deadline**: 20.10.2026

**Looking for a role where you can take real ownership and help shape the next generation of business-critical fintech software?**

MORS Software develops Treasury Management and Asset & Liability Management software for banks. The product is evolving from a primarily desktop architecture toward a browser-based experience, a durable application/API layer and governed AI/agentic capabilities through MORSia.

Now, MORS is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to join its growing engineering team.

**What will you be doing?**

As a Senior Software Engineer at MORS, you will take end-to-end ownership of key areas of its treasury and banking software. Your work will be backend-focused, with C#/.NET at the core, and will combine work on established production systems with building new solutions. Roughly 60% of the work focuses on the existing product and architecture and 40% on new development.

Your initial focus will be on Financial Planning and Payments, where you will take ownership of existing functionality while contributing to their continued development. Over time, your scope may expand into other areas of MORSs banking software.

Ownership here means more than implementing predefined tickets. You will work with Product and domain specialists to understand the underlying business problem, design the solution, implement and test it, take it to production, investigate issues, and improve it further. You will also have room to challenge existing approaches and influence technical and architectural decisions together with MORS's CTO and engineering team. **What makes you a great fit?**

You are an experienced backend engineer who enjoys taking responsibility for complex software rather than focusing only on an isolated part of the development cycle. You can navigate an established codebase, make pragmatic technical decisions, and move work forward independently even when every requirement has not been defined upfront.

You do not need previous banking experience, but you should be interested in understanding why the software exists and what it enables for customers. MORS values engineers who communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and remain curious as development practices and technologies evolve.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 5 years of professional experience with C#/.NET and strong backend development skills

- Experience owning, debugging, and developing established production software and business-critical functionality

- Strong SQL Server and data access skills, combined with a good understanding of REST APIs and systems integration

- Experience with automated testing, source control, and CI/CD as part of professional software development

- Good English skills and the ability to plan work independently, identify dependencies, and communicate technical risks clearly


**Additional skills we value:**

- Experience with banking, payments, treasury, ALM, or another regulated or business-critical software environment

- Familiarity with Azure and modern ASP.NET Core

- Hands-on knowledge of modernizing legacy .NET applications, including WPF-based systems

- Understanding of batch processing, long-running jobs, workflows, or audit-sensitive systems


**What MORS offers you:**

- Take real ownership of business-critical software, with the autonomy to influence technical decisions and how your areas evolve

- Play a key role in MORSs technical modernization, working with both established systems and new architecture

- Develop deep expertise in banking technology by solving complex problems across Financial Planning, Payments, treasury, and risk management

- Grow your scope as the engineering team expands, with room to take on broader responsibilities and influence technical decisions

- Explore new ways of building software, including AI-assisted development, while having a say in how these tools are adopted


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by MORS Software. The position is based in Helsinki, with the current hybrid model typically involving around two-three days per week at MORS's office at Aleksanterinkatu 48. At the beginning of the employment we hope you will primarily work at the office. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible, taking the selected candidate's notice period into account. Salary in this position is 5500-7500 €/month depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Recruitment process timeline:**

- _Initial video interviews with aTalent: week 43_

- _We will notify all candidates about the next steps by week 44 at the latest_

- _Interview rounds with MORS: week 44 – week 45_


**Interested in taking ownership of what comes next at MORS?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 20th of October via our application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/387497/create/.

A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with MORS Software here: https://morssoftware.com/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (+358 44 783 5666, veera.kokko\[at\]atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Riverco Oy on keskisuuri konepaja-, laivankorjaus- ja laivanrakennusalan yritys, joka on kansainvälisesti menestynyt ja alallaan tunnettu. Pääasiakkaitamme ovat muun muassa maailman johtavat risteilyvarustamot ja telakat.

Olemme osa erittäin vakavaraista ja 60 vuotta toiminutta monialaista yritysryhmää. Konserni toimii konepaja- ja laivanrakennusteollisuuden lisäksi sähkö- ja putkiurakoinnissa, kiinteistötoimialalla sekä kaupan alalla. Yrityksen toimipaikat sijaitsevat Turussa, Raisiossa, Paraisilla ja Nousiaisissa.

Tyypillisiä työkohteitamme ovat laivojen teknisten ja sisustusalueiden kokonaistoimitukset sekä laivojen tekniset järjestelmät. Toteutamme useille kansainvälisille varustamoille muun muassa vaativia muutos-, kunnossapito- ja huoltotöitä.

Osaavaan tiimiimme olisi nyt haussa kotimaassa ja ulkomailla toteutettaviin laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteihin:

**SISUSTUSTYÖNJOHTAJA**

**Työnkuva**

Sisustustyönjohtajana vastaat laivojen sisustus- ja muutostöiden käytännön toteutuksesta työmaalla. Johdat ja ohjaat asentajia sekä aliurakoitsijoita ja huolehdit siitä, että työt etenevät suunnitelmien, aikataulujen ja laatutavoitteiden mukaisesti. Ennen projektia osallistut esivalmistuksen ohjaamiseen ja ostotoimintaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- työmaan päivittäisen toiminnan ja työn etenemisen suunnittelu ja johtaminen

- oman henkilöstön ja aliurakoitsijoiden työnjohto sekä työn organisointi

- töiden aikatauluttaminen ja resurssien suunnittelu yhdessä projektiryhmän kanssa

- työpiirustusten ja muiden suunnitelmien läpikäynti sekä niiden toteutuksen valvonta

- materiaalien, työkalujen ja muiden työssä tarvittavien resurssien koordinointi

- työn laadun ja aikataulujen valvonta sekä tarvittavien muutosten koordinointi

- projektien valmisteluun, työmäärien arviointiin ja toteutuksen suunnitteluun osallistuminen


Työtehtävät vaihtelevat projektien mukaan, joten työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden olla mukana sekä pienemmissä korjaus- ja muutostöissä että laajemmissa laivanrakennusprojekteissa.

Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista projektiryhmää, mutta tehtävässä korostuu myös itsenäinen ote, päätöksentekokyky ja vastuunotto omasta työmaasta.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta tai aikaisempaa kokemusta laivanrakennuksen tai rakennus- ja teollisuudenalan työnjohdosta. Erityisesti kokemus laivojen sisustustöistä, muutostöistä tai telakkaympäristöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- käytännönläheistä ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- kykyä ohjata erilaisia työryhmiä

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä tehdä päätöksiä muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- kykyä lukea teknisiä piirustuksia ja suunnitelmia

- matkustusvalmiutta kotimaassa ja ulkomailla

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen sekä itsenäisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja mielenkiintoisten projektien parissa.

Tehtävässä pääset näkemään projektit alusta loppuun ja osallistumaan niiden valmisteluun, toteutukseen ja viimeistelyyn. Työ tarjoaa vaihtelua, vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista laivanrakennuksen ja laivankorjauksen monipuolisissa tehtävissä.

Työskentelet osana kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista projektiorganisaatiota, jossa yhteistyöllä ja käytännön tekemisellä on tärkeä rooli projektien onnistumisessa.

Jos olet käytännönläheinen, vastuullinen ja yhteistyökykyinen tekijä, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työympäristöissä ja haluaa olla mukana toteuttamassa vaativia laivanrakennus- ja laivankorjausprojekteja, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.
