jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer II, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

Big systems. Exciting challenges. Real impact. As a Software Engineer II (Fullstack), you'll take ownership of features across our Supply Chain Engineering systems — from Purchase Orders and Store Transfers to Cross Dock operations and Returns — building the backend services and integrations that keep inventory moving efficiently across our network. You'll design event-driven, Kafka-based workflows that connect our platform to external Warehouse Management Systems, and see your code go straight into production supporting Quick Commerce's growing Non-Food business.

Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We own and evolve systems supporting Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns orders, as well as capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and WMS integrations. Our systems operate across multiple markets and integrate with different internal platforms and external WMS, creating interesting challenges around distributed workflows, data consistency, reliability and system integration.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- Develop backend services using Golang/Python and frontend applications using React
- Design and evolve APIs, event-driven workflows, and Kafka-based integrations — including with internal platforms and external Warehouse Management Systems and logistics platforms
- Partner with Product Managers, engineers, and operational stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions
- Make technical decisions within your features and contribute to broader architecture and design discussions within the team
- Own the complete software lifecycle: design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production operation
- Investigate production issues and improve system reliability, performance, resilience, and observability

Qualifications

- Professional experience building and operating production software, with the ability to independently own features from problem understanding through production delivery
- Strong experience with at least one backend programming language — Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with the willingness to work across our backend stack
- Experience building modern web applications using React or comparable technologies, integrating them with backend APIs

jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) enables customers of all sizes to run their applications on Amazon’s industry-leading cloud computing infrastructure. AWS is growing very rapidly with hundreds of thousands of companies in over 190 countries on the platform.
We're looking for a detailed, motivated, and structured Sales Operations and Strategy Analyst to partner with the DACH sales teams to define, land and execute against our strategic priorities for the business. This role will partner with the EMEA central operations team in the strategic planning process, the annual and monthly rhythm of business and the annual Territory Planning process.
The successful candidate (m/f) will need to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional data teams to solve problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high standards.
This position will be responsible for supporting the rhythm of the business activities such as Monthly Business Reviews, Pipeline Reviews, and other cadenced reporting and metrics. The position will assist Sales Managers in evaluating and forecasting attainment against quotas, utilizing various CRM tools to derive well-vetted analysis, and other ad-hoc requests and analysis as needed. This individual will support the day-to-day execution of the business including commission and quota plans, managing the territory definitions and account movements, and providing reporting and insights to sales leaders.
The successful candidate must be able to roll-up their sleeves and dive deep into unclearly defined spaces and instill proper levels of structure and control. They will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across other geographies.
This role is a Fix Term Contract (FTC) for 12 months and the preferred location for this position is Berlin, the alternative can be Munich.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: - Develop key sales support systems/processes required to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives

- Analyze data and trends and make informed recommendations to the sales teams and managers
- Manage continuously-evolving forecast models and methodologies, owning the quantitative analysis of the performance of our sales team
- Develop relationships and work with sales, partner, sales operations, and other stakeholders to create and refine the tools and processes needed to drive productivity increases.
- Assist Sales Managers in all aspects of evaluating their teams’ performance
- Ensure accurate and timely sales commission calculations
- Identify reporting issues, gaps in processes, and drive timely resolution
- Prepare ad hoc analysis & participate on projects as needed

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. By submitting your resume and application information, you authorize Amazon to transmit and store your information in the Amazon group of companies' world-wide recruitment database, and to circulate that information as necessary for the purpose of evaluating your qualifications for this or other job vacancies.

Key job responsibilities
Revenue Forecasting & Planning – Support the ISV EMEA revenue forecasting process by analysing trends, identifying risks and opportunities, and ensuring forecast accuracy. Partner with ISV sales managers to validate inputs and drive accountability in the forecasting cadence.

Territory & Coverage Optimisation – Assist in the design and analysis of territory plans, account assignments, and coverage models across EMEA ISV segments, ensuring equitable distribution of opportunity and alignment with strategic priorities.

Operational Process Improvement – Identify and implement process improvements that increase ISV sales team productivity and operational efficiency. Streamline reporting workflows, automate recurring analyses, and champion best practices across the ISV EMEA sales organisation.

Strategic Project Support – Contribute to cross-functional strategic projects that drive business growth across ISV EMEA, including supporting go-to-market plans for new ISV segments or verticals, providing analytical input during account planning cycles to identify whitespace opportunities, building business cases for strategic partnerships, analysing the effectiveness of sales incentive programmes, and supporting organisational design initiatives such as the integration of new geographies or ISV segments into existing structures.

- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter Qualitätssicherung (m/w/d) - Quereinstieg möglich (Fachkraft - Qualitätssicherung/-management)
jobs.description:
RECALO GmbH ist ein international erfolgreich agierendes Unternehmen im Bereich Behälterlogistik und Ladungsträger-Management. Wir fokussieren uns auf das Pooling von Mehrwegladungsträgern (z. B. Boxen und Paletten), die von unseren Kunden für den Transport von Rohstoffen sowie Teil- oder Fertigprodukten eingesetzt werden. Dabei kommen unsere Dienstleistungen in unterschiedlichen Industrien zum Einsatz, u. a. in Lebensmittel, Kosmetik, Getränke, Pharma, Chemie und Haushalt.

An unserem Standort in Riedstadt-Goddelau erwartet dich ein eingespieltes, hilfsbereites Team mit echter Zusammenarbeit. Wir leben flache Hierarchien und einen intensiven Austausch mit unseren Führungskräften. Gegenseitiges Feedback ist uns wichtig: daher finden z. B. in der Onboarding-Phase mehrere feste Feedbackgespräche statt, später mindestens einmal jährlich. Wir pflegen intern eine Du-Kultur und legen Wert auf Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, einen offenen Umgang mit Fehlern und ein kollegiales, familiäres Miteinander.

Für unseren wachsenden Standort in Riedstadt-Goddelau bei Darmstadt suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit eine:n

Mitarbeiter Qualitätssicherung (m/w/d) - Quereinstieg möglich

Ihre Aufgaben:

Als Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) in der Qualitätssicherung sind Sie an unserem Standort in Riedstadt für folgende Aufgaben verantwortlich:

- Sie führen Qualitätskontrollen nach Prüfplan durch und stellen die benötigten Messmittel ein und kalibrieren diese.
- Sie prüfen Produkte auf Beschädigungen, bearbeiten Reklamationen vor Ort und unterstützen bei der Ursachenanalyse.
- Sie achten in der Produktion auf Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Einhaltung der HACCP-Standards. Außerdem erklären Sie Kolleg*innen die Reinigungsabläufe und weisen sie praktisch ein. RECALO ist kein Lebensmittelbetrieb – Hygiene und Sauberkeit sind dennoch wichtige Bestandteile unserer Qualitätssicherung.
- Sie wirken bei internen Audits mit, begleiten Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und pflegen Fehlerkataloge.
- Sie unterstützen Qualitätsprüfungen neuer Produkte und Materialien, sind Ansprechperson für Qualitätsfragen in der Produktion und dokumentieren sowie berichten die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Ihr Profil:

- Schulabschluss (Abitur und/oder Ausbildung im QS-Bereich o.ä. wünschenswert, aber nicht notwendig)
- Erfahrung aus Produktion, Lager, Logistik, Hygiene oder Qualitätssicherung ist ein Plus; Quereinstieg möglich.
- Sehr gute Deutsch- (mind. B2) und gute Englisch-Kenntnisse (mind. B1) zwingend erforderlich
- Grundlegende PC-Grundkenntnisse (E-Mail, MS Office, etc.) notwendig
- Staplerschein von Vorteil
- Klare Kommunikation und selbstbewusster Auftritt bei bspw. Schulungen/Einweisung von Gruppen
- Sorgfältige, genaue und selbständige Arbeitsweise sowie ein gutes Hygiene- und Qualitätsbewusstsein
- Durchsetzungsfähigkeit notwendig
- Bereitschaft zu Erklärungs- und Prüfzwecken in der Produktion körperlich mitzuarbeiten

Das bieten wir Ihnen:

- Vollzeitstelle mit geregelten Arbeitszeiten in Tagschicht (07:00 - 15:45 Uhr, montags bis freitags), 30 Tage Urlaub sowie Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe
- Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets
- Attraktive Sozialleistungen (betr. Unfall- und Krankenzusatzversicherung, Altersvorsorge)
- Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bei fehlenden Qualifikationen
- Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr
- Kostenfreie Getränke (Wasser, Kaffee, Tee)

Hier bekommen Sie einen Einblick in unseren Standort:

Sie möchten Teil unseres Teams und Erfolgs werden?

Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt und senden uns Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen inklusive Gehaltsvorstellungen! Wir freuen uns von Ihnen zu hören.

Nach der Bewerbung melden wir uns zeitnah bei Ihnen zurück. Wenn Ihr Profil passt, laden wir Sie zu einem ersten Bewerbungsgespräch via Microsoft Teams ein. Im zweiten Gespräch vor Ort können Sie den Standort und mögliche Aufgaben näher kennenlernen.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.
At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About UsTo solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams

- Formation supérieure en marketing, communication, médias ou domaine équivalent.

- Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets et priorités simultanément
- Excellent relationnel et aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement international.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Incident Response
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast.

This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Incident Response

 - Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

 - Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken.

 - Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

 - Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation.


Investigation & Forensics

 - Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts.

 - Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents.

 - Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected.


IR Automation & Tooling

 - Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage.

 - Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible.

 - Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain.



Detection & Continuous Improvement

 - Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion.

 - Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment.

 - Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure.

 - Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking).

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads.

 - Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse).

 - Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes.

 - Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms.

 - Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers.

 - Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research.

 - Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

 - Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience.
   


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curiosity & initiative: Strong desire to understand attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and how they apply to real-world systems.
   

 - Speed & analytical rigor: Ability to quickly assess high-risk vulnerabilities with clear, evidence-based reasoning.
   

 - Collaboration: Comfort working across cross-functional teams spanning Security, SRE, Engineering, and Infrastructure.
   

 - Clear communication: Ability to explain findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels.
   

 - Ownership mindset: Takes initiative to drive investigations, improvements, and remediations to completion.
   

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying up to date on new vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and cloud-native security best practices.
   





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Upholstery Sewer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

We offer: Bee Interior (specializing in exclusive upholstery and interior work for vehicles, watercraft, and furniture) typically offers the following conditions and benefits to its automotive and furniture upholsterers:
Exciting and varied projects: The work is not assembly-line production—every project is unique, ranging from interiors for vintage and luxury cars to motorcycle seats and custom-made furniture. ￼ Competitive pay commensurate with skills ￼ Professional tools and equipment ￼ On-site training and specialization: Support and guidance in executing specific cutting techniques, decorative stitching, and leather preparation. ￼ Stable full-time employment: Long-term job security and a steady workload in a specialized craft sector. ￼ Pleasant work environment: A small, professional, and supportive team that values ​​high-quality craftsmanship.

jobs.title: Security guard
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Production Operator – Skilled / Experienced – CAM Plant
jobs.description:
**Position: Production Operator – Skilled / Experienced – CAM Plant**

**Location: Kotka**

**Employer: Easpring Finland New Materials Oy**

**Position Overview**

We are looking for experienced Production Operators to join our CAM plant production organization.

The position is primarily a field operator role, not a control room operator role. The work focuses on hands-on process and equipment operation, field observations, troubleshooting, sampling, process equipment inspections, and maintaining safe, high-quality, and stable production.

Production equipment is mainly operated through local operating panels, and the work is performed in the production area as part of the shift team.

As the plant operates 24/7/365, the position requires working in a rotating shift schedule, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Operate production equipment and process stages in the field using local operating panels.

- Perform field rounds and monitor and inspect process and equipment conditions.

- Perform sampling, material handling, cleaning, and other practical production activities.

- Identify process and equipment deviations and take appropriate first actions.

- Participate in production start-ups, shutdowns, product changeovers, and troubleshooting.

- Follow safety, quality, and operating procedures, including LOTO and permit-to-work practices.

- Cooperate with Shift Supervisors, Production Process Engineers, Maintenance, and other support functions.

- Participate in continuous improvement of safety, quality, process stability, and working methods.


**What We Expect from You**

- Practical experience in the chemical industry or another relevant process industry.

- Experience in field operations and operating industrial process and production equipment.

- Experience in operating equipment through local operating panels is considered an advantage.

- Ability to identify process and equipment deviations and participate in troubleshooting.

- Good understanding of process safety and safe working practices.

- Safety- and quality-oriented, responsible, and hands-on approach to work.

- Willingness to work shifts and perform hands-on work in the production area.

- Good communication and teamwork skills in an international industrial environment.

- A valid right to work in Finland is required.

- Previous experience in a Finnish industrial environment is considered an advantage.


**Experience Level**

**Skilled Production Operator – 2–5 Years of Relevant Experience**

You have 2–5 years of practical experience in production and process equipment operation, preferably in the chemical industry or another relevant process industry.

After site-specific training, you are able to independently operate the equipment within your assigned process area. You understand the basic operation of the process and equipment, recognize typical process and equipment deviations, and can take appropriate first actions safely.

**Experienced Production Operator – More Than 5 Years of Relevant Experience**

You have more than 5 years of practical experience in production and process equipment operation, preferably in the chemical industry or another relevant process industry.

You have strong hands-on experience in field operations and process equipment. You can independently identify abnormal process and equipment conditions, participate actively in troubleshooting, and support less experienced operators in practical field operations.

**Preferred Industrial Background**

We particularly value hands-on operating experience from the chemical industry and other process industries involving powder or solid material handling and similar types of process equipment.

**Relevant experience may include:**

- Chemical and petrochemical industry

- Battery materials

- Minerals and materials processing

- Metals and metal compounds processing

- Relevant process operations in the pulp and paper industry


Experience with material feeding and dosing, mixing, thermal processing, milling, screening, pneumatic or mechanical material conveying, and packaging processes is particularly relevant.

Previous experience in a highly automated process environment combined with hands-on field operations is considered an advantage.

**Application**

The application period closes on 31 October 2026.

Please note that we will review applications and conduct interviews already during the application period. We may also make hiring decisions before the application deadline when suitable candidates are identified.

We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
We have a strong and growing product development organization made up of experienced professionals and talented junior engineers. Our product roadmap is healthy well into the future, offering a variety of technically meaningful challenges.

To support our long-term roadmap and ambitious technology goals, we are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to help develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable efficient, secure, and high-quality software and product delivery.

We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in DevOps toolchains, automation, CI/CD, and Kubernetes-based platforms.

**Your** **role**

As a **DevOps Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the development infrastructure used throughout the product lifecycle, including the underlying network connectivity and security controls. The environment includes source code and artifact management, build and release automation, test infrastructure, Kubernetes-based platforms, and integrations supporting requirements management, verification, validation, and product releases.

You will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline development workflows and introduce modern tools and practices that support developers in their daily work.

**Main Responsibilities**

- Maintain and continuously improve the development environment and DevOps toolchain, manage source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact repositories.

- Design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient network connectivity for development, build, test and deployment environments and troubleshoot issues.

- Support network architecture and configuration for Kubernetes-based platforms, including ingress controls, load balancing, DNS, service connectivity, network policies and certificate management.

- Ensure development infrastructure complies with relevant standards, cybersecurity requirements, and regulations.

- Automate manual processes and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, reliability, traceability, and quality.

- Integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and compliance checks into the software development lifecycle.

- Evaluate, implement, and support AI-powered tools that enhance developer productivity.

- Administer developer tools and software, integrate development data sources to provide clear visibility and reporting across the product development lifecycle.


**Your profile**

Our ideal candidate has a strong background in DevOps, automation, and software development tooling.

You are a proactive, hands-on professional who can apply industry best practices to modern, highly secure and regulated engineering environments.

**Required Skills**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.

- Minimum five years of relevant experience in DevOps, Build Engineering, Software Tooling, or a similar role.

- Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, TLS/PKI, and network segmentation.

- Experience with DevOps technologies such as GitLab, Git, Docker, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or similar.

- Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes.

- Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes-based container platforms.

- Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure software development, open-source software governance, and DevSecOps practices.

- Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.

- Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar).

- Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.


We do not expect you to meet every requirement listed above. If you have a strong DevOps background, a hands-on mindset, and experience in many of the areas described, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges just as much as experience with specific tools.

**What you will be part of**

Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of Saab Surveillance business area. Our R&D teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people safe**. As an example of a brilliant product we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact!

We support flexible ways of working and offer opportunities for occasional remote work when the nature of the tasks allows. As a DevOps Engineer, you will work closely with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to continuously improve our development platforms, tools, and processes. Because of this close collaboration and the nature of our development environment, most work is carried out on-site at our modern Saab Technology Center in Tampere.

On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options.

In this job, some of your tasks have a connection to defense secrecy. Therefore, a drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance act 726/2014 is required for the selected applicant.

**Why join us?**

- Play a key role in enabling the development of cutting-edge electronic warfare systems

- Work with modern DevOps technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and automation solutions

- Take ownership of processes and solutions that directly support product development and delivery

- Collaborate with highly skilled software, systems, and engineering professionals

- Grow your expertise through continuous learning, training opportunities, and challenging technical projects


We are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.

**Interested?**

Take your chance to build your future career at Saab by submitting your CV and application via Saab Careers already now!

jobs.title: Sourcing Engineer – Electronics and RF Categories
jobs.description:
**Your role**

As a **Sourcing Engineer**, you will play a key role in securing the supply of technically demanding electronic components and modules used in advanced electronic warfare systems. In this role, you will work closely with engineering teams and global suppliers to ensure access to cutting-edge technologies in a fast-evolving and strategically important environment.

You will be responsible for sourcing within advanced electronics categories. Previous experience in the relevant categories is beneficial; however, we also welcome sourcing professionals with experience in other complex technical categories and an interest in developing their expertise further.

As part of the Sourcing and Production team, you will manage relationships with current and potential suppliers and work closely with stakeholders across engineering, projects, production, quality and supply chain. Your work will help ensure an efficient, resilient and uninterrupted supply chain that meets project and production needs. The role includes occasional domestic and international travel to supplier sites, Saab locations and industry events, typically accounting for approximately 10-20% of working time.

The role operates in a challenging and complex environment, where Saab continuously pushes the boundaries of what is technically possible. Success in this role requires strong communication and planning skills, a commercial and analytical mindset, and a proactive approach to supplier management.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Take commercial responsibility for assigned sourcing categories supporting projects and production throughout the product lifecycle.

- Continuously assess the competitiveness, capability, capacity and risk profile of the supplier portfolio.

- Develop and maintain long-term supplier relationships, in close co-operation with internal stakeholders.

- Lead sourcing activities, including RFQs, quotation evaluation, commercial negotiations and supplier agreement management.

- Monitor market trends, component availability, lead times, pricing and obsolescence risks within the assigned categories.

- Identify and drive opportunities for cost efficiency, supplier development and supply-chain resilience.

- Ensure compliance with Saabs sourcing strategy, policies, procedures and applicable requirements.


Your profile

To thrive in this role, you are commercially minded, structured and customer-oriented. You communicate confidently with different stakeholders and are comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a cross-functional team.

You have an analytical approach and the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-paced and technically demanding environment. You are proactive in engaging with suppliers and able to take initiative when identifying supply-chain risks, commercial opportunities or improvement needs.

**Required skills**

- University degree in Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain Management or a related field; alternatively, equivalent relevant work experience

- Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement or supplier management

- Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills

- Excellent written and spoken Finnish and English

- Experience in analysing sourcing, supplier or commercial data using Excel or similar tools


**We also appreciate**

- Experience of sourcing technically demanding electronic components, modules or related products, such as FPGAs, RF components, RF modules or GNSS/INS modules

- Understanding of the electronics-component market, including availability challenges, long lead times, lifecycle management and obsolescence

- Experience of working with ERP systems, for example IFS

- Experience in utilizing AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, data analysis or sourcing processes

- Experience in the electronics, high-technology, aerospace or defence industry

- Technical understanding of electronics, RF technologies or embedded systems


We do not expect you to meet every preferred qualification listed above. If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply!

**What you will be part of**

Saab is one of the world's leading defence and security companies, specializing in air, land, and naval defence, civil security, and commercial aerospace. Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of business area Surveillance. Our teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people and society safe**. As an example of a brilliant product that we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact!

In addition to extremely interesting projects, we offer you unique career opportunities where on-going training and development is also provided to help you build your career. We are big enough to offer a wide range of opportunities, but agile enough to be noticed and recognized.

We value work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely 2-3 days per week when business needs allow. To support a successful onboarding and help you build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, we expect a higher on-site presence during the first months in the role. After that, the position offers a flexible hybrid working model.

On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options.

Please note that some of the tasks in this position are connected to defence secrecy. A drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act (726/2014) are required for the selected applicant.

We hope to welcome you to the team in January 2027 or as soon as possible. We understand that candidates have different notice periods and circumstances, so we are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.

**Interested?**

Please send your CV and application with the salary request through the Saab Career System, **latest by 25th October 2026**.

jobs.title: Er du SuperUsers' nye dataspecialist og -instruktør?
jobs.description:
Er du stærk inden for data, og har du lyst til at fordybe dig fagligt, arbejde med nye teknologier inden for data og AI og lære fra dig som kursusinstruktør? Så er du måske vores nye fuldtidskollega!

Vi søger en teknisk stærk og nysgerrig dataperson med et solidt fagligt fundament og lyst til løbende at udvide det. Særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python er centrale teknologier i rollen, suppleret af Power BI og SQL som vigtige dele af værktøjskassen. Dataområdet udvikler sig hurtigt i takt med AI, og du vil få mulighed for at arbejde med teknologier og løsninger i krydsfeltet mellem data, analytics og AI.

Undervisningserfaring er ikke et krav. Det er derimod vigtigt, at du har lyst til at formidle, forklare og gøre komplekse tekniske emner forståelige og anvendelige for andre.

Om SuperUsers A/S
SuperUsers er et danskejet IT-kursus- og konsulenthus, stiftet i 1984. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger, der brænder for kurser, læring og kompetenceudvikling inden for bl.a. data, AI, cloud, cybersikkerhed, softwareudvikling og infrastruktur. Vi er bl.a. officiel Microsoft Training Services Partner og samarbejder med en række af branchens førende teknologileverandører.

Du bliver en del af vores team af konsulenter og instruktører, måske Danmarks bedste, når det gælder teknisk undervisning på højt niveau. Fælles for os er, at vi går op i vores fag, følger udviklingen tæt og gerne deler vores viden med både kursister og hinanden.

Vi har afdelinger i både Hillerød og Aarhus. I Hillerød får du din daglige gang på Karlebogaard, en historisk landejendom, hvor vi hver dag byder kursister velkommen på kursus i nogle helt unikke rammer. Her bliver du en del af et fagligt og socialt miljø med ca. 20 kolleger.

Om stillingen som instruktør

jobs.title: Sourcing Engineer – Indirect Procurement and Services
jobs.description:
**Your role**

As a **Sourcing Engineer**, you will be responsible for sourcing activities within indirect procurement and services. Your work will support Saabs operations by ensuring that internal stakeholders have access to competitive, reliable and high-quality services, consumables and other indirect goods.

As part of the Sourcing and Production team, you will manage relationships with current and potential suppliers and work closely with stakeholders across production, engineering, HR, administration and facilities. Your work will help ensure a resilient and cost-effective supply base that supports day-to-day operations, projects and production.

**Your category scope may include**

- Production support services, tooling, consumables and capital equipment, including purchases for investment projects.

- Maintenance, calibration and repair services

- Accessories

- Professional, technical, digital, engineering and consultancy services

- Facility management and site services

- Logistics, transport and warehousing services

- Office, workplace and other operational support services


The role includes occasional domestic travel to supplier sites, Saab locations and industry events, typically accounting for approximately 5-10% of working time.

The role operates in a challenging and complex environment, where Saab continuously pushes the boundaries of what is technically possible. Success in this role requires strong communication and planning skills, a commercial and analytical mindset, and a proactive approach to supplier management.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Take commercial responsibility for assigned sourcing categories, including sourcing for investment projects, production and business operations.

- Manage and develop the supplier portfolio, including supplier performance, competitiveness, capability, capacity and risk profile.

- Build and maintain long-term supplier relationships in close collaboration with internal stakeholders.

- Lead sourcing activities, including RFQs, quotation evaluation, commercial negotiations and supplier agreement management.

- Monitor market developments, supplier capacity, pricing, contractual risks and service-delivery performance within the assigned categories.

- Identify and drive opportunities for cost efficiency, supplier development, demand consolidation and operational resilience.

- Ensure compliance with Saabs sourcing strategy, policies, procedures and applicable requirements.


**Your profile**

To thrive in this role, you are commercially minded, structured and customer-oriented. You communicate confidently with different stakeholders and are comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a cross-functional team.

You have an analytical approach and the ability to manage several priorities in a fast-paced and complex environment. You are proactive in engaging with suppliers and internal stakeholders, and able to take initiative when identifying commercial opportunities, supply risks or improvement needs.

**Required skills**

- University degree in Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain Management or a related field; alternatively, equivalent relevant work experience

- Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement or supplier management

- Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills

- Excellent written and spoken Finnish and English

- Experience in analysing sourcing, supplier or commercial data using Excel or similar tools


**We also appreciate**

- Experience in indirect procurement, service procurement or category management

- Experience of sourcing professional, technical, IT, facilities, logistics or other operational support services

- Experience in contract management, supplier-performance management and service-level agreements

- Experience of working with ERP, purchasing or contract-management systems for example IFS

- Experience of utilising AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, data analysis or sourcing processes

- Experience in a high-technology, industrial, aerospace or defence environment


We do not expect you to meet every preferred qualification listed above. If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply!

**What you will be part of**

Saab is one of the world's leading defence and security companies, specializing in air, land, and naval defence, civil security, and commercial aerospace. Saab Sensor Technology Center in Tampere is part of business area Surveillance. Our teams are developing extremely versatile and innovative electronic warfare systems, motivated by a clear target: **to keep people and society safe**. As an example of a brilliant product that we are developing in Tampere, check out Sirius Compact!

We value work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely 2-3 days per week when business needs allow. To support a successful onboarding and help you build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, we expect a higher on-site presence during the first months in the role. After that, the position offers a flexible hybrid working model.

On top of joining a team of highly talented professionals and fun people, we offer a wide range of employee benefits, including a lunch benefit, exercise and culture benefit, leisure-time accident insurance, an employee share matching program, and support for your daily commute through public transport benefits or parking options.

Please note that some of the tasks in this position are connected to defence secrecy. A drug test and approved security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act (726/2014) are required for the selected applicant.

We hope to welcome you to the team in January 2027 or as soon as possible. We understand that candidates have different notice periods and circumstances, so we are happy to discuss a start date that works for both sides.

**Interested?**

Please send your CV and application with the salary request through the Saab Career System, **latest by 25 October 2026.**

Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that we might start interviews before the closing date of the advertisement.

jobs.title: Vil du være en del af vores stærke pædagogteam i børnehaven i Schous Børnehus?
jobs.description:
Vi er netop i gang med en rivende faglig udvikling i vores børnehave – og nu mangler vi den sidste pædagog på holdet, der sammen med os vil være med til at løfte vores børnehave til næste niveau.

Måske er det dig?

Måske er du optaget af musik og fællessang.
Måske elsker du udeliv, natur og ture ud af huset.
Måske er du god til fortællinger, teater eller til at skabe fantasifulde legeuniverser.

Eller måske er din største styrke, at du møder børn med varme, nærvær og en særlig evne til at få alle med i fællesskabet.

Hos os er der plads til forskellige pædagogiske interesser og kompetencer – for vi tror på, at stærke børnefællesskaber skabes af voksne, der bringer deres faglighed og personlighed i spil.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:
Som pædagog i børnehaven bliver du en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt team, hvor du blandt andet vil:
  • Planlægge og deltage aktivt i børnenes lege, aktiviteter og hverdag
  • Understøtte børns sprog gennem leg, sang, fortælling, samtaler og fælles aktiviteter
  • Bidrage med dine egne interesser og pædagogiske idéer til aktiviteter og projekter i børnehaven
  • Støtte børn i at indgå i lege og fællesskaber
  • Samarbejde med forældre om børnenes trivsel, udvikling og hverdag

Vi søger en pædagog, der:
  • Er uddannet pædagog
  • Ikke kan lade være med at bringe sine interesser og kompetencer i spil i arbejdet med børn
  • Kan skabe trygge relationer til både børn, forældre og kolleger
  • Er nysgerrig på pædagogisk praksis og bidrager til faglige refleksioner og udvikling
  • Har blik for børns forskellige behov og deltagelsesmuligheder

Som person:
  • Møder du børn og forældre med nærvær, nysgerrighed og autenticitet
  • Har du ro, overblik og struktur
  • Bidrager du aktivt til fællesskabet med humor, engagement og initiativ
  • Er du fagligt reflekteret og har lyst til både at lære og dele viden med dine kolleger

Hvem er vi?
Schous Børnehus er en selvejende integreret daginstitution midt i Københavns Nordvestkvarter – tæt på både Utterslev Mose, byens liv og kulturtilbud.

Vi holder til i en tidligere sæbefabrik, hvor det stadig bobler af leg, nysgerrighed og livsglæde.

Hos os tror vi på, at gode relationer er fundamentet for udvikling – både for børn og voksne. Vi arbejder målrettet med sprog, fællesskaber og udviklende læringsmiljøer, og vi prioriterer tid til faglig refleksion og samarbejde i hverdagen.

I Schous Børnehus er det trygt at fejle og let at få idéer i spil. Hos os er det vigtigt, at vi lykkes sammen.

Vi tilbyder dig:
  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer i børnehaven
  • Tiltrædelse 1. december 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter
  • Et fagligt stærkt fællesskab med høje ambitioner på børnenes vegne
  • Løbende faglig opkvalificering
  • En grundig mentorordning for en tryg opstart
  • To årlige personalearrangementer og to temadage med overnatning
  • Gode fysiske rammer og aktiv brug af lokalområdet
  • En hverdag præget af arbejdsglæde, initiativ og gensidig støtte

Se vores video "Arbejdspladsen man ikke vil hjem fra" på YouTube og få et indblik i vores hverdag.

Interesseret?
Du er meget velkommen til at ringe eller kigge forbi til en rundvisning – vi fortæller gerne mere om vores børnehus.

Kontakt leder, Mia Kehlet på tlf. 3062 8104 .

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag/referencer til: leder@schousbornehus.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet det rette match.

Måske er det dig, der skal være den sidste pædagog på holdet i Schous Børnehus.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst med BUPL.

jobs.title: Paid Social Specialist – bliv ekspert i én branche
jobs.description:
Hjælp top 1 % med at blive endnu rigere
Fuldtid · Fysisk på kontoret ved Vesterport, København · Start hurtigst muligt

På Vinduespudserskolen starter man typisk som elev, fordi man drømmer om mere frihed i sin hverdag.

Det er helt simpelt. Forestil dig, at vinduespudseren kommer ud til en kunde på det tidspunkt, der passer ham. Han pudser huset hele vejen rundt på 5 minutter, systemet sender automatisk en faktura på 399 kr. til kunden og navigerer ham videre til næste kunde på vejen.

Så kan man selv regne på det. Gør du det én gang om dagen, 22 dage om måneden, har du 8.778 kr. i omsætning. Gør du som de andre, bare 15 gange om dagen, omsætter du for 131.670 kr. om måneden. Og så er der selvfølgelig dem, der præsterer det dobbelte, og dem, der snart runder 1 mio. kr. om måneden (hvor deres ansatte udfører opgaven, ansatte de også får oplært på skolen)

Et opslag skal jo have en fængende overskrift, men for at forklare den: Modellen har været udgangspunktet for, at vi har hjulpet mange af vores elever til at blive blandt de 1 % rigeste i deres aldersgruppe. Typisk folk, der ikke passede ind i den traditionelle skole.

Kort sagt er det grundlaget for Vinduespudserskolen. Med systemer og intensiv træning, fra håndværket nede på skolen til hele forretningen, fx at sælge til højere priser og med hyppigere intervaller, optimerer vi for eleverne. Vi er et fuldtidsteam, der ikke laver andet end at støtte, udvikle og træne vores elever i det, de har brug for.

Når eleverne har lært at sælge gode priser, gode intervaller og mange naboer, hjælper vi dem også med at reinvestere en del i tiltag som Meta Ads. Det må dog aldrig være deres eneste kilde til nye kunder.

Det er her, du kommer ind

Malte står i dag for at køre annoncer for en lang række elever. De sidste 4 år har han ikke lavet andet end at skaffe de bedste kunder til vinduespudserfirmaer, så han har en stor specialviden på området. Nu er vi nået dertil, hvor vi gerne vil have en ekstra person med på teamet til at arbejde sammen med Malte.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med Meta Ads, som du kan vise frem. Google Ads er et plus, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du aldrig bliver helt tilfreds og hele tiden vil finde ud af, hvordan en kampagne kan blive bedre.

Du følger med i, hvad der sker med AI, og bruger det aktivt, fx med Make, til at automatisere rapportering og de opgaver, vi gør igen og igen. Ikke for at gøre tingene med hovedet under armen, men for at frigive tid, så vi kan bruge den på det, der gør en forskel for eleverne: at forstå dem, tale med dem og give dem et bedre og mere personligt produkt.

Du kommer til at holde møder med eleverne og være med på hele funnelen, fra annonce til hjemmeside. Hjemmesiderne udliciterer vi i dag, men dem vil vi gerne lave selv fremover. Og så skal du have lyst til at blive rigtig dygtig til ét område.

Opfylder du ikke alle punkter, men kan du genkende dig selv i det meste, så søg alligevel.

Hvem du er

Du starter med en intensiv oplæring. Vi forestiller os, at du tager ansvar for det, du har lovet en elev, og leverer det. Du er punktlig med dine aftaler og forventer det samme af andre. Og du kan lide at arbejde i et team.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst team, der gerne vil have, at du udvikler dig sammen med os. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på fuldtid, og du arbejder fysisk fra vores kontor ved Vesterport i København. Vi vil gerne have dig med hurtigst muligt.

Sådan søger du

Før du søger, så gå ind på Vinduespudserskolens YouTube og få et indtryk af, hvilken type virksomhed vi er.

Send derefter en kort ansøgning til job@vinduespudserskolen.dk med emnet "Paid Social – dit navn". Fortæl os, hvorfor du mener, du er den rette til jobbet.

jobs.title: Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown
jobs.description:
Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown

Vil du jobbe tett på ledelsen, internasjonale prosjekter og beslutningene som faktisk betyr noe?

Podtown er i sterk utvikling og bygger nå organisasjonen for neste fase. Vi utvikler og leverer modulære rom- og infrastrukturløsninger til krevende markeder som forsvar og beredskap. Nå søker vi en Business Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i selskapet – tett på ledelsen, prosjektene og den operative virksomheten.

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell controllerrolle hvor hovedoppgaven er å rapportere på det som allerede har skjedd. Vi ser etter deg som vil forstå hva som skjer i virksomheten, se fremover og bidra til bedre beslutninger.

Regnskapet håndteres i stor grad eksternt. Din viktigste jobb blir derfor å sørge for at Podtown har kontroll på prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser, marginer og økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag. Rollen skal være Podtowns interne økonomiske kontrollpunkt og en viktig sparringspartner for ledelsen.

En rolle med reell påvirkning

Podtown har en liten og kompetent organisasjon og arbeider med komplekse leveranser mot internasjonale kunder. Selskapet har etablert seg i forsvarsmarkedet og står foran en fase hvor både prosjektene og organisasjonen skal skaleres.

Som Business Controller får du en bred rolle. Du vil blant annet:

  • etablere og følge opp prosjektbudsjetter, faktiske kostnader, committed cost, forecast, inntekter og marginer

  • bygge og følge opp rullerende likviditets- og cash flow-prognoser

  • analysere avvik og bidra til at tiltak blir satt inn tidlig

  • etablere en enkel og robust struktur for månedsrapportering, periodiseringer og avsetninger

  • arbeide tett med prosjektansvarlige, leverandører og produksjonspartnere for å forstå kostnadsdrivere, kapasitet og risiko

  • utarbeide økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag og rapportering til CEO, styre og eiere

  • støtte selskapet i dialog med bank, revisor, regnskapsfører og øvrige rådgivere

  • bidra i finansierings-, garanti-, forsikrings- og kapitalprosesser

  • bygge Podtowns egne økonomiske arbeidsprosesser og systemer etter hvert som virksomheten vokser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har noen års erfaring fra controlling, prosjektøkonomi eller økonomistyring og nå ønsker deg nærmere både virksomheten og beslutningene.

Du kan for eksempel arbeide som Business Controller, Project Controller, prosjektøkonom eller Financial Controller i dag. Erfaring fra prosjektbasert virksomhet, industri, maritim sektor, energi eller tilsvarende vil være relevant, men er ikke et absolutt krav.

Vi ser særlig etter deg som har:

  • høyere utdanning innen økonomi, finans eller regnskap

  • gjerne rundt 3–7 års relevant erfaring

  • god forståelse for regnskap og økonomiske sammenhenger

  • interesse for prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser og business partnering

  • gode ferdigheter i Excel og god systemforståelse

  • evne til å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger forståelige og beslutningsrelevante.

Like viktig er hvordan du jobber.

Du trives i et miljø med tempo, korte beslutningsveier og tydelige forventninger. Du er selvstendig nok til å drive egne områder fremover, men samtidig trygg nok til å diskutere, utfordre og sparre med ledelsen når tallene tilsier det.

Du trenger ikke være den som alltid har det mest kompliserte regnearket. Viktigere er det at du forstår hva tallene betyr, ser hva som krever handling og klarer å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger konkrete og beslutningsrelevante.

Vi tror du vil lykkes godt i rollen dersom du:

  • tar eierskap og følger opp til ting faktisk er ferdige

  • arbeider strukturert og trives med ansvar

  • er analytisk, men også pragmatisk og løsningsorientert

  • kommuniserer tydelig på både norsk og engelsk, og tør å stå for egne faglige vurderinger

    bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt på tvers

  • trives med frihet innen tydelige rammer

Hvorfor Podtown?

Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å komme inn på et tidspunkt hvor du faktisk kan være med og forme hvordan økonomifunksjonen skal fungere.

Du får:

  • stor påvirkning og kort vei fra analyse til beslutning

  • tett samarbeid med CEO, COO og selskapets ledelse

  • ansvar for økonomien i komplekse og internasjonale prosjekter

  • innsikt i et spennende marked med krevende kunder og leveranser

  • mulighet til å bygge systemer, arbeidsprosesser og rapportering – ikke bare overta dem

  • en rolle som kan utvikle seg mot et bredere økonomiansvar etter hvert som Podtown vokser.

Du vil få betydelig ansvar og handlingsrom, samtidig som det forventes fremdrift, kvalitet og selvstendighet i rollen.

Podtown passer særlig godt for deg som ønsker mer ansvar og større påvirkning enn du typisk får som én av mange controllere i et større konsern.

Arbeidssted

Grieg Gaarden, Bergen
Stillingen er 100 % og rapporterer til CEO.

jobs.title: Vastaanottovirkailijoita Break Sokos Hotel Kolille ja Break Sokos Hotel Koli Kylälle
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIEKSA

Sokos Hotels – tehtävänä Onnellistaminen

Vastaanottovirkailijoita Break Sokos Hotel Kolille ja Break Sokos Hotel Koli Kylälle

Etsimme kahta iloista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä vastaanottovirkailijaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Kolin hotelleille (Break Sokos Hotel Koli ja Break Sokos Hotel Koli Kylä). Meillä pääset osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen päivä on erilainen ja jossa yhdessä luomme vieraillemme elämyksiä, jotka jäävät mieleen pitkäksi aikaa.

Työsuhteet ovat määräaikaisia 8.8.2027 saakka ja tunteja tarjoamme 60 h / 3 viikkoa. Sinulla on mahdollisuus saada lisää tunteja ristiintyöskentelemällä myös molempien hotellin muilla osastoilla. Työsuhteet alkavat 26.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Break Sokos Hotel Koli sijaitsee Kolin vaarojen laella henkeäsalpaavissa maisemissa. Break Sokos Hotel Koli Kylä puolestaan toimii Kolin kylän lämpimänä sydämenä. Yhteensä hotelleissamme on 209 huonetta, Koli Relax Spa, useita ravintoloita sekä monipuolisia vapaa-ajan palveluita.

Mitä työ sisältää?
Vastaanottovirkailijana olet usein ensimmäinen ja viimeinen ihminen, jonka vieras kohtaa. Vastaanotossa huolehdit sujuvasta asiakaspalvelusta ja viihtyisästä vierailukokemuksesta alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu mm. asiakkaiden vastaanottoa ja uloskirjaamista, huonevarausten käsittelyä ja asiakkaiden neuvontaa alueen palveluista ja aktiviteeteista. Lisäksi työhösi kuuluu Koli Relax Span lipunmyyntiä, kahvilan ja ravintolan kassapalveluita sekä Koli Safariksen vuokravälineiden käsittelyä ja luovutusta. Työ sisältää työskentelyä kaikkina vuorokauden aikoina ja kaikkina viikonpäivinä.

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?
Edellytämme sinulta suomen ja englannin sujuvaa kielitaitoa, anniskelu- ja hygieniapassia ja ajokorttia, aktiivista ja positiivista asennetta sekä osaamista digitalisoituvassa työympäristössä. Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen vastaanottotyössä sekä Opera Cloud-järjestelmän tuntemuksen.

Haemme nyt asiakaspalvelun sydämensä asiaksi kokevaa hotellialan ammattilaista työskentelemään hotelliemme vastaanotossa. Olet tehokas ja energinen ammattilainen ja nautit asiakkaiden palvelemisesta. Teet työtäsi innostuneesti, positiivisella otteella ja osaat toimia myös paineen alla etkä hätkähdä vaihtelevia tilanteita. Olet sosiaalinen, joustava ja sinulla on hyvät yhteistyötaidot. Etsimme luotettavaa ja sitoutunutta tekijää.

Tule mukaan luomaan vieraillemme aikaa, energiaa ja unohtumattomia elämyksiä Kolin upeisiin maisemiin.

Meillä työtä tehdään Break-arvojen mukaisesti
Välitän mitä välitän
Meille aito välittäminen näkyy jokaisessa kohtaamisessa. Huomaamme asiakkaan tarpeet, autamme työkaveria kiireen keskellä ja haluamme luoda vieraillemme kokemuksia, jotka ylittävät odotukset.
Vastuu on minun
Otamme vastuuta omasta työstämme, asiakkaiden viihtymisestä ja yhteisistä tavoitteista. Meillä jokainen voi vaikuttaa siihen, millainen kokemus asiakkaalle syntyy.
Kehitän ja kehityn
Kannustamme oppimaan uutta ja kokeilemaan rohkeasti. Monipuolinen työympäristö tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kasvattaa osaamista vastaanotosta ravintola- ja vapaa-ajapalveluihin.
Breaking the pattern
Emme tyydy tavanomaiseen. Haluamme yllättää asiakkaamme positiivisesti ja etsimme jatkuvasti uusia tapoja tehdä asioita entistä paremmin.

Hae rohkeasti mukaan työyhteisöömme, jossa välittäminen, vastuu, kehittyminen ja uudenlainen ajattelu näkyvät jokaisessa työpäivässä.

Monipuolisen työskentely-ympäristön lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi isossa toimipaikkaverkostossamme. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja tuemme sinua onnistumaan tehtävässäsi. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijöillämme on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamistaan. Lisäksi saat käyttöösi erinomaiset PKO:n ja S-ryhmän henkilökuntaeduthttps://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut. Meillä työnantaja on vakuuttanut jokaisen työntekijän myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella, ja liikkumistasi kannustamme Epassilla.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa hotellipäällikkö Noora Väisänen, noora.vaisanen@sok.fi tai puhelimitse arkisin klo 9-15 numerosta +358 10 762 3640. Hakuaika päättyy 18.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja olemme yhteydessä kaikkiin ehdokkaisiin rekrytointiprosessin edetessä.

Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
  • Assisting the mechanical team if needed
  • Helping out the other teams when necessary

Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

  • Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
  • Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
