jobs.title: Kok / Cater – DinnerdeLuxe UCL Seebladsgade, Odense
jobs.description:
Er du faglært kok eller cater, og holder du lige så meget af at lave rigtig god mad, som vi gør? Så kan det være dig, vi mangler på holdet hos DinnerdeLuxe.

Vi søger en ny kollega, der sætter en ære i godt håndværk, gode råvarer og høj kvalitet – og som trives i et køkken, hvor der er tempo på, godt humør og plads til at være en del af et stærkt team. Hos os laver vi mad fra bunden, og hver dag arbejder vi for at give vores gæster en madoplevelse, de glæder sig til.

Vi tilbyder

·         En spændende stilling i et moderne og bæredygtigt kantinekoncept

·         Gode kollegaer og et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde, kvalitet og madglæde

·         En hverdag med god energi, faglig stolthed og plads til dine idéer

·         Ordentlige arbejdstider og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

·         Gode og ordnede ansættelsesforhold med kantineoverenskomst, pension og sundhedssikring

Om jobbet

Som kok/cater hos DinnerdeLuxe får du din hverdag i kantinen og køkkenet på UCL Seebladsgade i Odense – og her er der masser af liv. UCL samler mange forskellige uddannelser under samme tag, og hver dag mødes husets studerende og medarbejdere i kantinen til god mad og en pause sammen.

Du bliver en del af et fantastisk fællesskab og et køkken, hvor du får frihed til at bruge dit håndværk, komme med idéer og sætte dit eget aftryk på maden. For os er det fedeste, når gæsterne glæder sig til frokost – og når vi kan overraske dem med nye smage, favoritter og retter, de får lyst til at tage en ekstra portion af.

Vi laver både varme og kolde retter, farverige og sprøde salater, lækkert pålæg og velsmagende plantebaserede alternativer – altid med fokus på godt håndværk, gode råvarer og masser af smag.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Produktion af mad til kantinens gæster

  • Arbejde i både det varme og kolde køkken

  • Anretning og klargøring af mødeforplejning

  • Deltagelse i opvask, rengøring og almindelige køkkenopgaver

Om dig

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Er uddannet kok eller cater (krav)

  • Har erfaring fra storkøkken, kantine eller catering

  • Er passioneret omkring mad, kvalitet og præcision

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret, stabil og fleksibel

  • Arbejder struktureret – altid med et smil

Du har gerne kørekort (ikke et krav, men en fordel), og du trives med at tage ansvar og være en del af et team, der løfter i flok.

Arbejdstid

Fuldtidsstilling (37 timer pr. uge) med arbejdstid mellem kl. 6.00 og 16.00 på hverdage.

Der kan forekomme aften og weekend arbejde til arrangementer.

Tiltrædelse

Snarest muligt.
Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Ansøgning og spørgsmål

Spørgsmål
Kontakt Site Manager Helle Hvidsten for spørgsmål til stillingen:
Mobil: 31151563

Send din ansøgning og CV (meget gerne med referencer) til:
Site Manager Helle Hvidsten
helle.hvidsten@dinnerdeluxe.dk
Skriv ”Kok/Cater” i emnefeltet.

Hvis du vedlægger referencer, betragter vi det som samtykke til, at vi må kontakte dem.

Af hensyn til GDPR skal ansøgningen sendes til ovenstående mailadresse, og du skal kun oplyse nødvendige personoplysninger som navn, telefonnummer og mailadresse.

Om DinnerdeLuxe:

DinnerdeLuxe er familieejet, og vi har begge ben solidt plantet på jorden. Her er der ikke langt fra idé til handling – eller fra medarbejder til ledelse. Vi kender hinanden, hjælper hinanden og tror på, at de bedste arbejdspladser skabes af mennesker, der trives sammen. For i sidste ende er det menneskene, der er DinnerdeLuxe – og det gode fællesskab er fundamentet for alt det, vi skaber sammen.

jobs.title: Pædagoger søges til fuldtidsvikariat på specialskole på Fyn
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af et fast team og bidrage til en tryg,
struktureret og udviklende skoledag for børn med særlige behov? 
Udviklingsbasen søger pædagogiske medarbejdere til et vikariat som udgangspunkt er på 37 timer om ugen, på en specialskole på Fyn. Vikariatet starter hurtigst muligt og løber frem til jul. Du får dit eget skema og bliver tilknyttet det faste team omkring den eller de klasser, du skal arbejde i. 

Om skolen og børnene 
Børnene har forskellige udfordringer, som påvirker deres evne til hensigtsmæssig følelsesregulering. Det kan blandt andet være ADHD, adfærd inden for autismespektret, angst eller relations- og tilknytningsvanskeligheder. Børnene er i udgangspunktet normalt begavede. Skolen har både undervisning og morgen- og eftermiddags-SFO. 

Din rolle i hverdagen 
Du får timer i både skolen og SFO'en. Arbejdet vil primært være i indskolingen og/eller på mellemtrinnet. Dog skal du være fleksibel og kunne træde til i andre klasser ved behov. Som en del af det faste team skal du bidrage aktivt til en stabil hverdag, følge skolens pædagogiske retning og samarbejde tæt med dine kolleger om børnenes trivsel, deltagelse og udvikling. 

Vi søger dig, der 
Vi ser meget gerne, at du er uddannet pædagog og har erfaring med børn, der har behov for tydelig struktur, nærvær og professionel støtte til følelsesregulering. Det er vigtigt, at du kan skabe ro og forudsigelighed, indgå loyalt i skolens pædagogiske arbejde og bidrage konstruktivt til det tværfaglige samarbejde. Du skal samtidig kunne være fleksibel og bevare overblikket i en omskiftelig hverdag. 

Arbejdstid og ansættelse 
Stillingen er i udgangspunkt på37 timer om ugen med arbejdstid på alle hverdage mellem kl. 07.15 og 16.00. Du får et skema, så du får en forudsigelig arbejdsuge og mulighed for at blive en integreret del af skolens hverdag og faglige fællesskab. 

Det tilbyder vi 
Hos Udviklingsbasen får du mulighed for at bruge og udvikle dine pædagogiske kompetencer i en specialiseret skolekontekst. Du bliver en del af et fast team, får et tydeligt arbejdsgrundlag og kan opbygge værdifuld erfaring med special pædagogik, skole og SFO. Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, ordentlighed og tæt dialog gennem hele forløbet. 

Opstart og ansøgning 
Inden opstart inviteres du til en samtale på skolen, så både du og skolen får mulighed for at afstemme forventninger og sikre det rette match. Vi ansætter løbende og ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, så send gerne din korte ansøgning og dit CV via ansøgningsformularen her på siden. 

 

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på 75 66 11 22.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

  • Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

    • Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

    • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

    • Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

    • Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

  • Production Support & Continuous Improvement

    • Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

    • Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

  •   Technical leadership

    • Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

  • Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

    • With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

    • Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

      • Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

      • Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

      • Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

  • Experience

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

    • Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

    • Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

    • Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

    • Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

  • Technical Expertise

    • Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

    • Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

    • Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

    • Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

    • Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

  • Management & Interpersonal Skills

    • High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

    • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

    • Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

    • Contractor control

    • Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

  • Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

  • Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

  • Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

  • A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

  • Good safety attitude

  • Can do attitude

jobs.title: Ingénieur Avant-Vente Défense et Sécurité F/H

jobs.title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
jobs.description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Responsable Approvisionnement Biomasse H/F
jobs.description:
MISSIONS :
- Rédige et tient à jour les procédures concernant la mobilisation sur chantier de défriche agricole, urbaine ou forestière, de récupération de connexes de scieries, de bois en fin de vie ou autre sourcing biomasse,
- Assure la prospection et la recherche de fournisseurs/ sous traitant de biomasse ou transporteur de biomasse,
- Pilote le choix, la négociation, et la contractualisation des achats de biomasse ou de gestion de chantiers de défriches ou forestiers en concertation avec sa direction,
- Soumet à sa direction les choix d'achats de biomasse,
- A un œil vigilant sur la conformité réglementaire de l'origine de la biomasse en lien avec sa direction,
- Planifie et organise les livraisons de biomasse (hebdomadaire, mensuel, annuel) pour assurer un approvisionnement permettant le fonctionnement de la ou des centrales en production,
- Planifie, contrôle et coordonne les activités d'exploitation forestières (abattage, débardage, broyage, transport, stockage) pour les chantiers de l'équipe de mobilisation,
- Organise les opérations de stockage/déstockage sur parc de rupture le cas échéant,
- Suit les contrats en communication permanente avec la responsable de parc à bois,
- Informe le Responsable de parc en cas de difficultés d'approvisionnement ou de changement de volume livré au jour le jour pour permettre la coordination appro/réception,
- Réalise les calculs de coût de biomasse réel/ chantier,
- Programme et organise les chantiers de défriche selon une stratégie définie et validé par la direction,
- Recherche des solutions à toutes situations problématiques rencontrées sur le terrain ou avec les parties prenantes en créant de nouvelle procédure au besoin.
- Fais de chaque expérience une analyse permettant d'améliorer les procédures dans l'ensemble.

PILOTAGE FINANCIER ET ADMINISTRATIF DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- S'assure du respect des objectifs budgétaires fixés par la direction Providex et des objectifs d'approvisionnement de biomasse, il engage et suit les commandes de biomasse auprès des fournisseurs en concertation avec la direction,
- Tient à jours les indicateurs de coûts sur la biomasse en concertation avec la responsable de parc à bois qui suit la réception de la biomasse,
- Analyse les indicateurs, pointe les écarts et dysfonctionnements, propose des solutions à la direction.

MANAGEMENT DES ÉQUIPES DE L'APPROVISIONNEMENT BIOMASSE :
- Manage et anime l'équipe de mobilisation (mobilisateurs),
- S'assure de la continuité de service dans l'équipe mobilisateurs,
- Identifie, valorise et développe les compétences de ses collaborateurs en proposant des formations appropriées,
- Participe aux groupes de travail au sein de la centrale, destinés à améliorer l'appareil de production ou les conditions de travail,
- S'assure de la prévention des risques professionnels sur l'activité qu'il encadre en lien avec sa direction,
- Assure la mise en place de procédure adéquate avec le ou la SQE sur les chantiers de mobilisation.

SÉCURITÉ :
- Suit et veille à faire appliquer les recommandations du SQE  sur les chantiers,
- Informe la direction et QSEE de tout incident, accident ou situation à risque, et traite l'anomalie en conséquence,
- Veille à l'application de toutes les règles et procédures de sécurité établies.

ENVIRONNEMENT :
- Veille en permanence au respect absolu des normes environnementale sur chantier,
- Anticipe toutes anomalies à venir, agit et fait agir en conséquence.

QUALITÉ :
- Décline la politique qualité qui sera déployée,
- Applique et fait appliquer les procédures du SMI,
- Suit les non conformités, actions correctives et préventives,
- Renseigne et suit les indicateurs biomasse mis en place par la direction,
- Suit et applique les recommandations du QSEE,
- Informe le personnel de la politique et de l'application des dispositions Qualité qui seront mis en place.

jobs.title: Kom i mesterlære som tjener på Hindsgavl Slot
jobs.description:
Begynd din tjeneruddannelse hos os - med løn fra dag ét. I flotte og historiske rammer på Hindsgavl Slot lærer du alt det, en dygtig tjener skal kunne - inden for mad, vin, service og drift. Ingen skole det første år.

"Som elev på Hindsgavl Slot har jeg været omgivet af dygtige fagfolk, der gerne vil lære fra sig. De har fået mig til at føle mig som en ligeværdig kollega, og jeg fik også tidligt en del ansvar. Det har udviklet mig meget - og det har været en god måde at lære på. Samtidig er det sjovt at gå på arbejde, og dagene er så forskellige."

Sådan fortæller vores tidligere tjenerelev Laura om sin læretid på Hindsgavl Slot. Laura fortsætter på slottet som udlært tjener, og vi søger nu en ny elev til vores erfarne og fagligt stærke tjenerteam. Her står Laura og hendes tjenerkolleger klar til at lære dig alt det, en dygtig tjener skal kunne - inden for mad, vin, service og drift.

I tjenerteamet såvel som i resten af huset er vi gode til at hjælpe og sparre med hinanden. Her går vi det ekstra skridt, som vores gæster husker os for.

Om Ny mesterlære

Ved et tage din grunduddannelse i Ny mesterlære kan du gennem praktisk, lønnet arbejde kvalificere dig til hovedforløbet.

  • Løn fra dag ét
  • Praktisk læring og erfaring
  • Ingen skole det første år
  • Afsluttende praktisk prøve

OBS: Har du allerede gennemført grundforløbet, er du også velkommen til at søge elevpladsen.

Om dig

Du er nysgerrig og klar til at lære nyt hver eneste dag. For to dage er sjældent ens på Hindsgavl Slot. Den ene dag servicerer du gæster i vores hyggelige café, og den næste kan det være 700 gæster til stående frokost i Slotsladen eller 3.000 til koncert i parken. Og så er der alt det derimellem.

Du har et godt humør og er af natur smilende, udadvendt og ansvarsfuld. Du bidrager til holdånden og samarbejdet i tjenerteamet såvel som på tværs af slottets forskellige afdelinger.

Om dine opgaver

På Hindsgavl Slot kommer du godt omkring i tjenerfagets discipliner. Sammen med dine kolleger arbejder du med alt fra planlægning til afvikling.

Du bliver desuden klogere på både gastronomiens og vinens verden, og du vil erfare, at gæster er forskellige og har forskellige forventninger og behov. Her lærer du at komme dem alle i møde på en professionel måde.

Om Hindsgavl Slot 

Hindsgavl Slot ligger mellem vand og skov lidt uden for Middelfart på Vestfyn. Stedets historie går helt tilbage til det 12. århundrede, og i disse historiske rammer driver vi et moderne hotel og konferencecenter. Her er plads til både store og små arrangementer, fest og farver samt afslapning og hygge.

Gennem tider har vi udlært mange dygtige tjenere. Vi er derfor vant til at lære fra os og hjælpe vores elever til gode resultater og en fremtidig karriere inden for hospitalitybranchen. Flere af vores elever har desuden valgt branchen til, efter at de har prøvet kræfter med den her hos os.

Hindsgavl Slot er en mangfoldig og ansvarlig arbejdsplads med ordentlige forhold og vilkår.

Send os en ansøgning 

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, til vi finder den rette kandidat. Send os derfor din ansøgning snarest. Skriv lidt om dig selv, og hvorfor du gerne vil være tjener.

Ansøgningen sender du sammen med et vellignende foto af dig selv til F&B chef Peter Vinther-Wilhelmsen på pvw@hindsgavl.dk. Det er også ham, du skal kontakte, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Enten på mailen eller ved at ringe 64 41 88 00.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig - og forhåbentlig byde dig velkommen på vores elevteam.

jobs.title: Tekniker / montør med flytteopgaver søges – deltid eller fuldtid
jobs.description:
Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS

På grund af stigende aktivitet søger vi en dygtig og praktisk anlagt tekniker/montør, som har lyst til en alsidig hverdag med montage, demontering, tekniske opgaver og specialtransport.

Vores primære behov er en medarbejder til montage- og teknikeropgaver. Der vil også forekomme almindelige flytteopgaver, og derfor skal du være indstillet på at hjælpe til med flytning og fysisk arbejde, når opgaverne kræver det.

Stillingen kan være deltid eller fuldtid, afhængigt af dine ønsker, erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Montering og demontering af fitnessudstyr og træningsmaskiner

  • Samling, opstilling og justering af maskiner og teknisk udstyr

  • Nedtagning og klargøring af udstyr til transport

  • Indbæring og placering af maskiner og specialudstyr

  • Brug af almindeligt håndværktøj og elværktøj

  • Praktiske og tekniske opgaver hos vores erhvervskunder

  • Specialtransport og håndtering af tungt eller teknisk udstyr

  • Fejlfinding og mindre tekniske opgaver, hvor det er relevant

  • Flytteopgaver for private og erhvervskunder efter behov

  • Andre praktiske montage- og specialopgaver

Vi arbejder med mange forskellige typer opgaver og udstyr. Det kan eksempelvis være fitnessmaskiner, teknisk udstyr, maskiner, pengeskabe, klaverer, flygler og andet specialinventar.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er praktisk anlagt og har god teknisk forståelse

  • Har erfaring med montage, teknik, mekanik eller lignende – eller stor interesse for området

  • Kan bruge almindeligt håndværktøj og elværktøj

  • Kan finde løsninger, når en opgave ikke altid går helt efter planen

  • Er omhyggelig og passer godt på kundernes maskiner og udstyr

  • Har god fysik og kan deltage i flytte- og løfteopgaver

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og sammen med kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

  • Erfaring med fitnessmaskiner eller andet teknisk udstyr

  • Erfaring med flyttearbejde eller specialtransport

Det er dog ikke et krav, at du kommer fra flyttebranchen.

Vi vægter teknisk forståelse, praktiske evner og den rette indstilling højt.

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel arbejdsplads

  • Ordentlige arbejdsforhold

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi leder først og fremmest efter en tekniker/montør – ikke kun en traditionel flyttemand.

Du skal kunne lide at arbejde med hænderne, bruge værktøj og finde praktiske løsninger. Samtidig skal du være indstillet på, at vi er en flytte- og transportvirksomhed, og at der derfor også vil være dage, hvor du hjælper med almindelige flytteopgaver.

Hos Buchtrups Flytteforretning 2016 ApS er dagene forskellige. Den ene dag kan du demontere og montere fitnessmaskiner, og den næste dag kan du være med til at flytte og opstille tungt specialudstyr hos en erhvervskunde.

Kan du skrue, samle, montere og finde praktiske løsninger – og er du samtidig klar til at tage fat – så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Forskningsprojekt Arven i Landskabet
jobs.description:
Museum Odense søger en postdoc til en etårig stilling i forskningsprojektet Arven i Landskabet.

Forskningsprojektet

Det danske landskab står over for nogle af de største forandringer i nyere tid. Med Den Grønne Trepart og en række andre natur-, klima- og miljøtiltag skal store arealer i de kommende år ændre anvendelse. Landbrug, natur, biodiversitet, klima og lokale interesser skal finde nye balancer. Men det er ikke første gang, det danske landskab gennemgår en grundlæggende omstilling.

Arven i Landskabet undersøger det store brud i det danske landskabs udvikling ca. 1780-1914. I løbet af denne periode blev et varieret og mange steder ekstensivt udnyttet kulturlandskab forandret til et stadig mere intensivt landbrugslandskab. Gennem analyser af blandt andet historiske kort, nationale data og lokale kilder undersøger projektet, hvad der drev forandringerne, hvordan de udspillede sig forskelligt fra sted til sted, og hvilken betydning landskabets fysiske rammer, teknologiske muligheder, økonomiske interesser og menneskers valg havde.

Projektet stopper imidlertid ikke i 1914. Et centralt mål er at bringe den historiske viden i spil i den aktuelle grønne omstilling. Hvad kan tidligere tiders gennemgribende landskabsforandringer fortælle os om de processer, konflikter og muligheder, der præger omstillingen i dag? Og hvordan kan et langt historisk perspektiv kvalificere vores forståelse af de valg, der nu træffes om fremtidens landskab?

Projektet er støttet af Augustinus Fonden 2026-2029 og placeret på Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum. Din arbejdsplads bliver på Museum Odense. Læs mere på https://museumodense.dk/forskningsartikler/arven-i-landskabet/.

Stillingen

Som postdoc får du en central rolle i den del af Arven i Landskabet, der forbinder projektets historiske undersøgelser med de landskabsforandringer, der finder sted i Danmark netop nu.

En væsentlig opgave bliver at undersøge, hvordan nutidens landmænd, lodsejere og andre lokale aktører oplever og forholder sig til den grønne omstilling og til konkrete forandringer i det landskab, de lever og arbejder i. Det gælder blandt andet processer og naturprojekter knyttet til Den Grønne Trepart. Gennem kvalitative interviews og, hvor det er relevant, surveys og andre analyser skal du undersøge aktørernes perspektiver, handlemuligheder og interesser samt de muligheder og konflikter, der opstår, når hensyn til landbrugsproduktion, klima, biodiversitet, natur og lokalsamfund mødes.

Undersøgelserne skal sættes i relation til projektets historiske forskning. Du kommer dermed til at arbejde med spørgsmål som: Hvordan gennemføres store landskabsforandringer lokalt? Hvad får mennesker til at medvirke til, modsætte sig eller forsøge at påvirke dem? Hvilken betydning har erfaringer, ejerskab, økonomi, natursyn og tilknytning til landskabet? Og hvad kan erfaringerne fra tidligere perioder med omfattende landskabsforandringer bidrage med til de beslutninger, vi træffer i dag?

Opgaven har således en klar ramme, men der er samtidig betydeligt forskningsmæssigt råderum. Afhængigt af din faglige profil og dine interesser får du mulighed for at præge undersøgelsens forskningsspørgsmål, teoretiske perspektiv, metode og konkrete empiriske fokus inden for projektets overordnede problemstillinger.

Du bliver en del af en tværfaglig forskningsgruppe på tværs af Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum og vil arbejde tæt sammen med projektets øvrige forskere. Stillingen indebærer både selvstændigt forskningsarbejde og deltagelse i projektets fælles aktiviteter. Du forventes blandt andet at bidrage til projektets dataindsamling og analyser, videnskabelige publikationer, den afsluttende antologi og et fagligt symposium samt til formidling af forskningen til en bredere offentlighed og den aktuelle debat om fremtidens landskab.

Kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har en ph.d.-grad eller tilsvarende inden for f.eks. etnologi, antropologi, historie eller tilsvarende relevante fag.
  • Har erfaring med interviews til forskningsundersøgelser.
  • Har interesse for landskabsforskning og -forvaltning.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Har kørekort B, da der kan forventes kørsel i arbejdstiden. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Et tværfagligt og spændende forskningsmiljø, heriblandt fire andre forskere ved Arven i Landskabet i Odense.
  • Deltagelse i den større tværfaglige projektgruppe med forskere på Aarhus Universitet, Det Grønne Museum og Museum Odense (heriblandt Den Fynske Landsby).
  • En kombination af klart definerede projektopgaver og forskningsmæssigt råderum til at udvikle egne spørgsmål og analyser inden for projektets ramme.

Ansøgning og ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

  • En motiveret ansøgning (maks. 2 sider), hvor du redegør for:
    • din motivation for at søge stillingen
    • dine kvalifikationer i forhold til opslaget
    • en kort beskrivelse af, hvordan du vil tilgå projektet forskningsmæssigt
  • CV (maks. 2 sider)
  • En kopi af kandidatbevis og evt. ph.d.-bevis
  • Publikationsliste med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, som ønskes taget i betragtning ved bedømmelsen
  • Maksimalt 2 vedhæftede publikationer til bedømmelse.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. nov. 2026

Vi anvender shortlisting, hvor et antal ansøgere udvælges til bedømmelse af deres faglige kvalifikationer. På baggrund af bedømmelserne indkaldes en eller flere kandidater til samtale. De ansøgere, hvis ansøgning ikke sendes til bedømmelse, orienteres om dette umiddelbart efter shortlisting. Samtaler foretages i midten af december. Endeligt afslag sendes ved afslutningen af rekrutteringen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende forhandlingsberettigede overenskomst. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i 12 måneder. Det primære arbejdssted er Forskningscenter CENTRUM ved Museum Odense og det forventes, at du som udgangspunkt er til stede på museet i arbejdstiden. Der vil dog forekomme feltarbejde, seminarer og projektmøder andre steder.

Tiltrædelse 1. feb. 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Uddybende spørgsmål om stillingen kan rettes til projektleder ved Arven i Landskabet Peder Dam tlf. 21493464 og mail pda@museumodense.dk.

Museum Odense er en selvejende institution og et af landets store statsanerkendte kulturhistoriske museer. Vi driver i alt seks museer og havde i 2025 et samlet besøgstal på over 400.000. Museets Vision 2026 og Strategi 2024-2026 sætter rammer og retning for museets ambitiøse udvikling i de kommende år. Se museets vision og strategi på Organisation - Museum Odense Museum-Odense_kort-strategi-2024-2026.pdf

jobs.title: Elektriker til elbilsbatterier
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet elektriker med et stærkt teknisk mindset, og har du lyst til at arbejde med en af den grønne omstillings mest bemærkelsesværdige vækstsektorer? Trives du i en hverdag med høj grad af frihed under ansvar, hvor du er med til at forme og optimere de daglige arbejdsgange? Så er det dig, vi søger på vegne af vores kunde, Stena Recycling!

En anderledes og fremtidssikret elektrikerrolle

I denne rolle slipper du for de traditionelle bygge- og installationsopgaver. I stedet bliver du en nøgleperson i Stenas nye, banebrydende projekt omkring modtagelse, test, afladning og genanvendelse af elbilsbatterier.

Da området er i rivende udvikling, forventer vi ikke, at du er ekspert i højspændingsbatterier fra dag ét – Stena sørger for grundig oplæring og faglig opkvalificering. Det vigtigste er din faglige nysgerrighed, din høje sikkerhedsforståelse og dit engagement i at tage ansvar for opbygningen af et nyt felt.

Dine primære opgaver:

- Modtagelse, tilstandstest og registrering af elbilsbatterier fra hele Danmark.

- Styre og overvåge sikker afladning samt energihåndtering af højspændingsbatterier.

- Præcis af- og demontering af batteripakker ned på modul- og celleniveau.

- Klargøring af batterikomponenter til henholdsvis genanvendelse, destruktion eller second-life brug.

- Medvirke til at udvikle og optimere sikkerhedsrutiner, testudstyr og daglige arbejdsgange på værkstedet.

Hvad leder vi efter hos dig?

- Du er uddannet elektriker, automatiktekniker eller har en lignende el-teknisk baggrund.

- Du har en høj sikkerhedsforståelse og arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt.

- Du trives i en pionerrolle, hvor procedurer og arbejdsgange løbende udvikles og tilpasses.

- Du tager naturligt initiativ og er en god holdspiller.

Stena tilbyder:

- En unik chance for at opbygge en specialistprofil inden for et område i massiv vækst.

- En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, frihed under ansvar og stærkt sammenhold.

- Grundig oplæring, relevante kurser og løbende kompetenceudvikling.

- Oprigtig frihed under ansvar og stor tidslig fleksbilitet

¤praktisk info¤

- Lønnen afgøres efter dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer

- Arbejdstiderne er på daghold - 07:00 - 15:15 mandag - torsdag og fredag 07:00 - 13:00 (Stena betaler din pause)

- Arbejdet er dækket under Industriens Overenskomst

- Arbejdet foregår på Stenas lokation i Farum, men forventes at rykke til deres lokation i Roskilde, når det tekniske anlæg er oppe og køre.

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.

Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "ansøg". Randstad varetager rekrutteringsprocessen på vegne af Stena Recycling. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og der afholdes løbende interviews. Så send gerne din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt, hvis du vil med på holdet.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

Om Randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

Experienced Data Engineer Consultant

  • Full-time

Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. 

  • Contract: Full-time 

  • Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

  • Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

  • Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. 

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

  • Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. 

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. 

  • Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

  • A relevant degree.

  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

Our Impact

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

jobs.title: Orthoptistes : un CDI à Sedan H/F Debutant ok !
jobs.description:
DN8 Solutions LTD recrute un orthoptiste (H/F) pour exercer au sein d'un cabinet ophtalmologique situé à Sedan. Ce poste en contrat à durée indéterminée constitue une opportunité d'intégrer une structure médicale à taille humaine, où vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prise en charge des patients aux côtés des médecins ophtalmologistes.
Vous assurez l'ensemble des actes orthoptiques dans le cadre de consultations organisées et encadrées.
Vos missions portent principalement sur le bilan visuel, le dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation, ainsi que sur la rééducation orthoptique des patients de tous âges.
Vous contribuez activement à la fluidité des consultations en réalisant les examens complémentaires nécessaires à l'établissement du diagnostic médical.
Le poste est ouvert aux candidats débutants. Vous bénéficiez d'un encadrement adapté à votre niveau d'expérience et d'une montée en compétences progressive dans un environnement clinique structuré. Cette configuration est particulièrement favorable pour les orthoptistes souhaitant consolider leur pratique clinique en sortie de formation.
Vous évoluez dans un cadre de travail stable, avec des horaires définis permettant un équilibre satisfaisant entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Les équipements techniques mis à disposition sont adaptés aux exigences de la pratique orthoptique contemporaine, incluant les outils de réfractométrie, de périmétrie et d'imagerie fonctionnelle.
Ce poste représente une opportunité concrète de développer votre expertise clinique au sein d'une équipe médicale investie dans la qualité des soins apportés à ses patients.
Profil recherché:
Titulaire du Certificat de Capacité d'Orthoptiste (CCO), vous êtes débutant(e) ou disposez d'une première expérience en cabinet ophtalmologique ou en structure de soins. Les candidatures en sortie de formation sont les bienvenues.
- Maîtrise des techniques de bilan visuel et de réfraction subjective et objective
- Connaissance des protocoles de dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation
- Capacité à réaliser des examens complémentaires ophtalmologiques : réfractométrie, périmétrie, et imagerie fonctionnelle
- Aptitude à conduire des séances de rééducation orthoptique auprès de patients de tous âges, de la pédiatrie à la gériatrie
- Connaissance des pathologies relevant du champ orthoptique : strabisme, amblyopie, troubles oculomoteurs, basse vision
- Capacité à travailler en coordination avec les médecins ophtalmologistes dans le cadre de consultations structurées
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de traçabilité et de suivi patient utilisés en cabinet médical
- Rigueur dans la réalisation des actes et sens des responsabilités vis-à-vis des patients
- Qualités relationnelles permettant d'instaurer un climat de confiance avec des patients d'horizons et d'âges variés
- Capacité d'adaptation et volonté de progresser dans un environnement clinique encadré
- Sens de l'organisation pour contribuer à la fluidité des consultations au sein du cabinet

jobs.title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
jobs.description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Our offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and pre-screening requirements. The candidate acknowledges that all information provided must be accurate.

jobs.title: Teacher French Language B (DP and MYP) (m/f) - 6 months contract
jobs.description:
DP (Diploma Programme) and MYP (Middle Years Programme) French Language B - 6 months contract (2627-037)

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

Join Our Learning Community at ISL!

Do you believe that every learner has unique potential, and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking, and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that empower students to make sense of the world and their place in it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a teacher in our school, you will play a key role in shaping not only what our students learn, but how they learn. You'll design engaging, concept-driven lessons that invite curiosity, encourage reflection, and challenge students to connect learning to their own lives — locally and globally. Teaching in our Upper School means that you will be expected to take part in the student wellbeing / advisory programme.
Why ISL?

At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
· Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

About the Role

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:

If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.

If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

jobs.title: Opérateur(trice) de production agroalimentaire (H/F/X)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.

• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools

SD-26150-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN CARBON FIBRE SURFACE ENGINEERING AND COMPOSITE MANUFACTURING
Fixed term contract | Hautcharage | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

You will be mainly in charge of:

·        Developing and optimising carbon fibre recovery and recycling processes, with a focus on preserving fibre quality and length.
·        Investigating and optimising fibre surface treatments and sizing strategies to improve fibre–matrix compatibility and interfacial performance.
·        Developing fibre alignment strategies and semi-finished products based on recovered carbon fibres.
·        Manufacturing and optimising recycled carbon fibre composite materials and components using suitable processing routes.
·        Performing mechanical and microstructural characterisation and evaluating structure–process–property relationships.
·        Contributing to the manufacturing and validation of composite demonstrators.
·        Analysing and communicating research results through technical reports, scientific publications and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

·        PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer/Composite Engineering or a closely related field.
·        A strong research background in composite materials, preferably involving surface engineering, carbon-fibre-reinforced polymers and/or recycling.

Experience and skills

·        Strong background in fibre-reinforced polymer composites and composite manufacturing.
·        Experience in carbon fibre recycling, surface treatment and/or sizing.
·        Experience in composite processing and mechanical/material characterisation.
·        Knowledge of fibre alignment and semi-finished product manufacturing would be an asset.
·        Ability to independently plan, conduct and analyse experimental research.
·        Strong communication, scientific writing and teamwork skills.

Language skills

•              Fluency in English, oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas

·        Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce

·        32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

·        Contact details of 2 references

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies.

For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

De formation spécialisée en Banque/Finance/Gestion (à partir de Bac+5), vous possédez idéalement une première expérience (stage, intérim, apprentissage, CDD.) sur un poste similaire idéalement sur du Middle-office sur les instruments financiers, sur des données de marché ou plus globalement sur les activités de marché.
Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils de bureautique usuels.
Un bon niveau d'anglais est indispensable du fait de l'usage quotidien dans un contexte international.

Vous êtes reconnu pour votre rigueur, votre capacité d'analyse, votre capacité à gérer des dead lines serrées du fait de l'interaction avec les Front-offices, votre force de travail et de proposition, votre indépendance, votre esprit d'équipe.

Le poste est basé à Guyancourt (78) dans un campus verdoyant qui vous réserve bien des surprises.
Cette mission d'intérim s'étale sur 6 mois potentiellement renouvelable.

La rémunération brute annuelle fixe est comprise entre 40 et 45 K€ selon le profil.
Un modèle de travail hybride est prévu, avec minimum 2 jours par semaine de télétravail après la validation du manager.

Si votre profil correspond, nous échangerons par téléphone pour faire un point sur votre parcours et votre projet professionnel.

jobs.description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

This role requires residence in the Repub

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.
